safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
(يا بني آدم): its i'rab has already been given [Note: In āya (27) of this sura.]. (خذوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (زينة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (عند): an adverb of place, accusative [Note: Or of time.], attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خذوا). (كلّ مسجد): like the first [Note: In āya (29) of this sura.]. (الواو): a conjunction in the three places. (كلوا، اشربوا): like خذوا. (لا): prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تسرفوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إنّه لا يحبّ): like إنّه يرى … [Note: In āya (27) of this sura.]
and the verb is negated by (لا). (المسرفين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «يا بني آدم....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «خذوا....»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «كلوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خذوا.
The clause «اشربوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خذوا.
The clause «لا تسرفوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خذوا.
The clause «إنّه لا يحبّ....»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يحبّ المسرفين»: in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of inna.

* Morphology:
(زينة): a noun for that with which one adorns oneself, or a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of تزيّن; its pattern is فِعْلة, with kasra then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Majāz mursal (non-metaphorical trope): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ».
That is: take your clothing. Adornment is a state residing in clothing, so He expressed the state and meant the place in which it resides. The relationship is thus that of the state (ḥāliyya).

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (من): an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (حرّم): a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (زينة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of زينة. (أخرج): like حرّم. (لعباد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرج), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): a conjunction. (الطيّبات): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to زينة, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (من الرزق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الطيبات. (قل): like the first. (هي): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (اللام): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هي. (آمنوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (في الحياة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنوا) [Note: It may be attached to the predicate to which (للذين آمنوا) is attached.]. (الدنيا): naʿt of الحياة, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra. (خالصة): ḥāl, accusative, from the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar, i.e. "it is existing for them on the Day of Resurrection, in the state of being exclusive". (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to خالصة. (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الكاف): a preposition [Note: Or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description, i.e. "We detail them a detailing like that detailing".] of comparison. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governing word is the verb after it; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (نفصّل): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "We" (نحن) for majesty. (الآيات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نفصّل). (يعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative …. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من حرّم ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of (من).
The clause «أخرج.»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (التي).
The clause «قل (the second)»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هي للذين آمنوا»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «آمنوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «نفصل.»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعلمون»: in the position of genitive, naʿt of قوم.

* Benefits:
1- From the occasions of revelation:
Ibn ʿAbbās said that the occasion of the revelation of this āya was that the Arabs used to circumambulate the House naked, the men by day and the women by night, and they used to say: "We will not circumambulate in clothes in which we disobeyed Allah", as though disobedience did not go beyond the clothes to the hearts; so this āya was revealed.
2- Al-Rashīd had a skilled Christian physician, who said to ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Wāfid: "There is nothing of the science of medicine in your Book." He said to him: "Allah has gathered all of medicine in half an āya of His Book." He said: "And what is it?" He said: "The saying of Allah the Exalted: «كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا وَلا تُسْرِفُوا»." The physician said: "And nothing on medicine is transmitted from your Messenger."
He said: "Our Messenger has gathered medicine in a few words." He said: "And what are they?" He said: "His saying: «المعدة بيت الداء والحمية رأس كل دواء»" (The stomach is the house of disease, and abstinence is the head of every remedy).
The physician said: "Your Book and your Prophet have left no medicine for Galen."

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): like the preceding [Note: In the preceding āya (22).] [Translator's note: the source reads (22); the preceding āya is (32).]. (إنما): the restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (حرم): a past verb. (رب): fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الفواحش): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as badal (substitute) of الفواحش. (ظهر): like حرم. (من): a particle, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of ظهر. (الواو): a conjunction. (ما بطن): like ما ظهر and conjoined to it. (الواو): a conjunction in the four places. (الإثم، البغي): two nouns conjoined to الفواحش, accusative like it [Note: (الإثم) may be a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "He forbade" (حرم); the conjunction then becomes a conjoining of clauses.]. (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, [attached] to an omitted ḥāl of البغي. (الحق): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle causing the subjunctive. (تشركوا): an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بالله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تشركوا). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governing word being تشركوا. (لم): a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion [to past meaning]. (ينزل): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) is in the position of genitive, attached to (ينزّل). (سلطانا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تشركوا) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to البغي … or it is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "He forbade" (حرم), i.e. He forbade associating partners with Allah [Note: The conjunction then becomes a conjoining of clauses.].
(أن تقولوا على الله ما): like أن تشركوا بالله ما [Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun described [by an adjective] (nakira mawṣūfa), with the clause after it as its naʿt; the referring pronoun is omitted in both analyses.]. (لا): negating. (تعلمون): like يعلمون [Note: In the preceding āya (32).].
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «حرم ربي ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ظهر منها»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «بطن..»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «تشركوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لم ينزل ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «تقولوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «تعلمون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the fourth relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقولوا) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.

safi-cedvel:34-34.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (لكل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). (أمة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (أجل): a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). (الفاء): a conjunction. (إذا): an adverb for the future, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis يستأخرون. (جاء): a past verb. (أجل): fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لا): a particle of negation. (يستأخرون): an imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ساعة): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يستأخرون). (الواو): a conjunction. (لا يستقدمون): like لا يستأخرون.
The clause «لكل أمة أجل....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جاء أجلهم....»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا يستأخرون ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لا يستقدمون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.

safi-cedvel:80-84.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لوطا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember) «[Note: It is stated in Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal: "Here 'أرسلنا' (We sent) is not supplied, because the sending was not at the time of his statement mentioned; the adverb here prevents supplying the sending ..." End quote.]»; (إذ) an adverbial noun, badal (substitute) of (لوطا), in the position of accusative; (قال) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "هو"; (لقوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال); and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval and rebuke; (تأتون) imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is fāʿil; (الفاحشة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (ما) negating; (سبق) like قال, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أحد, i.e. "engaged in it"; (من) redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (أحد) genitive in form, nominative in position, fāʿil of سبق; (من العالمين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of أحد.
The clause «(اذكر) لوطا ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قال ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تأتون ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «ما سبقكم ... أحد» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the agent in (تأتون), i.e. "initiating it", or of الفاحشة, i.e. "not preceded by others than you" «[Note: It may be cut off as resumptive, and so have no grammatical position.]».
(81) (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of inna; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (تأتون) like the first; (الرجال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (شهوة) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative «[Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "desiring" (مشتهين). And if (تأتون) is taken to mean "you desire" (تشتهون), then (شهوة) is an object standing for the maṣdar, being a noun of the maṣdar.]» [Translator's note: the source prints «مشهين»; presumably مشتهين is intended.]; (من دون) preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of الرجال, i.e. "passed over" (متجاوَزين, with fatḥa on the wāw), or of the agent, i.e. "passing over" (متجاوِزين, with kasra on the wāw); (النساء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (بل) particle of iḍrāb (turning away) and of beginning; (أنتم) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (قوم) khabar (predicate), nominative; (مسرفون) naʿt of قوم, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «إنّكم لتأتون ....» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تأتون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «أنتم قوم ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(82) (الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (كان) incomplete past verb — an abrogator; (جواب) khabar of kāna, placed first, accusative; (قوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إلّا) particle of restriction; (أن) maṣdar particle; (قالوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma .. and the wāw is fāʿil; (أخرجوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من قرية) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخرجوا), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن قالوا ...) is in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna, placed later.
(إنّهم) like إنّكم; (أناس) khabar of inna, nominative; (يتطهرون) like تأتون.
The clause «وما كان جواب ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أخرجوهم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «إنّهم أناس ...» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يتطهّرون» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of أناس.
(83) (فأنجيناه وأهله) the i'rab of its like has already been given «[Note: In āya (72) of this sura.]»; (إلا) particle of exception; (امرأة) excepted by إلّا, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كانت) incomplete past verb — an abrogator — and (التاء) for the feminine, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي"; (من الغابرين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of كانت, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أنجيناه ...» is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.:
"they wanted to expel him, so We saved him", or "they intended to expel him, so We saved him".
The clause «كانت من الغابرين» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
(84) (الواو) circumstantial «[Note: The raining came before the saving, since they were rained upon first and then came the saving of Lot and his family; for this reason it is fitting that the clause be circumstantial .. It may also be cut off as resumptive.]»; (أمطرنا) like أنجينا; (على) preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أمطرنا), as it is made to include the meaning of أرسلنا (We sent); (مطرا)
mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) resumptive; (انظر) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "أنت"; (كيف) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, khabar of kāna placed first; (كان) like the first; (عاقبة) noun of kāna, nominative; (المجرمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أمطرنا ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «انظر ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كان عاقبة المجرمين» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb انظر, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative كيف.

* Morphology:
(جواب): a noun of the maṣdar of the verb أجاب; its pattern is فَعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(الغابرين): plural of الغابر, active participle of the triliteral غبر, meaning "remained" or "stayed"; its pattern is فاعل.
(مطرا): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the water of the clouds; it is on the pattern of a maṣdar but is intended as a concrete noun; its pattern is فَعَل, with two fatḥas.

* Benefits:
1- بل is for iḍrāb (turning away), conjunction, and departure from one ruling to another, when it comes after an affirmative statement; and it is for istidrāk (correction), just like «لكن», when it comes after a negation or prohibition.
If a clause follows it, it is not a conjunction but a particle of beginning, and it conveys either the cancelling iḍrāb or the transitional iḍrāb:
The cancelling, as in the words of Allah the Exalted: وَقالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمنُ وَلَداً سُبْحانَهُ. بَلْ عِبادٌ مُكْرَمُونَ.
The transitional, as in what occurs in this āya that we are dealing with: «بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُسْرِفُونَ».
1- Among those who distinguished between the triliteral (مطر) and the quadriliteral (أمطر) is al-Fīrūzābādī, author of al-Qāmūs al-Muḥīṭ, who said: "أمطرهم الله is said only of punishment", and there is disagreement on that..!

safi-cedvel:85-87.t:
* I'rab:
(وإلى مدين أخاهم ... من إله غيره) the i'rab of its like has already been given «[Note: In āya (65) of this sura.]»; (قد جاءتكم بنّية من ربّكم) its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In āya (73) of this sura.]»; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (أوفوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); (الكيل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (الميزان) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الكيل, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive; (تبخسوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (أشياء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (لا تفسدوا) like لا تبخسوا; (في الأرض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تفسدوا); (بعد) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تفسدوا); (إصلاح) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (ذلكم) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) .. and (اللام) for distance and (كم) a particle of address; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (اللام) preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خير); (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (كنتم) incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn. And (بم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna [Translator's note: the source prints «(بم)»; the attached pronoun (تم) is evidently intended], and it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (مؤمنين) khabar of كنتم, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «(أرسلنا) إلى مدين ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قال ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with (قد) implied «[Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «the vocative and its response ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «اعبدوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «قد جاءتكم بينة» has no grammatical position; a resumption within the scope of Shuʿayb's speech.
The clause «أوفوا الكيل» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you believe in the clear proof, then give full ...." «[Note: The fāʾ may be for linking the effect to the cause, so that the performative clause أوفوا is conjoined to the declarative clause جاءتكم.]».
The clause «لا تبخسوا..» is conjoined to the clause أوفوا الكيل.
The clause «لا تفسدوا ...» is conjoined to the clause أوفوا الكيل.
The clause «ذلكم خير لكم» has no grammatical position; causal.
The clause «كنتم مؤمنين» has no grammatical position; resumptive .. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the meaning of what preceded, i.e. "if you are believers, then do that good" «[Note: The clause may be parenthetical between two conjoined items, i.e. between the clause لا تفسدوا ... and the clause لا تقعدوا in the following āya.]».
(86) (الواو) conjunction; (لا تقعدوا) like لا تبخسوا; (بكل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقعدوا) «[Note: The bāʾ is for adhesion, or for location .. It may be for accompaniment, so the attachment is to an omitted ḥāl of the agent, i.e. "engaged with every path".]»; (صراط) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (توعدون) imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (تصدون) like توعدون; (عن سبيل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تصدّون); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (من) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi; (آمن) past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو", and it is the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid); (الباء) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (آمن); (الواو) conjunction; (تبغون) like توعدون, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (عوجا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. "crooked", accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (اذكروا) like أوفوا; (إذ) an adverb, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as an adverbial, attached to an omitted item which is the object of the verb اذكروا .. i.e. "remember Allah's favour at this time" «[Note: (إذ) may be accusative as a direct object, since the remembering falls on the time being spoken about.]»; (كنتم) like the first; (قليلا) khabar of كنتم, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (كثّر) past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو", i.e. Allah, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (انظروا) like أوفوا; (كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين) like كيف كان عاقبة المجرمين «[Note: In āya (84) of this sura.]».
The clause «لا تقعدوا» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تفسدوا..
The clause «توعدون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of تقعدوا.
The clause «تصدّون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause توعدون.
The clause «آمن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «تبغونها ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause توعدون.
The clause «اذكروا» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تقعدوا.
The clause «كنتم قليلا» is in the position of genitive through (إذ) being annexed to it.
The clause «كثّركم» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause كنتم قليلا.
The clause «انظروا.» is conjoined to the clause اذكروا.
The clause «كان عاقبة ...» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative كيف.
(87) (الواو) resumptive; (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (كان) incomplete verb — an abrogator — indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis; (طائفة) noun of kāna, nominative; (من) preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; (آمنوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma .. and the wāw is fāʿil; (الباء) preposition; (الذي) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (آمنوا); (أرسلت) past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn .. and (التاء) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (به) like the first, attached to (أرسلت) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the deputy agent in (أرسلت).]»; (الواو) conjunction; (طائفة) conjoined to the first word, and its naʿt has been omitted because the naʿt of the first indicates it; (لم) particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; (يؤمنوا) imperfect, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is fāʿil; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (اصبروا) like أوفوا; (حتى) particle of limit and preposition; (يحكم) imperfect, accusative by an implied أن after (حتّى); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (بين) adverb, accusative, attached to (يحكم), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحكم الله) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (اصبروا).
(الواو) circumstantial; (هو) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ; (خير) khabar, nominative; (الحاكمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «آمنوا.» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kāna.
The clause «أرسلت به» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause آمنوا. [Translator's note: so in the source; the following line suggests that the clause «لم يؤمنوا» was meant to be listed here as conjoined, while «أرسلت به» is the ṣila of الذي.]
The object attached to the verb is omitted, indicated by the attached object of the preceding verb, i.e. "did not believe in that with which I was sent".
The clause «اصبروا» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يحكم الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «هو خير ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl «[Note: The clause may be an explanatory resumption, and so have no grammatical position.]».

* Morphology:
(مدين): a proper noun for a specific city; its pattern is فَعْيَل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and the yāʾ, with a quiescent ʿayn between them, and the yāʾ did not undergo weakening (iʿlāl) because the letter before it is quiescent.

* Benefits:
- Abū l-ʿAlāʾ and "luzūm mā lā yalzam" (observing what is not required): in this āya there are two words, «قريتنا» and «ملتنا», each of which ends with the same two letters, tāʾ and nūn. This is a type of verbal embellishment to which poets and writers held fast with their molars until it reached the age of al-Maʿarrī, when it had become a school of artificiality rather than of craft. Nevertheless al-Maʿarrī adopted it as a binding plan in his dīwān «al-Luzūmiyyāt», and Abū l-ʿAlāʾ reached a degree of commitment in his Luzūmiyyāt that no poet ever reached: in one of his odes he committed himself to four letters, and in another to five letters, among them: ضرائرهم، وسرائرهم، وصرائرهم.
Yet it does reveal the possibilities of our language and its wealth in vocabulary. But Allah is witness that it is a killer of poetic taste, and an artificiality that neither avails nor benefits.
[Translator's note: the words «قريتنا» and «ملتنا» occur in the following āya (88), not in this passage.]

safi-cedvel:138-138.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (جاوزنا) like أورثنا «1»; (ببني إسرائيل) like على بني إسرائيل «2», attached to (جاوز); (البحر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) conjunction; (أتوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (على قوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أتوا) by its being made to carry the meaning of «قدموا» (they came upon); (يعكفون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (على أصنام) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعكفون); (اللام) preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an adjective (naʿt) of أصنام; (قالوا) like صبروا «3»; (يا) vocative particle; (موسى) the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; (اجعل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you", i.e. "make"; (لنا) like لهم, attached to (اجعل); (إلها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الكاف) preposition of comparison; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted adjective of (إلها); (لهم) like the first one, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما.. According to Ibn Hishām, the preposition and its genitive noun is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هي», i.e. the idols; (آلهة) badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the ṣila of ما, i.e. "like those which are established for them as gods".
The clause «جاوزنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أتوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يعكفون ...» is in the position of the genitive: an adjective of قوم.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يا موسى ...» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اجعل لنا إلها» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
(قال) past verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun (ism) of إنّ; (قوم) khabar of إنّ, nominative; (تجهلون) like يعكفون.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّكم قوم ...» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported.
The clause «تجهلون» is in the position of the nominative: an adjective of قوم.

safi-cedvel:139-139.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) particle of emphasis and of the accusative; (ها) for calling attention (tanbīh); (أولاء) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, the noun of إنّ; (متّبر) khabar (predicate), nominative [Note: Or a fronted khabar of the relative noun after it, and the nominal clause made of the relative noun with its ṣila and the khabar is the khabar of إنّ. Likewise (باطل) may be a khabar, with the interpreted maṣdar as mubtadaʾ, and the clause conjoined to the clause of the relative noun and its khabar.]; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive participle متّبر; (هم) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (في) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to the khabar of هم; (الواو) conjunction; (باطل) conjoined to متّبر, nominative like it; (ما) maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun, with the returning pronoun omitted.]; (كانوا) defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of كان; (يعملون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil of the active participle باطل.
The clause «إنّ هؤلاء متبّر..» has no grammatical position: resumptive, carrying a sense of giving the reason (taʿlīl).
The clause «هم فيه» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative: the khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(متبر): passive participle of the quadriliteral تبّر, i.e. "to perish"; its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:140-140.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval, rebuke and wonder; (غير) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), fronted; (الله) the Word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (أبغي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنا»; and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, with the lām omitted, the original being «أبغي لكم»; (إلها) tamyīz (specification) of غير, accusative [Note: It may also be a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the following analyses are also possible: (إلها) mafʿūl bihi, (غير) ḥāl of (إلها) — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies.]; (الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl; (هو) pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (فضّل) past verb, and the fāʿil is "he", and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على العالمين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضّلكم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أبغيكم ...» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هو فضّلكم ...» is in the position of the accusative: a ḥāl of the Word of Majesty or of the second-person plural pronoun [Note: The clause may also be cut off as a resumption, so that it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «فضّلكم ...» is in the position of the nominative: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هو.

* Rhetoric:
The interrogative departing from its original meaning: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «قالَ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلهاً», the interrogative here is for disapproval (inkār).

safi-cedvel:141-141.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكروا»; (أنجينا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من آل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنجينا); (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (يسومون) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the fāʿil, and (كم) like the last one; (سوء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (العذاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يقتّلون) like يسومون; (أبناء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يستحيون نساءكم) like يقتّلون أبناءكم; (الواو) resumptive; (في) preposition; (ذلكم) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate)..
and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (بلاء) delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (من ربّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of بلاء, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عظيم) second adjective of بلاء, nominative [Note: See the i'rab of the whole verse in Sūrat al-Baqara, verse (49).]
The clause «أنجيناكم ...» is in the position of the genitive: muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يسومونكم ...» is in the position of the accusative: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of آل فرعون.
The clause «يقتّلون ...» is in the position of the accusative: a badal (substitute) of the clause يسومونكم; and the clause «يستحيون ...» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause يقتّلون.
The clause «في ذلكم بلاء» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

safi-cedvel:142-142.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (واعدنا) like أنجينا [Note: In the previous verse (141).]; (موسى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif, and it does not take tanwīn; (ثلاثين) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the completion of thirty", the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (ليلة) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (أتممنا) like أنجينا [Note: In the previous verse (141).], and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بعشر) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أتممنا); (الفاء) conjunction; (تمّ) past verb; (ميقات) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أربعين) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ [Note: It may be a mafʿūl bihi if the verb تمّ is made to carry the meaning of بلغ (to reach).]; (ليلة) like the first; (الواو) resumptive; (قال) past verb; (موسى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (لأخي) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قال), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (هارون) badal (substitute) of أخيه — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (اخلف) imperative verb, and (النون) for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (في قوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اخلف), and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (أصلح) like اخلف; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive; (تتّبع) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "you"; (سبيل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (المعتدين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «واعدنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أتممناها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause واعدنا.
The clause «تمّ ميقات ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أتممناها.
The clause «قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اخلفني ...» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أصلح» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.
The clause «لا تتّبع ...» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.

safi-cedvel:175-176.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اتل) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اتل); (نبأ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الذي) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (آتينا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (آيات) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunctive; (انسلخ) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (انسلخ); (فأتبع) like فانسلخ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الشيطان) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) conjunctive; (كان) [Translator's note: the source has «فأفعل ماض», evidently a misprint for «فعل ماض».] defective (nāqiṣ) past verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; (من الغاوين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «اتل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آتيناه» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «انسلخ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أتبعه الشيطان» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause انسلخ.
The clause «كان من الغاوين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أتبعه الشيطان.
(الواو) conjunctive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (شئنا) like آتينا; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis (jawāb) of law; (رفعناه) like آتيناه; (بها) like منها, attached to (رفعنا); (الواو) conjunctive; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for istidrāk (rectification) – an abrogator – and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the ism of lākinna; (أخلد) like انسلخ; (إلى الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخلد); (الواو) conjunctive; (اتّبع) like [Translator's note: the source has «نسلخ», evidently for «انسلخ».] انسلخ; (هوى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunctive; (مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (الهاء) like the last one; (الكاف) a preposition [Note: It may be redundant (zāʾida), with (مثل) genitive in form and nominative in position as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ مثله.]; (مثل) genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الكلب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تحمل) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "you"; (عليه) like عليهم, attached to (تحمل); (يلهث) like تحمل, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أو) a conjunction; (تتركه يلهث) like تحمل ... يلهث, and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi; (ذلك) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ ... and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; the reference is to the parable; (مثل) khabar, nominative; (القوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الذين) relative noun in the position of the genitive, naʿt (adjective) of القوم; (كذّبوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis of an implied condition; (اقصص) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (القصص) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (لعلّهم يتفكّرون) like لعلّكم تتّقون [Note: In āya (171) of this sūra.].
The clause «لو شئنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كان من الغاوين.
The clause «رفعناه ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لكنّه أخلد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause شئنا.
The clause «أخلد ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of lākinna.
The clause «اتّبع ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause أخلد.
The clause «مثله كمثل ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause أخلد [Note: According to the view of al-Zamakhsharī, who said: "... The proper form of the speech would have been: ولو شئنا لرفعناه بها ولكنّه أخلد إلى الأرض فحططناه ووضعنا منزلته (had We willed We would have raised him by them, but he clung to the earth, so We abased him and lowered his rank); so His saying فمثله كمثل الكلب took the place of فحططناه as the most eloquent form of abasement ..." End quote.].
The clause «إن تحمل ...» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: According to al-Zamakhsharī and Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكلب. Abū Ḥayyān rejected this, saying: "... As for the conditional sentence, it hardly ever occurs in its entirety in the position of a ḥāl; one does not say جاءني زيد إن يسأل يعط as a ḥāl. Rather, if that were intended, the conditional sentence would be made the khabar of a pronoun referring to the one of whom the ḥāl is meant, as in جاء زيد هو إن يسأل يعط, so that what occupies the position of the ḥāl is the nominal sentence, not the conditional one. Yes, they have placed sentences headed by a conditional particle in the position of a ḥāl, but only after removing them from the reality of condition ... such as when it turns to the meaning of equivalence (taswiya), as in أتيتك وإن لم تأتي; had you left out the wāw, it would be confused with a real condition ..." End quote.].
The clause «يلهث» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تتركه» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause تحمل.
The clause «يلهث (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to يلهث (the first) [Note: Or it is the apodosis of a second condition, not joined with the fāʾ.].
The clause «ذلك مثل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اقصص ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you wish to admonish the people, then relate ...".
The clause «لعلّهم يتفكرون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of اقصص, i.e. hoping for their reflection; or it has no grammatical position, having the status of a causal explanation (taʿlīl).
The clause «يتفكّرون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الغاوين): plural of الغاوي, active participle of the triliteral غوى; its pattern is فاعل. In الغاوي there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is الغاويين with two yāʾs: the yāʾ came vowelless before the yāʾ that is the sign of the genitive, and the first was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters – and such is the case of the manqūṣ in the plural – its pattern being الفاعين.
(القصص): a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of the passive participle; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
Representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the noble āya the state of one who was given something and did not accept it is likened to the dog – in baseness and lowliness – which, if you drive at it, barks and turns away, and if you leave it, rushes at you and barks; it exerts effort and strain of itself in every one of its states. That is because no other animal pants unless it is roused and agitated, otherwise it does not pant; but the dog is abject, perpetually abject, panting in both states.

safi-cedvel:177-177.t:
* I'rab:
(ساء) past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm), and the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun obligatorily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو), and it has come specified by the word (مثلا), which is a tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb); (القوم) khabar (predicate) of an obligatorily omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هو, and that is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. مثل القوم [Note: (القوم) may be a postponed mubtadaʾ – also on the omission of a muḍāf – whose khabar is the clause before it.]; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as naʿt (adjective) of القوم; (كذّبوا بآياتنا) its i'rab has been given [Note: In the preceding āya (176).]; (الواو) conjunctive; (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, accusative, its governor being يظلمون, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كانوا) defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its ism; (يظلمون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ساء مثلا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كانوا يظلمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: It may be resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «يظلمون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of kānū.

* Benefits:
Every triliteral verb fit for expressing wonder (taʿajjub) may be used on the pattern «فَعُلَ» with ḍamma on the ʿayn, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «ساءَ مَثَلًا [Translator's note: the source's quotation mark is not closed here and the list of examples runs straight on.] ظرف وشرف وفهم وضرب, to convey praise or blame; it then runs the course of «نعم وبئس» in the rule of the fāʿil and of the one specified (al-makhṣūṣ) for praise or blame. As when you say: فهم الرجل علي, and خبث الرجل عمرو. Of this kind are: ساءَتْ مُرْتَفَقاً and ساءَ مَثَلًا «the āya». There is detail on this for whoever seeks benefit.

safi-cedvel:178-178.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first; (يهد) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) linking (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (هو) detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (المهتدي) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunctive; (من يضلل) like من يهد, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو); (الفاء) linking for the apodosis; (أولئك) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ ... and (الكاف) is a particle of address; (هم) pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الخاسرون, the nominal clause being the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.]; (الخاسرون) khabar of أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «يهد الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هو المهتدي» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يضلل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أولئك ... الخاسرون» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(المهتدي): active participle of the five-letter (اهتدى); its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn [Note: See āya (16) of Sūrat al-Baqara.].

safi-cedvel:35-37.t:
* I'rab:
(يا بني آدم): its i'rab has already been given [Note: In āya (27) of this sura.]. (إن): a conditional particle causing the jussive. (ما): a redundant (zāʾida) particle. (يأتين): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) … and (النون) is for emphasis, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (رسل): fāʿil (agent), nominative. (من): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسل. (يقصون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (عليكم): like منكم, attached to (يقصون). (آيات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ … and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الفاء): connecting the apodosis of the first condition. (من): a conditional noun causing the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (اتقى): a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو). (الواو): a conjunction. (أصلح): in the position of jussive, conjoined to (اتقى), the protasis. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis of the second condition. (لا): a particle of negation, inoperative (muhmal) [Note: Or it operates like laysa, its noun being (خوف) and its predicate (عليهم).]. (خوف): mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: Beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it relies on the negation.]. (عليهم): like منكم, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). (الواو): a conjunction. (لا): a redundant particle for emphasising the negation. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (يحزنون): like يقصون.
The vocative clause and its reply … have no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يأتينكم رسل....»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «يقصون....»: in the position of nominative, a second naʿt of رسل [Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (رسل), because the indefinite noun has been described.].
The clause «من اتقى....»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition إن, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اتقى....»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «أصلح»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اتقى.
The clause «لا خوف عليهم»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis of the condition (من), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هم يحزنون»: in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause of the second apodosis.
The clause «يحزنون»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(36) (الواو): a conjunction. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (كذّبوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): a conjunction. (استكبروا): like كذبوا. (عن): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (استكبروا) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "they kept away" (ابتعدوا). (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of the relative noun, and the predicate of the relative is أصحاب ...], and (الكاف) is a particle of address. (أصحاب): khabar, nominative. (النار): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (فيها): like عنها, attached to (خالدون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم, nominative.
The clause «الذين كذّبوا....»: in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause من اتقى.
The clause «كذّبوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «استكبروا عنها»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك أصحاب....»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «هم فيها خالدون»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of أصحاب, the governing factor in it being the meaning of the pointing [of the demonstrative].
(الفاء): connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (من): an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (أظلم): khabar, nominative. (من): a preposition. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to أظلم. (افترى): like اتقى. (على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترى). (كذبا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar because it is its synonym, since fabrication (الافتراء) is a synonym of lying (الكذب) … or it is a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl.]. (أو): a conjunction. (كذّب): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (بآيات): like the first, attached to (كذب), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أولئك): like the first. (ينال): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (نصيب): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (من الكتاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of نصيب. (حتى): a particle of beginning (ḥarf ibtidāʾ). (إذا): an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (قالوا). (جاءت): a past verb … and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (رسل): fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يتوفون): an imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (هم): like the preceding. (قالوا): like كذّبوا. (أين): an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ. (كنتم): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn … and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (تدعون): like يقصون. (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the omitted referring pronoun, i.e. "you call upon him besides Allah". (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (قالوا): like كذّبوا, and likewise (ضلّوا). (عنّا): like عنها, attached to (ضلّوا). (الواو): resumptive. (شهدوا): like كذبوا. (على أنفس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شهدوا), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of anna. (كانوا): like كنتم. (كافرين): the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنهم كانوا كافرين) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (شهدوا), i.e. they testified against themselves to their being disbelievers, or to their disbelief.
The clause «جاءتهم رسلنا ...»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يتوفونهم»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of رسلنا.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أين ما كنتم ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنتم تدعون ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تدعون ...»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of كنتم.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ضلوا عنا ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «شهدوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كانوا ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of anna.

* Morphology:
(يتوفونهم): the same weak-letter change (iʿlāl) took place in it as in (يتوفّون) — in the passive — in āya (234) of Sūrat al-Baqara.

* Rhetoric:
1- The interrogative departing from its original meaning: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرى عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً» and His saying «أَيْنَ ما كُنْتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ». In the first:
the interrogative is for denial, and in the second the interrogative is for rebuke and reproach.

* Benefits:
حتى comes in five kinds:
a- The ḥattā of beginning (al-ibtidāʾiyya), which is a particle that enters upon nominal clauses. b- The ḥattā after which أن is concealed and which enters upon the imperfect verb.
c- The ḥattā after which the imperfect is nominative.
d- The ḥattā that is a preposition; it is equivalent to «إلى» and indicates the end of the extent, whether spatial or temporal.
e- The conjunctive ḥattā, which conjoins under conditions. Each of the five kinds has conditions which we are unable to explain here, this being a place of brevity and concision.

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(قال): a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e. Allah. (ادخلوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the fāʿil is the pronoun wāw. (في أمم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ادخلوا), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "among some nations". (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (خلت): a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters …. and (التاء) is for the feminine. (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلت) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمم.], and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (من الجن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of أمم. (الواو): a conjunction. (الإنس): conjoined to الجن, genitive. (في النار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ادخلوا) [Note: The two prepositions (في) are attached to a single governing word because the first is not for containment but for accompaniment, i.e. "accompanying nations" … or the second may be a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of the first, the containment in the first being figurative.]. (كلما): an adverb meaning "when" (حين) [Note: The word (كل) in it may have the meaning of an adverb, and (ما) be a maṣdar-forming particle … and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.], containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis لعنت. (دخلت): a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (أمة): fāʿil, nominative. (لعنت): like دخلت. (أخت): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (حتى إذا): their i'rab has already been given [Note: In the preceding āya (37).]. (اداركوا): like كذّبوا [Note: In āya (36) of this sura.]. (في): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ادّاركوا). (جميعا): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the fāʿil of ادّاركوا. (قالت): like دخلت. (أخرى): fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لأولى): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قالت), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif, and (هم) is like the first. (رب): the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative particle omitted, a muḍāf, accusative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (أضلّوا): like كذّبوا [Note: In āya (36) of this sura.], and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الفاء): for connecting the effect to the cause. (آت): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (هم) is a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi. (عذابا): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ضعفا): naʿt of (عذابا), accusative. (من النار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second naʿt of (عذابا) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl of (عذابا), because it has been described.]. (قال): like the first. (لكل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (ضعف): a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو): a conjunction. (لكن): a particle of rectification (istidrāk). (لا): a particle of negation. (تعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ادخلوا....»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قد خلت ...»: in the position of genitive, naʿt of أمم.
The clause «دخلت أمة»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لعنت ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition (كلما).
The clause «ادّاركوا»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالت أخراهم»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the non-jussive condition (إذا).
The vocative clause and its reply: in the position of accusative, the speech reported [Note: It alone may be a parenthetical clause of pleading for mercy.].
The clause «هؤلاء أضلّونا»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «أضلونا»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هؤلاء).
The clause «آتهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the reply to the vocative [Note: It may be the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if they deserve the punishment, then give them ..."].
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لكل ضعف»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «لا تعلمون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.

* Morphology:
(ادّاركوا): it contains a substitution (ibdāl); its origin is تداركوا. The tāʾ was replaced by a dāl, then made quiescent so that its assimilation would be sound, then a connecting hamza was brought onto it so that pronunciation would be sound ...
Its pattern is أتفاعلوا.
(أخراهم): see āya (184) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(أولاهم): the feminine of الأول; it is a derived adjective, its pattern being فُعْلى with ḍamma on the fāʾ, and the alif is appended for the feminine.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): a conjunction. (قالت ... لأخراهم): like قالت ... لأولاهم [Note: In the preceding āya (38).]. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis of an implied condition. (ما): negating. (كان): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna. (على): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to فضل. (من): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (فضل): genitive in form, nominative in position, the delayed noun of kāna. (الفاء): for connecting the effect to the cause. (ذوقوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn … and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (العذاب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (الباء): a preposition of causation. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (كنتم): a defective past verb, an abrogator, and its noun [Translator's note: the source does not complete this phrase; the noun of kāna is the pronoun (تم)]. (تكسبون): an imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تكسبون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (ذوقوا).
The clause «قالت أولاهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالت أخراهم [Note: In the preceding āya (38).].
The clause «ما كان..»: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you went astray because of us, then there was not …"; the implied conditional clause together with its apodosis is in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ذوقوا ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the speech reported [Note: If the speech is from the saying of Allah and not from the saying of the group, then the clause is resumptive.].
The clause «كنتم تكسبون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تكسبون»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of كنتم.

safi-cedvel:143-144.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna), carrying the meaning of a condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to the apodosis قال; (جاء) past verb; (موسى) fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (لميقات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (كلّم) like جاء, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ربّ) fāʿil, nominative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (قال) like جاء, and the fāʿil is "he"; (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on what precedes the omitted first-person yāʾ, which is the muḍāf ilayhi; (أرني) imperative verb, of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter..
and (النون) for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (أنظر) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), as the response to the request [Note: This is according to the outward form, but the meaning is that the verb (أنظر) is the apodosis of an implied condition, the meaning being: "prepare for me the way to the vision; if You do so, or if that is accomplished, I will look at You."], and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «أنا»; (إلى) preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أنظر); (قال) like the first; (لن) particle of negation and of the accusative; (تراني) imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif ... and (النون) for protection, and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "you"; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) particle of rectification (istidrāk); (انظر) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (إلى الجبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انظر); (الفاء) conjunction; (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (استقرّ) past verb, indeclinable, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (مكان) accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بمكانه» ... and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (سوف) particle of the future; (تراني) like the first; (الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا تجلّى) like لمّا جاء, the indeclinability on the fatḥa being implied on the alif; (ربّه) like the first; (للجبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجلّى); (جعله) like كلّمه; (دكّا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, i.e. "crushed flat" (madkūkan); (الواو) (الواو) conjunction [Translator's note: (الواو) is written twice in the source.]; (خرّ) like جاء; (موسى) fāʿil, as before; (صعقا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; (فلمّا أفاق) like فلمّا تجلّى; (قال) like the first; (سبحانك) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb..
and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (تبت) past verb and its fāʿil; (إلى) preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تبت); (الواو) conjunction; (أنا) pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أوّل) khabar (predicate), nominative; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «جاء موسى ...» is in the position of the genitive: muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كلّمه ربّه» is in the position of the genitive: conjoined to the clause جاء موسى.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The vocative clause and its response ... are in the position of the accusative: the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أرني ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنظر إليك» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The second clause «قال» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لن تراني» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported.
The clause «انظر..» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.
The clause «استقرّ ...» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause انظر, so it falls within the scope of the speech.
The clause «سوف تراني» is in the position of the jussive: the apodosis.
The clause «تجلّى ربّه ...» is in the position of the genitive: muḍāf ilayhi.. and the condition with its protasis and apodosis is conjoined to the first condition with its protasis and apodosis.
The clause «جعله دكّا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «خرّ موسى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعله.
The clause «أفاق ...» is in the position of the genitive: muḍāf ilayhi.. and the condition with its protasis and apodosis is conjoined to the second condition with its protasis and apodosis.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «سبحانك» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «تبت..» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported.
The clause «أنا أوّل المؤمنين» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause تبت إليك.
(قال) like the first; (يا) vocative particle; (موسى) the one addressed, a single proper noun, indeclinable on the implied ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun (ism) of إنّ; (اصطفيت) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على الناس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اصطفيتك); (برسالات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اصطفيت), and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (بكلامي) like برسالاتي in i'rab and attachment; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (خذ) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (آتيت) like اصطفيت, and the second object is omitted, i.e. «آتيتك إياه»; (الواو) conjunction; (كن) defective imperative verb, its noun being a latent pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (من الشاكرين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كن, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; الشاكرين is genitive here, so "the sign of the genitive" is meant.].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The vocative clause and its response are in the position of the accusative: the speech reported.
The clause «إنّي اصطفيتك ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «اصطفيتك ...» is in the position of the nominative: the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «خذ ...» is in the position of the jussive: the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if My signs come to you, then take..".
The clause «آتيتك ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
The clause «كن من الشاكرين» is conjoined to the clause خذ.

* Morphology:
(تراني): like نرى.. it has the hamza — which is the ʿayn of the word — dropped for lightening; its original is ترأى, its pattern تفل with two fatḥas.
(تجلّى): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original is تجلّي — with yāʾ —; the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif.
(دكّا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb دكّ, of the naṣara pattern; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(صعقا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb صعق يصعق, of the fariḥa pattern; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then kasra.
(أفاق): the alif in it is changed from a wāw, because its bare form is فاق يفوق فوقا; when the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa it was changed to alif.
(كلامي): a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb كلّم; it may be applied to the revealed Book, naming a thing by the name of the maṣdar; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
Seeing Allah in this world and in the Hereafter:
As for this world, the verse states its negation explicitly in the saying of Allah the Exalted: لن تراني. As for the Hereafter, a dispute arose between the Muʿtazila and the Ashʿarīs. The Muʿtazila deny the vision in the Hereafter and say that «لن» is for perpetuity (taʾbīd), which indicates that the vision is impossible absolutely. The Ashʿarīs, on the other hand, argue for the possibility of the vision from other verses, among them the saying of Allah the Exalted: «وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ ناضِرَةٌ إِلى رَبِّها ناظِرَةٌ». The dispute widened and reached the point of mutual abuse and heaping of accusations, and each has its own point of view. How little need people have to plunge into matters that lie outside their sensory perception, beyond the "illuminated region", as the philosophers say. So reflect on the matter, and do not plunge in with those who plunge.

safi-cedvel:179-179.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath; (قد) particle of realization (taḥqīq); (ذرأنا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (لجهنّم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ذرأنا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (كثيرا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من الجنّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (كثيرا); (الواو) conjunctive; (الإنس) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الجنّ, genitive (majrūr); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (قلوب) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (لا) negative; (يفقهون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يفقهون); (الواو) conjunctive; (لهم أعين لا يبصرون بها) like لهم قلوب ...; (الواو) conjunctive; (لهم آذان لا يسمعون بها) like لهم قلوب ...; (أولئك) like the previous one [Note: In the preceding āya (178).]; (كالأنعام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of أولئك; (بل) particle of iḍrāb (digression) and of beginning; (هم) detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of the nominative; (أضلّ) khabar, nominative; (أولئك هم الغافلون) the i'rab of its like has been given [Note: In the preceding āya (178).].
The clause «ذرأنا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of an implied oath.
The clause «لهم قلوب ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (كثيرا) [Note: What permitted making it a ḥāl of an indefinite noun is that the indefinite noun is qualified ... The clause may also be in the position of the accusative as a second naʿt of (كثيرا).].
The clause «لا يفقهون بها» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of قلوب.
The clause «لهم أعين» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لهم قلوب.
The clause «لا يبصرون بها» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of أعين.
The clause «لهم آذان» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لهم قلوب.
The clause «لا يسمعون بها» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of آذان.
The clause «أولئك كالأنعام» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هم أضل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أولئك ... الغافلون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
Representative simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the noble āya, where the Jews – in the enormity of what they ventured upon in belying the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, despite their knowing that he is the promised Prophet – are likened to the many from whom faith can scarcely come, as though they had been created for the Fire. Then He likened them to cattle, indeed to what is beneath cattle, in relapse, folly and sinking into the depths of vice.

* Benefits:
1- «لا» comes in Arabic in several kinds, namely:
The Ḥijāzī «لا», as in the saying of al-Nābigha:
وحلّت سواد القلب لا أنا باغيا ... سواها ولا عن حبها متراخيا
(She settled in the core of my heart; I seek no other than her, nor am I slack in loving her.)
«لا» as a particle of answer, which is for negating in reply, as in: هل جاء فلان؟ and you say: لا.
The redundant (zāʾida) «لا», which conveys emphasis, as in «لِئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتابِ».
The conjunctive «لا», to exclude the second from what the first entered into, as in هذا بلد خصب لا جدب.
«The lā of generic negation (lā al-nāfiya li-l-jins)», on which there is a lengthy discussion.
«The negating lā», which negates the imperfect, the past and the present.
«The prohibitive lā (lā al-nāhiya)», which is for request, whether prohibition or supplication: the first: يا بنيّ لا تشرك بالله, and the second: ربنا لا تؤاخذنا ... It is one of the particles that put the imperfect verb in the jussive.

safi-cedvel:180-180.t:
* I'rab:
