(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (الأسماء) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (الحسنى) naʿt (adjective) of الأسماء, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause; (ادعوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (ادعوه); (الواو) conjunctive; (ذروا) like ادعوا; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يلحدون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في أسماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يلحدون), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (السين) particle of the future; (يجزون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. جزاء ما كانوا ...; (كانوا) defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its ism; (يعملون) like يلحدون.
The clause «لله الأسماء ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ادعوه بها» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause [Note: It may be the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. إذا دعوتموه فادعوه بها (when you call upon Him, call upon Him by them).].
The clause «ذروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ادعوه.
The clause «يلحدون» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «سيجزون ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (ما), and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. يعملونه.
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of kānū.

safi-cedvel:181-181.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a preposition; (من) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first [Note: Or a qualified indefinite noun in the position of the genitive.]; (خلقنا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أمّة) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (يهدون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يهدون; (الواو) conjunctive; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يعدلون), which is parsed like يهدون.
The clause «خلقنا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من) [Note: Or in the position of the genitive as naʿt (adjective) of (من).].
The clause «ممن خلقنا أمّة» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يهدون» is in the position of the nominative as naʿt of أمّة.
The clause «يعدلون» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يهدون.

safi-cedvel:182-183.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الذين) relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كذّبوا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (السين) particle of the future; (نستدرج) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "We" (نحن) for majesty, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من) a preposition; (حيث) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (نستدرج); (لا) negative; (يعلمون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «الذين كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «سنستدرجهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الواو) conjunctive; (أملي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is "I" (أنا); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أملي); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb – an abrogator (nāsikh); (كيدي) ism of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (متين) khabar of inna, nominative.
The clause «أملي ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause سنستدرجهم.
The clause «إن كيدي متين» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:88-89.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) past verb; (الملأ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, naʿt (adjective) of الملأ; (استكبروا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma .. and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil; (من قوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of استكبروا, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (نخرجنّ) imperfect, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative .. and (النون) the nūn of emphasis, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; (يا) vocative particle; (شعيب) the one addressed, a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) relative, in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the pronoun of the addressee in (نخرجنّك); (آمنوا) like استكبروا; (مع) adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (آمنوا), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من قرية) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نخرجنّ), and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) conjunction; (اللام) like the first; (تعودنّ) imperfect, nominative «[Note: Complete or incomplete .. It is taken as incomplete in the sense of "you become", because Shuʿayb was not of their religion so as to return to it .. And it is interpreted as complete on the principle of taghlīb (giving precedence to the majority), since Shuʿayb's people had been of the religion of the arrogant.]», the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and .. the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, is fāʿil, nominative «[Note: Or it is the noun of the verb if the verb is taken as incomplete.]». And (النون) the nūn of emphasis; (في ملّة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the agent of تعودنّ, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi «[Note: And the preposition and its genitive noun are the predicate of the verb if it is taken as incomplete.]»; (قال) like the first; (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval; (الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl «[Note: This i'rab is according to the view of al-Zamakhsharī, but Abū Ḥayyān says: "This wāw is the wāw of conjunction, conjoined to an omitted ḥāl, as in his saying, upon him be peace: «Turn the beggar away even with a burnt hoof» — the meaning is not 'turn him away in the state of giving him a burnt hoof as charity', but the meaning is 'turn him away accompanied by charity, even if accompanied by a burnt hoof'.." End quote.]»; (لو) a connective particle (ḥarf mawṣūl) «[Note: Al-Jamal said in his Ḥāshiya: "لو in a context like this is not for stating the non-occurrence of a thing because of the non-occurrence of another, but merely for linking." End quote.]»; (كنّا) incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn .. and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative, the noun of kāna; (كارهين) khabar (predicate) of كنّا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause: قال الملأ ... has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause: استكبروا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause: نخرجنّك has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath, and the implied oath clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The vocative clause: يا شعيب has no grammatical position; parenthetical, for threat.
The clause: آمنوا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause: تعودنّ has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath, and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the first oath clause, in the position of accusative.
The clause: قال ... has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) .. and the clause of the maqūl al-qawl is omitted, the implied form being: "أنعود فيها" (shall we return to it?).
The clause: كنّا كارهين is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in the implied verb نعود.
(قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (افترينا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn .. and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil; (على الله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افترينا); (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, if (افترى) is made to include the meaning of كذب (lied).]»; (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (عدنا) like افترينا, and the verb is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) «[Note: See footnote no. (1) on page 6.]»; (في ملّتكم) like في ملّتنا; (بعد) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (عدنا); (إذ) adverbial noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (نجّانا) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif ..
and its object; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative [Translator's note: the source reads «ومفعوله» without naming it; the object is evidently the pronoun (نا)]; (من) preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نجّانا); (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negating; (يكون) complete imperfect, in the sense of "it is fitting", nominative; (اللام) preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يكون); (أن) maṣdar particle making accusative; (نعود) imperfect, accusative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" «[Note: Taking the verb as either incomplete or complete.]»; (فيها) like منها, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعود) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يكون.
(إلّا) particle of exception; (أن يشاء) like أن نعود; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (ربّ) naʿt of the Name of Majesty, nominative like it, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يشاء الله) is in the position of accusative as an exception from the generality of states, i.e. "except in the state of Allah's willing" «[Note: Or: "it is not for us to return to it at any time except the time of Allah's willing" .. This implied reading is not valid with respect to the prophets, because they are protected from sin at all times.]».
(وسع) past verb; (ربّنا) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (علما) tamyīz (specification), accusative, converted from the agent; (على الله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توكّلنا), which is like افترينا; (ربّ) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, with the vocative particle omitted, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (افتح) imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is "أنت"; (بين) adverb, accusative, attached to (افتح), and (نا) like the preceding; (الواو) conjunction; (بين) like the first and conjoined to it; (قوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (نا) like the preceding; (بالحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (افتح), as it is made to include the meaning of احكم (judge); (الواو) resumptive; (أنت) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (خير) khabar, nominative; (الفاتحين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause: قد افترينا ... has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause: عدنا في ملّتكم has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption .. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if we return, then we have invented".
The clause: نجّانا الله ... is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause: ما يكون ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قد افترينا «[Note: Because the verb (افترينا) has the meaning of the future, "we would invent", despite (قد) preceding it.]».
The clause: نعود has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause: يشاء الله has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
The clause: وسع ربّنا ... has no grammatical position; resumptive, containing the meaning of giving a reason.
The clause: توكّلنا has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The vocative clause: ربّنا ... has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause: افتح ... has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause: أنت خير الفاتحين has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(كارهين): plural of كاره, active participle of the triliteral كره; its pattern is فاعل.
(نجّانا): it contains weakening (iʿlāl) by substitution; its origin is نجّينا — with yāʾ — and when the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa it was changed to alif: نجّانا; its pattern is فعّلنا.
(الفاتحين): plural of الفاتح, active participle of the triliteral فتح; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:90-90.t:
* I'rab:
(قال الملأ ... من قومه) the i'rab of its like has already been given «[Note: In āya (88) of this sura.]» [Translator's note: the source footnote prints «الصورة» for «السورة»]; (اللام) paving the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (اتّبعتم) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). And (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (شعيبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of inna; (إذا) a particle of response with no governing effect «[Note: But it conveys emphasis .. Abū Ḥayyān said in al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ: "Some grammarians claimed that it is in the position of an adverb, governed by لخاسرون, and that the nūn is a compensation for what was omitted, the implied form being: 'you, when you have followed him (ابتعتموه), will be losers'; when what it was annexed to was omitted, the nūn was given in compensation for that ... like the compensation in يومئذ and حينئذ and the like. What this claimant held is nothing, because compensation and omission have not been established for the إذا of the future in any instance on which this could be modelled ..." End quote.]» [Translator's note: «ابتعتموه» in the quotation appears to be a misprint for اتّبعتموه]; (اللام) the lām of the oath, which serves to link the response to the oath «[Note: And it is the shifted lām (al-muzaḥlaqa) when there is no oath.]»; (خاسرون) khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause: قال الملأ.. has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قال الملأ الذين استكبروا.
The clause: كفروا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause: اتّبعتم is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause: إلّكم.. لخاسرون [Translator's note: misprint in the source for «إنّكم»] has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath .. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.

safi-cedvel:91-91.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (أخذت) past verb .. and (التاء) for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الرجفة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) like the first; (أصبحوا) incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma .. and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative, the noun of aṣbaḥa; (في دار) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاثمين, which is the khabar (predicate) of aṣbaḥa, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause: أخذتهم الرجفة has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قال الملأ ...
The clause: أصبحوا ... جاثمين has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أخذتهم الرجفة.

safi-cedvel:92-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كذّبوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma .. and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); (شعيبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (كأنّ) lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is omitted, its implied form being كأنهم; (لم) particle of negation, jussive and inversion (of tense); (يغنوا) imperfect, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is fāʿil; (في) preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يغنوا); (الذين كذّبوا شعيبا) like the first; (كانوا) like أصبحوا «[Note: In the preceding āya (91).]»; (هم) pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); (الخاسرين) khabar (predicate) of كانوا, accusative.
The clause: الذين كذّبوا ... has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause: كذّبوا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (الذين).
The clause: كأن لم يغنوا ... is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause: يغنوا ... is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the lightened كأن.
The clause: الذين كذّبوا (the second) has no grammatical position; resumptive, emphasising.
The clause: كذّبوا (the second) has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause: كانوا.. الخاسرين is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (الذين).
(الفاء) conjunction; (تولّى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (عن) preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تولّى); (الواو) conjunction; (قال) past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو"; (يا) vocative particle; (قوم) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness, and the dropped (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (أبلغت) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn .. and (التاء) is fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (رسالات) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (نصحت) like أبلغت; (اللام) preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نصحت); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (كيف) interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), governed by (آسى), which is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; (على قوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آسى); (كافرين) naʿt (adjective) of قوم, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause: تولّى ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أصبحوا..
جاثمين «[Note: In the preceding āya (91), and what lies between the two clauses is in the status of a parenthesis.]».
The clause: قال ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تولّى.
The vocative clause: يا قوم is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause: قد أبلغتكم has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath .. and the implied oath clause is the response to the vocative.
The clause: نصحت has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أبلغت..
The clause: آسى ... is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you do not believe, then how should I grieve.."

* Morphology:
(يغنوا): it contains weakening (iʿlāl) by deletion; its origin is يغناوا; the alif was dropped because it met, quiescent, with the wāw of the plural, and then the fatḥa remained on the nūn as an indication of the dropped alif.
(آسى): the madda in it is converted from two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second quiescent, its origin being أأسى. It also contains weakening by substitution, since the yāʾ in it — which is the lām (third radical) of the verb — was changed to alif because it came vowelled after a fatḥa; its past is أسي, and the imperfect was originally يأسي — with yāʾ — and then became بأسى — with alif —. [Translator's note: «بأسى» is evidently a misprint for يأسى.]

* Rhetoric:
1- Repetition (al-takrīr): in the words of Allah the Exalted «الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْباً». That is for emphasis in rebutting what the chiefs said to their followers, deriding their opinion, mocking their counsel to their people, and treating as momentous what befell them.
2- A description of the state of the soul in its wavering:
His grief for his people became intense, then he reproached himself, saying: How should my grief become intense over a people who are not worthy of being grieved over, because of their disbelief and their deserving what came down upon them.

safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
Disconnected letters (ḥurūf muqaṭṭaʿa); the i'rab of their counterpart has been given in Surat al-Baqara (ألم). Al-Khāzin said in his tafsir: they are disconnected letters whose knowledge He has kept to Himself, and they are His secret in His Mighty Book.

* Benefits:
Despite the great amount of discussion the exegetes have brought concerning the interpretation of these letters that come at the opening of the surahs, and despite those many and differing opinions about these letters, I am moved to cast my bucket among the buckets. I say: since the reading of these letters corresponds to their names among the scholars of Arabic, old and new, there is nothing to prevent that Allah wished to remind us of the foundations on which our spoken and written language rests, namely the letters of the alphabet, and that they are the parts from which the language of the ḍād is composed, including this Noble Qur'an. So the opening of the surahs with these letters is nothing but a sanctification of them and a teaching to us so that we become acquainted with them, at a time when readers and writers were rarer than red sulphur, as the ancients say ... !

safi-cedvel:2-2.t:
* I'rab:
(كتاب): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هذا or هو. (أنزل): a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (إلى): a preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition [Note: Or a conjunction linking effect to cause.]. (لا): a prohibitive particle that puts the verb in the jussive. (يكن): an incomplete imperfect verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — jussive (majzūm). (في صدر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of يكن, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (حرج): the noun of يكن placed later, nominative. (من): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حرج. (اللام): a particle of causation. (تنذر): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām. (به): like منه, attached to the verb تنذر.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنذر به) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزل) [Note: Or attached to the notion of being settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar of يكن is attached; in that case there is no parenthesis.].
(الواو): conjunction. (ذكرى): conjoined to the position of the interpreted maṣdar — the genitive — the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif [Note: It may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "huwa", nominative, and the clause is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أنزل .. or it is conjoined to كتاب, nominative.]. (للمؤمنين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ذكرى.
The clause «(هذا) كتاب ...»: has no grammatical position, initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «أنزل ..»: in the position of nominative as a naʿt of كتاب.
The clause «لا يكن .. حرج»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you recite it, or if its revelation continues, then let there be no ... constraint [Note: The clause may be conjoined to the initial clause and so have no grammatical position, if the fāʾ is a conjunction ... and the implied conditional clause together with its apodosis is a parenthesis between what is attached and what it is attached to.].
The clause «تنذر به»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the concealed particle-relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(اتّبعوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أنزل إليكم): like أنزل إليك [Note: In the previous ayah (2).]. (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in (أنزل), i.e. being from your Lord.], and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (لا): a prohibitive particle that puts the verb in the jussive. (تتّبعوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of أولياء — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies — and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أولياء): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (قليلا): a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), since it is its attribute [Note: Or a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial) standing in for the adverb, i.e. you take heed for a little time.], i.e. you take heed with little heeding. (ما): a redundant (zāʾida) particle to emphasise the fewness. (تذكّرون): an imperfect verb, nominative, from which one of the two tāʾs has been dropped; the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «اتّبعوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنزل إليكم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تتّبعوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تذكّرون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تذكّرون): one of the two tāʾs has been dropped from it for lightness; its origin is تتذكّرون, its pattern being تتفعّلون. [Translator's note: The source gives the pattern as تفعّلون; the full form تتذكّرون corresponds to تتفعّلون.]

safi-cedvel:4-5.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (كم): the predicative (khabariyya) كم, an allusive word for a number, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: It may be the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation), explained by the one mentioned, and coming after it because it must stand at the head of the clause, i.e.: how many a town We destroyed.]. (من قرية): a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as tamyīz (specification). (أهلكنا): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi [Note: The meaning is: We willed its destruction.]. (الفاء): conjunction. (جاءها): a past verb and its object. (بأس): fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (بياتا): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, interpreted as a derived word, i.e. passing the night. (أو): a conjunction. (هم): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of nominative. (قائلون): khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «كم من قرية ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أهلكناها»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (كم).
The clause «جاءها بأسنا ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أهلكناها.
The clause «هم قائلون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the wording of the ḥāl (بياتا).
(5) (الفاء): conjunction. (ما): a negating particle. (كان): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (دعوى): the noun of كان, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إذ): an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (دعوى). (جاءهم بأسنا): like جاءها بأسنا. (إلّا): a particle of restriction. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle. (قالوا): like اتّبعوا [Note: In the earlier ayah (3) of this surah.]. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (كنّا): an incomplete past verb and its noun. (ظالمين): khabar of كنّا, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن قالوا) is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان.
The clause «ما كان دعواهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause, and in it there is the meaning of being caused by what precedes it.
The clause «جاءهم بأسنا»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «إنّا كنّا ظالمين»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنّا ظالمين»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(قائلون): plural of قائل, meaning one resting at the time of the midday nap (qaylūla); an active participle, its pattern being فاعل.
(دعوى): a non-regular (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb دعا يدعو, of the bāb naṣara; its pattern is فعلى with fatḥa on the fāʾ. It has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: the final alif was originally yāʾ because it came in fourth position, and when the letter before it had fatḥa it was changed to alif.

* Rhetoric:
1- Al-majāz al-mursal (non-metaphorical trope): in the words of the Exalted «وَكَمْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْناها», for He mentioned the town and meant its people; it is a trope whose relation is that of location (maḥalliyya).

* Benefits:
1- The predicative كم: the noun after it comes in the genitive with «من», and this «من» is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; the noun that follows it is genitive in form and accusative in position as tamyīz.
2- We have learned during our long labour in matters of i'rab that the wāw of circumstance (wāw al-ḥāl) is the one that may validly be replaced by «إذ», the adverb of past time ... ! and the meaning remains as it is, without any change or alteration ... !

safi-cedvel:40-41.t:
* I'rab:
(إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. (كذّبوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): a conjunction. (استكبروا): like كذبوا. (عن): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (استكبروا) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "they held themselves above" (ترفعوا). (لا): a particle of negation. (تفتح): an imperfect verb, passive, nominative. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تفتح). (أبواب): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. (السماء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): a conjunction. (لا): like the first. (يدخلون): an imperfect verb, nominative … and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الجنة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (حتى): a particle of limit and a preposition. (يلج): an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن concealed after حتى. (الجمل): fāʿil, nominative. (في سمّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يلج). (الخياط): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يلج الجمل) is in the position of genitive by (حتى), attached to (يدخلون).
(الواو): resumptive — or parenthetical. (الكاف): a preposition of comparison. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is نجزي; (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (نجزي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (المجرمين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «إن الذين كذبوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «استكبروا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كذّبوا ...
The clause «لا تفتح ... أبواب ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «يدخلون ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لا تفتح.
The clause «يلج الجمل»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «نجزي المجرمين»: has no grammatical position, resumptive ...
(41) (لهم): like the first, attached to a fronted khabar. (من جهنم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of مهاد — a naʿt (adjective) that has come before what it qualifies. (مهاد): a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الواو): a conjunction. (من فوق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (غواش): a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). (وكذلك نجزي الظالمين): like وكذلك نجزي المجرمين ...
The clause «لهم من جهنم مهاد»: has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: It may be a ḥāl of المجرمين.].
The clause «من فوقهم غواش»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نجزي ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الجمل): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known animal; and in al-Qāmūs: الجمل is the ship's rope. Its pattern is فَعَل, with two fatḥas.
(سم): a primitive noun for the eye of the needle; its pattern is فَعْل, with fatḥa then sukūn — ḍamma and kasra on the sīn are also permitted — and its plural is سموم and سمام.
(الخياط): a primitive noun for the instrument with which one sews; its pattern is فِعال, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(مهاد): see āya (206) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(غواش): plural of غاشية, the feminine of غاش, an active participle of غشي, the defective [verb]; its pattern is فاع, and the pattern of غواش is فواع. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, and the tanwīn in it is a tanwīn of compensation, i.e. compensation for the dropped yāʾ [Note: In al-Jamal's gloss on the Jalālayn the following appears: «The iʿlāl, i.e. the change and modification by deletion, takes precedence over the diptote status, i.e. the deletion of the tanwīn. Its origin is غواشي — with the tanwīn of full declension — the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent; two quiescent letters, the yāʾ and the tanwīn, met, so the yāʾ was deleted ... then its being originally on the pattern فواعل was taken into account, so the tanwīn of full declension was deleted, and it was feared that the yāʾ would return and the heaviness would occur, so the tanwīn of compensation was brought. So غواش with tanwīn is a diptote, and the tanwīn here is a tanwīn of compensation.... The preferred view gives precedence to the iʿlāl only because its cause, the heaviness, is evident, while the cause of the diptote status is hidden ... end.»].

* Rhetoric:
1- In the saying of Allah the Exalted: «حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِياطِ» there is a rhetorical art called al-madhhab al-kalāmī (dialectical argument). Its definition is that the speaker argues for what he intends and establishes it with a proof that blunts the weapon of the stubborn, arrogant opponent and cuts off his evidence, in the manner of the scholars of kalām. For the science of kalām consists in establishing the foundations of religion with rational proofs and decisive demonstrations that refute contentiousness; and of it is a logical kind in which sound conclusions are drawn from true premises. In the āya with which we are concerned, the way of drawing the conclusion from the two premises is to say: the disbelievers will never enter Paradise until the camel passes through the eye of the needle; and the camel will never pass through the eye of the needle; therefore they will never enter Paradise — because making a condition dependent on something impossible entails the impossibility of what is conditioned occurring.

* Benefits:
1- غواش: it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ), and it is in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ. Its due was to say «غواشي»; but since its yāʾ is quiescent and the ḍamma does not appear on it, two quiescent letters met — the quiescent yāʾ and the tanwīn, which is a quiescent nūn — so this required us to delete the quiescent yāʾ, since the kasra indicates it. It is said that this tanwīn is the tanwīn of compensation, because it is compensation for the deleted quiescent yāʾ.
«غواش» is the plural of غاشية, and there are two schools on its i'rab: the majority hold that it is a diptote, and others said that it is fully declinable.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (الذين): a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (آمنوا): like كذّبوا «1». (الواو): a conjunction. (عملوا): like كذبوا «2». (الصالحات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لا): a particle of negation. (نكلف): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "We" (نحن) for majesty. (نفسا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (إلا): a particle of restriction. (وسع): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) is a particle of address. (أصحاب): khabar (predicate), nominative. (الجنة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (في): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدون. (خالدون): khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عملوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لا نكلف....»: has no grammatical position, parenthetical [Note: The clause may be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين آمنوا....), with the referring pronoun implied, namely the phrase منهم, i.e. "We do not burden any soul among them" ... and in that case the clause أولئك أصحاب الجنة.... is parsed as a second khabar, or it is cut off as resumptive.].
The clause «أولئك أصحاب....»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «هم فيها خالدون»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of أصحاب, the governing factor in it being the pointing [of the demonstrative].

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): a conjunction. (نزعنا): a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في صدور): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [element forming the] ṣila of ما, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (من غلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the referring pronoun in the ṣila or of the relative. (تجري): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (من تحت): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of الأنهار.]. (هم): like the first. (الأنهار): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): a conjunction. (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الحمد): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). (الذي): a relative noun in the position of genitive, naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. (هدى): a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (اللام): a preposition. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (هدى). (الواو): a conjunction [Note: Or resumptive, and the clause after it then has no grammatical position as resumptive.]. (ما): negating. (كنا): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun. (اللام): the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd). (نهتدي): an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن concealed after the lām. (لولا): a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), containing the meaning of condition. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle. (هدانا): like the first. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نهتدي) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of كنا.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن هدانا الله) is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is obligatorily omitted, the implied form being: "were it not that Allah's guidance of us is existent".
(اللام): the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (جاء): a past verb, and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine. (رسل): fāʿil, nominative. (ربّ): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بالحق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of رسل, i.e. they came clothed with the truth. (الواو): a conjunction. (نودوا): a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (أن): an explicative particle [Note: Or lightened from the heavy (أنّ), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause after it is the khabar.]. (تلكم): a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn appearing on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ ... (اللام) is for distance, (الكاف) for address and (الميم) for the masculine plural. (الجنة): badal (substitute) of the demonstrative or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it [Note: It may be the khabar of the demonstrative, and the clause after it a ḥāl of it.], nominative. (أورثتم): a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn ... (تم) is a pronoun, the nāʾib fāʿil, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), being the lengthening of the ḍamma vowel, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (كنتم): a defective past verb — an abrogator — and its noun. (تعملون): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أورثتموها).
The clause «نزعنا ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause أولئك أصحاب [Note: In the preceding āya (42).] ...
The clause «تجري.... الأنهار»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the pronoun in (صدورهم).
The clause «قالوا ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تجري.
The clause «الحمد لله ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هدانا لهذا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «ما كنا لنهتدي ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.
The clause «نهتدي ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «هدانا الله»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the overt particle relative (أن).
The nominal clause «لولا أن هدانا الله»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.].
The apodosis of لولا is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "were it not that Allah guided us, we would not have been guided".
The clause «جاءت رسل ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to an implied oath.
The clause «نودوا ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause قالوا [Note: Or cut off as resumptive.].
The clause «تلكم الجنّة ...»: has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «أورثتموها ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (تلكم).
The clause «كنتم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تعملون»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(غلّ): a maṣdar established by usage (samāʿī) of the verb غلّ يغلّ, of the bāb ḍaraba; its pattern is فِعْل, with kasra on the fāʾ. The verb has another maṣdar, غليل, whose pattern is فعيل.
(نودوا): in it the alif was changed into wāw to suit the passive, its origin being نادى; then it contains iʿlāl by deletion, its origin being نوديوا — with ḍamma on the yāʾ — the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent — iʿlāl by quiescence — and the vowel was transferred to the dāl; then the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, so it became نودوا. Its pattern is فوعوا.

* Benefits:
1- A pronoun is appended to the demonstrative, namely the kāf of the addressee, to indicate the kind of addressee; for that reason it inflects as the addressee does, so one says: تلكم, تلكما, تلكن, etc. In the Noble Quran there are many examples that clarify this, such as the saying of Allah the Exalted: «فَذانِكَ بُرْهانانِ» and the saying of the wife of al-ʿAzīz: «فَذلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ». We will return to this topic in other places, Allah willing.

safi-cedvel:6-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive, indicating temporal sequence. (اللام): the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (نسألنّ): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative ...
and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu", for majesty. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أرسل): a passive past verb. (إليهم): a preposition and a pronoun in the position of genitive; the preposition and what it governs stand in place of the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction. (لنسألنّ): like the first. (المرسلين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «لنسألنّ»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath, and the oath clause is resumptive.
The clause «أرسل إليهم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «نسألن (the second)»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the oath clause.
(7) (الفاء): conjunction. (لنقصّنّ): like لنسألنّ. (عليهم): like إليهم, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نقصّنّ). (بعلم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of نقصّنّ, i.e. being with knowledge, and the bāʾ is for accompaniment. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): a negating particle. (كنّا غائبين): like كنّا ظالمين [Note: In the previous ayah (5).].
The clause «نقصّنّ»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath ... and the oath clause is conjoined to the resumption given in the previous ayah.
The clause «ما كنّا غائبين»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the omitted ḥāl to which the preposition and its genitive noun بعلم are attached.
(8) (الواو): conjunction. (الوزن): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative [Note: It may be indeclinable on fatḥa because it is annexed to an indeclinable word ... The adverb may also be attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, in which case (الحقّ) is parsed as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "huwa", and the clause is parenthetical.], attached to الوزن; إذ is an adverbial noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn at its end is the tanwīn of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ). (الحقّ): khabar, nominative. (الفاء): resumptive. (من): a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (ثقلت): a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء) is for the feminine. (موازين): fāʿil, nominative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (هم): a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or it is a detached pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is المفلحون ... and the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.]. (المفلحون): khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «الوزن ... الحقّ»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the previous resumption.
The clause «من ثقلت موازينه»: has no grammatical position, resumptive, and in it there is the meaning of being caused by what precedes it.
The clause «أولئك ... المفلحون»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
(9) (الواو): conjunction. (من خفّت ... فأولئك): like its earlier counterpart. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك. (خسروا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أنفس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الباء): a causal preposition. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (كانوا): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the noun of كان. (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يظلمون) by its being made to imply the meaning of يكذبون (they deny) or يجحدون (they reject), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يظلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «من خفّت موازينه»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من ثقلت ...
The clause «خفّت موازينه»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «أولئك الذين ...»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «خسروا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يظلمون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(غائبين): plural of غائب, an active participle of غاب يغيب, of the bāb ḍaraba; its pattern is فاعل. It has substitution of the yāʾ by hamza because it came after the alif of فاعل, and its origin is غائب. [Translator's note: So in the source; the underlying form intended is غايب.]
(الوزن): a non-regular (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb وزن يزن, of the bāb ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(موازين): plural of ميزان ... (see ayah 152 of Surat al-Anʿām).

safi-cedvel:145-145.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (كتبنا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun, the fāʿil (agent); (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (كتبنا); (في الألواح) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كتبنا); (من كلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of موعظة; (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (موعظة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: Some made it a badal (substitute) of the preposition and its genitive noun before it (من كل شيء), since its position is the accusative.]; (تفصيلا) conjoined to موعظة by the wāw, accusative; (لكلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفصيلا) [Note: The lām may be taken as redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening, with (كلّ) accusative by position as mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar (تفصيلا).]; (شيء) like the first. (الفاء) conjunction; (خذ) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you", and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بقوّة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of خذ, i.e. "being clothed with it" (mutalabbisan) [Note: The preposition and its genitive noun may be a ḥāl meaning "take it earnestly" or "diligently".]; (الواو) conjunction; (أؤمر) like خذ; (قوم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يأخذوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the request, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بأحسن) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأخذوا) by its being made to carry the meaning of «يتمسّكوا» (hold fast), the sign of the genitive being the kasra, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (السين) particle of the future; (أوري) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنا»; (دار) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاسقين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «كتبنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خذها ...» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb قلنا, and the omitted clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause كتبنا.
The clause «أؤمر ...» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause خذها.
The clause «يأخذوا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سأريكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(الألواح): plural of لوح, a non-derived (jāmid) noun denoting a known concrete thing; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
The clause [Translator's note: so in the source («وجملة»); a morphological item is meant.]: (وأمر): it has the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) dropped; the original is أؤمر — with a connecting hamza and then a second hamza written on a wāw, because the vowel of the connection is ḍamma —; when the conjunction came, the connecting hamza was dropped and the second hamza was then written on an alif; its pattern is وفعل, with sukūn on the fāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Iltifāt (shift of person): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «سَأُرِيكُمْ دارَ الْفاسِقِينَ» there is a shift from the third person to direct address; the purpose is intensity in urging. And in putting "showing" in the place of "taking heed" there is a putting of the effect in the place of the cause, also for intensity.

safi-cedvel:146-146.t:
* I'rab:
(سأصرف) like سأوري [Note: In the previous verse (145).]; (عن آيات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أصرف), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يتكبّرون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (في الأرض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتكبّرون); (بغير) preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يتكبّرون; (الحقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; and (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (يروا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (آية) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (لا) particle of negation; (يؤمنوا) imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباء) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يؤمنوا); (الواو) conjunction; (إن يروا سبيل ...) like its counterpart before it, and (الهاء) in (يتّخذوه) is the first mafʿūl bihi; (سبيلا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; the second (إن يروا ...) is parsed like the first; (ذلك) demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).. and (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address, and the reference is to the turning away; (الباء) preposition; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun (ism) of أنّ; (كذّبوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بآيات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (كانوا) defective past verb, an abrogator, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the noun of كان; (عنها) like بها, attached to (غافلين), which is the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «سأصرف ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يتكبّرون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
The clause «إن يروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لا يؤمنوا بها» has no grammatical position: the apodosis, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن يروا» (the second) has no grammatical position: conjoined to the first clause إن يروا.
The clause «لا يتّخذوه ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of the second condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن يروا» (the third) has no grammatical position: conjoined to the second clause إن يروا.
The clause «يتّخذوه ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of the third condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ذلك بأنّهم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), or giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كذّبوا ...» is in the position of the nominative: the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «كانوا عنها غافلين» is in the position of the nominative: conjoined to the khabar clause of أنّ [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption, so that it has no grammatical position.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم كذّبوا..) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلك).

* Rhetoric:
Ṭibāq (antithesis): between the path of right guidance (سبيل الرشد) and the path of error (سبيل الغي).

safi-cedvel:147-147.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الذين) relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (كذّبوا بآياتنا) like the previous one [Note: In the previous verse (146).
(2, 3) In the previous verse (146).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لقاء) conjoined to آيات, genitive like it; (الآخرة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (حبطت) past verb ... and (التاء) for the feminine; (أعمال) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (هل) interrogative particle in the sense of negation; (يجزون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ما) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «جزاء ما كانوا ...»; (كانوا) like the previous one «2»; (يعملون) like يتكبّرون «3».
The clause «الذين كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «حبطت أعمالهم» is in the position of the nominative: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of كذّبوا with (قد) implied, and the clause يجزون the khabar.].
The clause «هل يجزون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).].
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative: the khabar of كان.

* Morphology:
(يجزون): it has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original is يجزاون; the alif came quiescent before the quiescent wāw, and the alif was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is يفعون, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- The interrogative (istifhām):
It is seeking understanding by means of specific particles.
a- The interrogative has two particles: هل and the hamza. b- And it has nine nouns, which are:
«ما ومن وأي وكم وكيف وأنى ومتى وأين وأيّان».
c- All the interrogative nouns are for seeking a conception (taṣawwur).
d- «هل» is for seeking assent (taṣdīq) only.
e- The hamza is shared between conception and assent.

safi-cedvel:148-148.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اتّخذ) past verb; (قوم) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (موسى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility, and it is a diptote; (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اتّخذ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من حليّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عجلا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عجلا) first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (جسدا) naʿt (adjective) of (عجلا) meaning "embodied" (mujassad), accusative [Note: Or a badal (substitute) of (عجلا), accusative.. and the second object is omitted, its implied form being «إلها».]; (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (خوار) delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval; (لم) particle of negation, of conversion (qalb) and of the jussive; (يروا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the accusative, the noun (ism) of أنّ; (لا) particle of negation; (يكلّم) imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (الواو) conjunction; (لا يهديهم) like لا يكلّمهم; (سبيلا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه لا يكلّمهم) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يروا.. or of the single object.
(اتّخذوا) like the first, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being «إلها»; (الواو) conjunction; (كانوا ظالمين) like كانوا غافلين [Note: In verse (146) of this sūra.].
The clause «اتّخذ قوم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «له خوار» is in the position of the accusative: an adjective of (عجلا).
The clause «يروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يكلّمهم» is in the position of the nominative: the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «لا يهديهم ...» is in the position of the nominative: conjoined to the clause لا يكلّمهم.
The clause «اتّخذوه ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, to emphasise the first.
The clause «كانوا ظالمين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اتخذوه.

* Morphology:
(حليّهم): plural of حلي, with fatḥa on the ḥāʾ; and حلي — with fatḥa — may be a plural whose singular is حلية, like طبية [Translator's note: so in the source; probably ظبية is intended.].
(جسدا): originally a noun denoting a concrete thing, then used as an adjective meaning "embodied" (mujassad or mutajassid); its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(خوار): maṣdar (verbal noun) of خار يخور; since it denotes a sound, it has an approximate rule, namely its being on the pattern فعال, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
- al-Sāmirī and the calf:
Allah commanded Moses to purify himself and to fast for thirty days, then to come to Mount Sinai so that his Lord would speak to him and he would receive His command in a Book that would be their reference and return.
Moses' absence from his people grew long, until it reached forty days. The impulse of evil and corruption stirred in the soul of al-Sāmirī, so he seized the opportunity, gathered the ornaments from the Children of Israel, melted them over fire, and made from them a calf that lowed.
The Children of Israel were tempted by this calf and began to worship it. When Moses returned and saw his people and what they were doing, he almost struck out at his brother Aaron; and when his anger subsided, he took the calf, burned it, and threw its ashes into the water.
Then he called the Children of Israel to repent, and they repented and regretted, and began to punish themselves with humiliation and deprivation, until Allah accepted their repentance. And the Children of Israel boycotted al-Sāmirī; this was his recompense in his worldly life, and the recompense in the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting.

safi-cedvel:149-149.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna), carrying the meaning of a condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, attached to the apodosis قالوا; (سقط) past verb, passive; (في أيدي) preposition and its genitive noun, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (رأوا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أنّهم) like أنّه [Note: In the previous verse (148).]; (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (ضلّوا) like رأوا; (قالوا) like رأوا; (اللام) paving the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) conditional particle making jussive; (لم) particle of negation; (يرحمنا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ربّ) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يغفر) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يرحمنا), and (لنا) attached to (يغفر); (اللام) the lām of the oath; (نكوننّ) defective imperfect verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative.. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «نحن»; (من الخاسرين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of نكوننّ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «سقط في أيديهم» is in the position of the genitive: muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «رأوا ...» is in the position of the genitive: conjoined to the clause سقط ...
The clause «قد ضلّوا» is in the position of the nominative: the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إن لم يرحمنا ...» is in the position of the accusative: the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) [Note: If the omitted oath clause is taken as the speech reported, the conditional clause is a resumption within the scope of the speech.].
The clause «يغفر لنا» is in the position of the accusative: conjoined to the clause يرحمنا.
The clause «نكوننّ ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the oath ... and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم قد ضلوا ...) is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of رأوا.

* Rhetoric:
Kināya (metonymy): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ», i.e. they regretted what they had done with the utmost regret; that is a metonymy for it, because the regretful, grieving person bites his hand in distress, so that his hand becomes "fallen into" (masqūṭan fīhā). Al-Zajjāj said: its meaning is "regret fell into their souls", either by way of metonymic metaphor (istiʿāra bi-l-kināya) or by way of representative analogy (tamthīl).

safi-cedvel:94-96.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (أرسلنا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn. And (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil (agent); (في قرية) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا); (من) redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (نبيّ) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلّا) particle of restriction; (أخذنا) like أرسلنا; (أهل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بالبأساء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb أخذنا, as it is made to include the meaning of عاقبنا (We punished); (الواو) conjunction; (الضرّاء) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to البأساء, genitive; (لعلّ) particle of hope and of making accusative — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of laʿalla; (يضّرّعون) imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) .. and the wāw is fāʿil.
The clause: أرسلنا ... has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause: أخذنا ... is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with (قد) implied.
The clause: لعلّهم يضّرّعون has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause: يضّرّعون is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.
(ثمّ) conjunction; (بدّلنا) like أرسلنا; (مكان) second mafʿūl bihi, placed first «[Note: Or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in place of the evil" (بمكان السيّئة); that is because with the verb بدّل, when the bāʾ is attached to one of its two objects, that one is the second object, the one left aside.]», accusative; (السيّئة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الحسنة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "the place of the good"; (حتى) particle of limit and preposition; (عفوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped alif .. and the wāw is fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (قالوا) past verb and its fāʿil; (قد) particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (مسّ) past verb; (آباء) mafʿūl bihi, placed first, accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الضرّاء) fāʿil, nominative; (السرّاء) conjoined to الضرّاء by the wāw; (الفاء) conjunction; (أخذنا) like أرسلنا, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بغتة) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl of the agent of أخذناهم or of its object «[Note: It may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, by making أخذناهم include the meaning of بغتناهم (We took them by surprise).
Or it indicates the kind of the maṣdar, i.e. "We seized them with a seizing of surprise".]»; (الواو) circumstantial; (هم) a pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (لا) negating; (يشعرون) imperfect, nominative. And the wāw is fāʿil.
The clause: بدّلناهم ... is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أخذنا.
The clause: عفوا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن) .. and the interpreted maṣdar (أن عفوا) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (بدّلنا).
The clause: قالوا ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عفوا.
The clause: قد مسّ.. الضرّاء is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause: أخذناهم ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا, and between the two clauses is the link of effect and cause.
The clause: هم لا يشعرون is in the position of accusative as an emphasising ḥāl.
The clause: لا يشعرون is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
(الواو) conjunction; (لو) non-jussive conditional particle; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator; (أهل) noun of anna, accusative; (القرى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the implied kasra; (آمنوا) like قالوا; (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) like عفوا.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ أهل القرى..) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ثبت", i.e. "had the faith and piety of the people of the towns been established".
(اللام) occurring in the response of لو; (فتحنا) like أرسلنا; (على) preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (فتحنا), as it is made to include the meaning of صببنا (We poured); (بركات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (من السماء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of بركات; (الواو) conjunction; (الأرض) conjoined to السماء, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) particle of istidrāk (correction); (كذّبوا) like قالوا; (الفاء) — conjunctive, causal; (أخذنا) like the first, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) preposition, for causation; (ما) maṣdar particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أخذناهم) .. and the clause كانوا يكسبون has no grammatical position, being the ṣila, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.]»; (كانوا) incomplete past verb and its noun; (يكسبون) like يضرّعون.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يكسبون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أخذناهم), as it is made to include the meaning of عذّبناهم (We punished them).
The clause: (ثبت) إيمان ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أرسلنا من قرية.
The clause: آمنوا is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.
The clause: اتّقوا is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause: فتحنا has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the non-jussive condition.
The clause: كذّبوا ... is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause آمنوا..
The clause: أخذناهم is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كذّبوا.
The clause: كانوا يكسبون has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause: يكسبون is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(يضّرّعون): it contains the substitution of the tāʾ by ḍād because of the closeness of the points of articulation of the two letters, since its origin is يتضرّعون; when the tāʾ was changed to ḍād, the first ḍād was made quiescent to suit the assimilation (idghām); its pattern is يتفعّلون.
(بركات): plural of بركة, a noun from the quadriliteral بارك, meaning growth and increase; its pattern is فَعَلة, with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:97-100.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval; (أمن) past verb; (أهل) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (القرى) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (أن) maṣdar particle making accusative; (يأتي) imperfect, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بأس) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بياتا) adverb of time, accusative «[Note: Or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object, i.e. "heedless by night", and it may be a ḥāl of the agent, i.e. "concealed by night".]», attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأتي); (الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl; (هم) detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (نائمون) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause أمن أهل القرى has no grammatical position; resumptive ... or conjoined to the clause (ثبت) إيمان أهل القرى «[Note: In making the fāʾ conjunctive the parsers have gone different ways with various interpretations .. Some of them conjoined it to the clause أخذناهم بغتة, and made what lies between the conjoined and that to which it is conjoined a parenthesis — this is the view of al-Zamakhsharī, and Abū Ḥayyān followed him — and others went to supplying an omitted item, to which it is conjoined, between the hamza and the fāʾ ... All of them do that because the fāʾ, in their view, is conjunctive; these interpretations can be set aside by making the fāʾ resumptive, and the meaning does not reject that.]».
The clause: يأتيهم بأسنا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause: هم نائمون is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object pronoun in يأتيهم.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتيهم بأسنا) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being (من), attached to (أمن) .. or it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by أمن.
(أو أمن ... وهم) is parsed like its preceding counterpart, and the wāw after the interrogative is conjunctive; (يلعبون) imperfect, nominative .. and the wāw is fāʿil.
The clause: أمن أهل القرى.. has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمن أهل (the first).
The clause: يأتيهم بأسنا has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause: هم يلعبون is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object pronoun.
The clause: يلعبون is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتيهم بأسنا) is like the preceding interpreted maṣdar.
(الهمزة) like the first; (الفاء) conjunction; (أمنوا) past verb and its fāʿil; (مكر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) causal «[Note: Because what follows it is a reason for something implied, the implied sense of the speech being: "Do they feel secure from the plan of Allah .. they are deluded, because none feels secure from the plan of Allah except the losing people". Al-ʿUkbarī says: "The fāʾ is to draw attention to the fact that punishment follows feeling secure from the plan of Allah." End quote.]»; (لا) negating; (يأمن) imperfect, nominative; (مكر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إلا) particle of restriction; (القوم) fāʿil, nominative; (الخاسرون) naʿt (adjective) of القوم, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause: أمنوا ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمن أهل القرى..
The clause: لا يأمن.. إلا القوم has no grammatical position, being a reason for something implied.
