(الهمزة) like the first, and for rebuke; (الواو) conjunction; (لم) particle of negation, jussive and inversion (of tense); (يهد) imperfect, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; (اللام) preposition; (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (يهد), as it is made to include the meaning of "become clear and evident"; (يرثون) like يلعبون; (الأرض) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يرثون); (أهل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أن) lightened from the heavy form, and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لو) non-jussive conditional particle; (نشاء) imperfect, nominative, and the fāʿil is a pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; (أصبنا) past verb and its fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لو نشاء ...) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يهد «[Note: The fāʿil may be a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the Name of Majesty .. and the interpreted maṣdar becomes a mafʿūl bihi. It may also be a pronoun referring to what is understood from the context of the speech, i.e. "has not what happened to the former nations guided...", and the interpreted maṣdar is an object.]», i.e. "has it not become clear to the inheritors that We would strike them for their sins if We willed that?"
(بذنوب) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أصبنا), and the bāʾ is for causation, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (نطبع) like نشاء; (على) قلوب preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نطبع), and (هم) like the last; (الفاء) conjunction; (هم) detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (لا) negating; (يسمعون) like يلعبون.
The clause: لم يهد ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمنوا مكر الله.
The clause: يرثون ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause: نشاء is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the lightened أن.
The clause: أصبناهم has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause: نطبع ... has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: The (الواو) before the verb cannot be conjunctive, and consequently the clause cannot be conjoined to what precedes, namely the response of لو, i.e. the clause أصبناهم, because the response is within the scope of negation — the response is ruled out because the condition is ruled out — while (نطبع) is within the scope of affirmation, since what is intended is to affirm it. For this reason the (الواو) is resumptive and the clause after it is a fresh start.]».
The clause: هم لا يسمعون has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نطبع.
The clause: لا يسمعون is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Morphology:
(الضحى): with ḍamma and the short alif, a noun indicating the first rising of the sun; its pattern is فُعَل, with ḍamma then fatḥa, and the alif is converted from a wāw because it is taken from ضحا يضحو, i.e. "to be exposed to the sun". The alif is written in the form of yāʾ only because it is of the triliterals with ḍamma on the first letter, in which the scholars permitted writing it in two ways: the tall alif — الضحا — and the short alif, the undotted yāʾ — الضحى — like الربا and الربى, and العلا and العلى ...
(مكر): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb مكر يمكن, of the class of نصر [Translator's note: «يمكن» is evidently a misprint for يمكُر]; its pattern is فَعْل, with fatḥa then sukūn .. and the plan (makr) of Allah is figurative, its meaning being requiting a person for scheming.
(يهد): it contains weakening (iʿlāl) by deletion to suit the jussive; its origin is يهدي; its pattern is يفع.
(يرثون): it contains weakening by deletion, as it is a weak verb of the mithāl type (first radical weak); its fāʾ (first radical) was dropped in the imperfect because its ʿayn came with kasra; its pattern is يعلون.

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (نادى): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (أصحاب): fāʿil (agent), nominative. (الجنّة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (أصحاب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (النار): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (أن): explicative [Note: Or lightened from the heavy [أنّ], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), i.e. "that it is [the case that] we have found ...", and its khabar is the clause after it.]. (قد): a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (وجدنا): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) is the fāʿil. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (وعدنا): a past verb and its object. (ربّ): fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (حقّا): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: Or a ḥāl (circumstantial), if the verb is transitive to one object in the meaning of "we met".]. (الفاء): a conjunction. (هل): an interrogative particle. (وجدتم): like وجدنا. (ما وعد ربّكم حقّا): like ما وعدنا ربّنا حقا, and the first object is omitted, i.e. "He promised you" or "He promised us" ... (قالوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (نعم): a particle of answer. (الفاء): resumptive. (أذّن): a past verb. (مؤذّن): fāʿil, nominative. (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أذن) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مؤذّن.], and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أن): like the first [Note: Or lightened from the heavy [أنّ], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter, i.e. "that it is [the case that] the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers".]. (لعنة): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (على الظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «نادى أصحاب الجنّة ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قد وجدنا....»: has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «وعدنا ربّنا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «هل وجدتم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the explicative clause.
The clause «وعد ربّكم....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «قالوا....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) ... and the particle of answer stands in for the clause of the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. "yes, we have found that".
The clause «أذّن مؤذّن....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive, carrying a sense of giving the reason.
The clause «لعنة الله على الظالمين....»: has no grammatical position, explicative.

* Morphology:
(نادى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is نادي — with yāʾ at its end — the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif.
(مؤذّن): active participle of the quadriliteral أذّن; its pattern is مُفَعِّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they" (هم) [Note: Or in the position of genitive as naʿt (adjective) of الظالمين in the preceding āya (44) ... or in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "I mean" (أعني).]. (يصدّون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (عن سبيل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصدّون). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. (الواو): a conjunction. (يبغون): like يصدّون, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عوجا): a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "crooked" (معوجّة), accusative. (الواو): a conjunction — or circumstantial. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (بالآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كافرون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «(هم) الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يصدّون ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يبغونها ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هم.... كافرون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause ... or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate), and (هما) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (حجاب): a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الواو): a conjunction. (على الأعراف): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. (رجال): a delayed mubtadaʾ. (يعرفون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (كلّا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (بسيما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعرفون), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): a conjunction. (نادوا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (أصحاب): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الجنّة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (أن سلام): like أن لعنة [Note: In āya (44) of this sura ... and beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it indicates generality, so it carries the meaning of supplication.]. (على): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ سلام. (لم): a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion [to past meaning]. (يدخلوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): resumptive. (هم): a pronoun, mubtadaʾ. (يطمعون): like يعرفون.
The clause «بينهما حجاب ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «على الأعراف رجال»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يعرفون ...»: in the position of nominative, naʿt (adjective) of رجال.
The clause «نادوا ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يعرفون.
The clause «سلام عليكم»: has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «لم يدخلوها ...»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of نادوا; and there is no separation between the ḥāl and its owner, because the speech between them completes the content of the calling.
The clause «هم يطمعون»: has no [grammatical] position, resumptive.
The clause «يطمعون»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(حجاب): a primitive (jāmid) noun for that by which one is screened; its pattern is فِعال, with kasra on the fāʾ, and it has the form of a maṣdar.
(الأعراف): it is said to be the wall of Paradise, so it is a primitive noun; or a proper name for the screen separating Paradise and the Fire. Its pattern is أفعال.
(سيماهم): a primitive noun meaning "mark"; it came shortened (maqṣūr), its origin being the lengthened (mamdūd) سيماء. Its pattern is فِعلاء, with kasra on the fāʾ, and the yāʾ is converted from the wāw of سوماء: when the wāw came quiescent after a kasra it was converted into yāʾ.
(نادوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its origin is نادوا [Translator's note: so in the source; the intended origin is presumably ناداوا], the alif before the wāw of the plural was deleted because it came quiescent together with it, and the fatḥa remained on the dāl as an indication of the deleted alif. Its pattern is فاعوا, with fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): a conjunction. (إذا): an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis قالوا. (صرفت): a past verb, passive ... and the tāʾ is for the feminine. (أبصار): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (تلقاء): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (صرفت). (أصحاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (النار): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (قالوا): a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (ربّ): the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, with the vocative particle omitted, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لا): a prohibiting particle causing the jussive. (تجعل): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (مع): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the verb (تجعل). (القوم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الظالمين): like القوم, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «صرفت أبصارهم ...»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ربّنا لا تجعلنا ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لا تجعلنا ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.

* Morphology:
(تلقاء): the noun from اللقاء, used as an adverb; its pattern is تِفعال, with kasra on the tāʾ, and it is sometimes used as a maṣdar. It is said: no maṣdars came on the pattern تِفعال with kasra other than التلقاء and التبيان. It is lengthened (mamdūd).

safi-cedvel:48-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (نادى أصحاب الأعراف رجالا): like نادى أصحاب الجنة أصحاب [Note: In āya (44) of this sura.]. (يعرفونهم بسيماهم): like يعرفون كلّا بسيماهم [Note: In āya (46) of this sura.]. (قالوا): like the preceding [Note: In the preceding āya (47).]. (ما): a particle of negation. (أغنى): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (عن): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أغنى). (جمع): fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): a conjunction. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (كنتم): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (تستكبرون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كنتم تستكبرون) is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the explicit maṣdar جمعكم.
The clause «نادى أصحاب الأعراف ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعرفونهم ...»: in the position of accusative, naʿt (adjective) of (رجالا) ... or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of أصحاب الأعراف.
The clause «قالوا ...»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil أصحاب [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
The clause «ما أغنى ... جمعكم»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنتم تستكبرون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «تستكبرون»: in the position of accusative, the khabar (predicate) of كنتم.
(49) (الهمزة): for interrogation. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as khabar. (أقسمتم): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) is a pronoun, the fāʿil. (لا): a particle of negation. (ينال): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (برحمة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينال). (ادخلوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the letter nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الجنّة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (لا): a particle of negation, inoperative (muhmal) [Note: Or operating like laysa, (خوف) being its noun and (عليكم) its predicate.]. (خوف): mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: The mubtadaʾ came indefinite because it relies on a negation.]. (عليكم): like عنكم, attached to an omitted khabar. (الواو): a conjunction. (لا): redundant (zāʾida), for emphasising the negation. (أنتم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (تحزنون): like تستكبرون.
The clause «هؤلاء الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the preceding saying.
The clause «أقسمتم..»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا ينالهم الله ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the oath.
The clause «ادخلوا ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported of an implied saying, i.e. "Allah said to them: Enter Paradise ..." And the implied clause of saying is in the position of nominative, a second khabar of the demonstrative, i.e. "these are those to whom Allah said ..."
The clause «لا خوف عليكم»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil of ادخلوا.
The clause «أنتم تحزنون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the last ḥāl clause.
The clause «تحزنون»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

* Morphology:
(أغنى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is أغني: the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif. Its pattern is أفعل.
(جمعكم): a maṣdar established by usage (samāʿī) of the verb جمع يجمع, of the bāb fataḥa; its pattern is فَعْل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:10-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (اللام): the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of realisation. (مكنّا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مكّنا). (الواو): conjunction. (جعلنا): like مكّنا. (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to a second object governed by جعلنا. (في): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of معايش — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies — [Note: Or attached to (جعلنا) by its being made to imply the meaning of خلقنا (We created).]. (قليلا ما تشكرون): like قليلا ما تذكّرون [Note: In ayah (3) of this surah.].
The clause «مكنّاكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath, and the oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جعلنا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the oath.
The clause «تشكرون»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
(11) (الواو): conjunction. (لقد خلقناكم): like لقد مكنّاكم. (ثمّ): a conjunction. (صوّرناكم): like مكنّاكم. (ثمّ): like the first. (قلنا): like مكنّا. (للملائكة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قلنا). (اسجدوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (لآدم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اسجدوا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote. (الفاء): conjunction. (سجدوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إلّا): a particle of exception. (إبليس): excepted, accusative. (لم): a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive. (يكن): an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (من الساجدين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكن.
The clause «خلقناكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an implied oath ... and the oath clause has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first resumptive clause.
The clause «صورناكم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقناكم.
The clause «قلنا»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: So in the source; the clause that is the object of the saying is «اسجدوا لآدم», while «قلنا» is conjoined to the preceding clause.]
The clause «سجدوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قلنا.
The clause «لم يكن من الساجدين»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) to confirm the exception regarding Iblīs [Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of إبليس.].
(12) (قال): a past verb, and the verb is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Allah [Translator's note: "the verb" here is evidently a misprint for "the fāʿil".]. (ما): an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (منع): like قال, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle. (لا): redundant (zāʾida). (تسجد): an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and the fāʿil is "anta". إذ: an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (تسجد). (أمرت): a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الكاف) is mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تسجد) is in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi governed by منع [Note: Or in the position of genitive by an implied (من), attached to (منع).
(3, 4) Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the attached object pronoun in (خلق).].
(قال): like the first. (أنا): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (خير): khabar, nominative. (منه): like فيها, attached to خير. (خلقت): like أمرت, and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من نار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلقتني) «3». (الواو): conjunction. (خلقته): like خلقتني. (من طين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلقته) «4».
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ما منعك ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «منعك ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of (ما).
The clause «تسجد»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أمرتك»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «أنا خير منه»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «خلقتني من نار»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya) ... or an explanatory resumption.
The clause «خلقته من طين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خلقتني.
(13) (قال): like the first. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition. (اهبط): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta". (منها): like فيها, attached to (اهبط); the pronoun refers to the Garden or to the heavens. (الفاء): causal. (ما): negating. (يكون): a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, nominative, meaning ينبغي (it is fitting). (اللام): a preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (يكون). (أن تتكبر): like أن تسجد. (فيها): like the first, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil [Note: It may be attached to the verb (تتكبر).].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تتكبر) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يكون.
(الفاء): conjunction. (اخرج): like اهبط. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (من الصاغرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اهبط ...»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you have refused obedience, then descend ... and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis are in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «ما يكون ...»: has no grammatical position, causal.
The clause «تتكبّر»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «اخرج ...»: in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause اهبط to emphasise the apodosis.
The clause «إنّك من الصاغرين»: has no grammatical position, causal [Note: It is resumptive with a meaning of causation.].
(14) (قال): like the first. (أنظر): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is "anta", and (النون) is the nūn of protection, and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إلى يوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنظر). (يبعثون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); it refers to the creatures among the children of Adam, since the context of the speech indicates it.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنظرني ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «يبعثون»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(15) (قال): like the first. (إنّك من المنظرين): like إنّك من الصاغرين ...
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّك من المنظرين»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
(16) (قال): like the first. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition. (الباء): the bāʾ of oath [Note: Or it is causal, attached to (أقعدن).]. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (أغويت): a past verb and its fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أغويتني) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أقسم), i.e.: I swear by Your leading me astray, I will surely sit [Note: Allah's leading him astray is one of the effects of the power and might of Allah the Exalted, and one of the rulings of His sovereignty, so the outcome of the oath by both is the same ... (Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal ʿalā al-Jalālayn).
Further, the bāʾ may be causal, i.e.: because of Your leading me astray I will surely sit ... in which case the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أقعدنّ, and the implied form of the apodosis is: if You grant me respite, I will surely sit for them because of Your leading me astray.].
(اللام): the lām of oath. (أقعدن): an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative ... and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anā". (اللام): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (أقعدن) by its being made to imply the meaning of أتصدّى (I lie in wait). (صراط): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (أقعدن) [Note: Or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: on Your path.], and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (المستقيم): a naʿt (adjective) of صراط, genitive. [Translator's note: So in the source; صراط here is accusative, so its naʿt المستقيم is accusative.]
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «(أقسم), the implied»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being أنا, i.e.: then I swear ... and the nominal clause (أنا أقسم) is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if You grant me respite, then I swear by Your leading me astray ... and the conditional clause with its apodosis is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «أقعدن»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the oath.
(17) (ثمّ): a conjunction. (لآتينّهم): like لأقعدنّ and conjoined to it ... and (ثم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: (ثم) is evidently a misprint for (هم).]. (من بين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آتينّهم). (أيدي): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (من خلف): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آتيناهم) [Translator's note: so in the source, for (آتينّهم).], and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction in the three places. (عن أيمانهم، عن شمائلهم): like من خلفهم and conjoined to it. (لا): negating. (تجد): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta". (أكثر): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (شاكرين): a ḥāl, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ [Note: Or a second mafʿūl bihi ...].
The clause «آتينّهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the earlier oath.
The clause «لا تجد ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the oath [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption.].
(18) (قال): like the first. (اخرج): like اهبط. (من): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (اخرج). (مذءوما): a ḥāl, accusative, of the fāʿil of اخرج. (مدحورا): a second ḥāl, accusative. (اللام): preparatory to the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). (من): a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ [Note: It may be a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, with the (اللام) before it being the lām of the beginning (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and the omitted oath clause and its answer are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.]. (تبع): a past verb, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring to (من). (منهم): like منها, attached to a ḥāl of the latent pronoun in (تبعك). (اللام): the lām of oath. (أملأن): like أقعدنّ. (جهنّم): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (منكم): like منها, attached to (املأن). (أجمعين): a tawkīd (emphasis) of the attached pronoun in (منكم), following it in the genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ [Note: Emphasis with أجمعين is permissible without the word (كلّكم) preceding it.].
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اخرج منها»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «من تبعك ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تبعك ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «أملأن ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the oath ... and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

* Morphology:
(معايش): plural of معيشة, a noun for what a person earns and lives by; its pattern is مفعلة with ḍamma or kasra on the ʿayn, and fatḥa on it may be permissible. On this basis the word has iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by making vowelless, where the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the ʿayn, then the ḍamma was changed to kasra, or the kasra remained as it was. In al-Miṣbāḥ: عاش عيشا, of the bāb sāʾa, means he came to have life, so he is عائش and the feminine is عائشة, and عيّاش also, as an intensive. The pattern of معايش is مفاعل, so it is not written with hamza, because the yāʾ is original in the singular.
(الساجدين): plural of الساجد, an active participle of the triliteral سجد; its pattern is فاعل.
(الصاغرين): plural of الصاغر, an active participle of the triliteral صغر; its pattern is فاعل.
(المنظرين): plural of المنظر, a passive participle of the quadriliteral أنظر; it is on the pattern مفعل with ḍamma [on the mīm] and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(خلف): a noun for the direction; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أيمان): plural of يمين, a noun for the direction in which a person's right side is, or a noun for the side or the limb; its pattern is فعيل. It has other plurals: أيمن with fatḥa on the hamza and ḍamma on the mīm, أيامن with kasra on the mīm, and أيامين on the measure of أفاعيل.
(شمائل): plural of شمال, a noun for the opposite of the right; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ. There are other plurals: أشمل with fatḥa on the hamza and ḍamma on the mīm, شمل with two ḍammas, and شمال on the measure of the singular; and فعائل is the pattern of the plural شمائل.
(مذءوما): a passive participle of ذأم يذأم, meaning to find fault with and to detest, of the bāb fataḥa; its pattern is مفعول.
(مدحورا): a passive participle of دحر يدحر, of the bāb fataḥa, meaning to drive away and banish; its pattern is مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
Ayah «11» ..
- Kināya (metonymy): in the words of the Exalted «وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْناكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْناكُمْ». The speech is a kināya for the creation of Adam, upon him be peace, and the meaning is: We created your father Adam, upon him be peace, as unformed clay, then We formed him in the most wonderful form and the best stature.
Ayah «12» ..
- The device of tawahhum (false impression): in the words of the Exalted «ما مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ», for the apparent sense is: what prevented you from prostrating. The interpretation that resolves this speech is that the scholars said:
ما منعك, i.e.: what made you refrain from prostrating.
Ayah «17» ...
- The representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): in the words of the Exalted «ثُمَّ لَآتِيَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمانِهِمْ وَعَنْ شَمائِلِهِمْ», where the state of Iblīs's enticing and whispering to them is likened to the state of an enemy coming upon the one he is hostile to from whatever direction is possible for him; for this reason above and below were not mentioned, since there is no coming from them.

* Benefits:
1- A storm of disagreement arose over the word «معايش». We know that it is permissible to ease the hamza into the letter that suits the vowel of what precedes it, as بئر is eased to بير, فأس is eased to فاس, and لؤلؤ is eased to لولو; and the reverse is also true, for the yāʾ is changed to hamza in some of its cases, as عايش to عائش and عائشة to عائشة [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently عايشة to عائشة is meant]. Likewise the wāw, when it comes final, is changed to hamza, as in دعاء, كساء and سماء; all these hamzas were changed from wāw, because the origin is: كسا, سما and دعاو ...
2- The grammarians said of the conjunctive fāʾ: it conveys sequence, and the majority hold this. As for al-Farrāʾ, he opposed the majority and claimed that it does not convey sequence at all. Al-Jarmī made a distinction in that, saying: it does not convey sequence in conjoining places and cities to one another, and he cited as evidence the words of Imruʾ al-Qays «بين الدخول فحومل» (between al-Dakhūl and Ḥawmal).
3- His words «فَبِما أَغْوَيْتَنِي».
The bāʾ here is causal, and it is a preposition. This particle has thirteen meanings:
Sībawayh said: the original meaning of the bāʾ is adhesion (ilṣāq), and it does not leave it in any of its meanings; for this reason he limited himself to it. Adhesion is of two kinds, literal and figurative:
The first is like أمسكت بيدك (I took hold of your hand), and the second like مررت بدارك (I passed by your house). The remaining twelve categories are:
1- seeking help (istiʿāna) 2- causation (sababiyya) 3- making transitive (taʿdiya) 4- oath (qasam) 5- compensation (ʿiwaḍ) 6- substitution (badal) 7- location (ẓarfiyya) 8- accompaniment (muṣāḥaba) 9- the partitive من 10- the meaning of عن 11- superiority (istiʿlāʾ) 12- emphasis, which is the redundant one.
Were it not for the length, we would have given an example for each category; so return to it in the books of grammar.
4- The words of the Exalted: «لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِراطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ»: الصراط should properly have been put in the genitive with على, because the verb قعد is made transitive with this particle, and the grammarians have discussion about the accusative of its like.
Sībawayh said: it is accusative as an adverb (ẓarfiyya) ..!
Abū Ḥayyān preferred its being accusative by removal of the preposition.
The Arabs have much speech that came according to the rule of removing the preposition and its permissibility, but it is heard (samāʿī) and not taken as a basis for analogy, so one does not say «جلست الخشبة» (I sat the plank). Al-Zajjāj said: the soundest of all that is that we make the verb of sitting imply another meaning, such as «ألزم» (I keep to), so that it becomes transitive by itself and الصراط becomes a mafʿūl bihi.
I say: and what do we do with the countless examples, all of which we parse as the dropping of the preposition?
So choose — may Allah guide you to what is right — and be of those who make things easy, not of those who make things hard.

safi-cedvel:50-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (نادى أصحاب ... الجنّة أن): like نادى أصحاب.. النار أن [Note: In āya (44) of this sura.].
(أفيضوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (على): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أفيضوا). (من الماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أفيضوا). (أو): a conjunction. (من): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أفيضوا). (رزق): a past verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (قالوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (حرّم): a past verb, and (هما) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (على الكافرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حرّمهما), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «نادى أصحاب ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أفيضوا ...»: has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «رزقكم الله»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إنّ الله حرّمهما ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «حرّمهما ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of inna.
(51) (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, naʿt (adjective) of الكافرين [Note: Or in the position of nominative, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "hum" ... and the nominal clause is an explanatory resumption ... It is also permissible that it be in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "aʿnī" (I mean) or "adhummu" (I censure).]. (اتّخذوا): like قالوا. (دين): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (لهوا): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunctive. (لعبا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (لهوا), accusative like it. (الواو): conjunctive. (غرّت): a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الحياة): fāʿil, nominative. (الدنيا): naʿt of الحياة, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الفاء): resumptive. (اليوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (ننساهم), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the alif ... and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu", for majesty. (الكاف): a preposition of comparison [Note: Or it is for causation (taʿlīl).]. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (نسوا): like اتّخذوا and قالوا. (لقاء): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (يوم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, naʿt of يوم [Note: Or a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما نسوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) ...
(الواو): conjunctive. (ما): like the first. (كانوا): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the noun of kāna. (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجحدون), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يجحدون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «اتّخذوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «غرّتهم الحياة ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «ننساهم»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «نسوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first particle relative (ما).
The clause «كانوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle relative (ما).
The clause «يجحدون»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.

* Benefits:
1- Mushākala (verbal correspondence): it is that a word is used in keeping with another word even if it differs from it in its meaning and import. The Glorified used the word "forgetting" and attributed it to Himself by way of mushākala and of treating in kind the disbelievers who made themselves forget the Day of Resurrection and Recompense — and far be it from Allah that He be described with forgetfulness and failure to remember, He Whom neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes.

safi-cedvel:184-185.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for rhetorical-denial interrogation (istifhām inkārī); (الواو) conjunctive; (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]; (يتفكّروا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما) a negative particle [Note: Some allowed it to be interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), with the preposition phrase (بصاحبهم) attached to the khabar (predicate), and (من جنّة) a ḥāl (circumstantial).], (بصاحب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (جنّة) genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; (إن) a negative particle; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (نذير) khabar, nominative; (مبين) naʿt (adjective) of نذير, nominative.
The clause «يتفكروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumptive clause.
The clause «ما بصاحبهم من جنّة» is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of reflecting, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the negation.. It is also said that it is bound by the preposition: one says تفكّر بالشيء (he reflected on the thing).
The clause «إن هو إلّا نذير» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
(أو لم ينظروا) like أو لم يتفكّروا; (في ملكوت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينظروا); (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive, conjoined to ملكوت; (خلق) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, nominative; (من شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, tamyīz (specification) of (ما) [Note: Or a ḥāl of the omitted resumptive pronoun.], (الواو) conjunctive; (أن) lightened from the heavy [أنّ], its ism being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (عسى) a complete past verb; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle of the accusative; (يكون) an incomplete imperfect verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – accusative (manṣūb), its ism being the omitted pronoun of the matter [Note: Or it is أجلهم, and the fāʿil of اقترب is a pronoun referring to أجلهم, by way of tanāzuʿ (two governors contending for one word).], (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (اقترب) past verb; (أجل) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن عسى ...), from the lightened أن with its ism and khabar, is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to ملكوت, i.e. «in that it may be that its being has drawn near ...».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون ...) is in the position of the nominative as fāʿil of عسى.
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (الباء) a preposition; (أيّ) an interrogative noun, genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يؤمنون); (حديث) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يؤمنون), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «after its message» or «its revelation»; (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, referring to the Qur'an or to the Messenger; (يؤمنون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «لم ينظروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لم يتفكّروا.
The clause «خلق الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «عسى أن يكون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the lightened (أن) [Note: The clause occurs as a khabar although it is a non-requestive performative (inshāʾ ghayr ṭalabī). Abū Ḥayyān holds that this is like the saying of Allah the Exalted: وَالْخامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْها [al-Nūr – 9] in the reading with a lightened (أن) followed by a verb ... so the clause غضب is a supplication, a non-requestive performative, and its occurring as a khabar was permitted by the occurrence of the lightened (أن).].
The clause «يكون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «اقترب أجلهم» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of يكون.
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هم يؤمنون» ... and the nominal clause has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if they do not believe in what would admit them to Paradise – or in this discourse – then in what discourse will they believe?

* Morphology:
(جنّة): a maṣdar (verbal noun) of جنّ – in the passive – or it is the noun derived from it; its pattern is فعلة with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- The grammarians took care to detail the meanings of «الباء», which is a preposition, and they mentioned thirteen meanings for it. Their details have already passed in what came before in this book, so go back and recall them, for in repetition there is benefit ... !

safi-cedvel:186-186.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يضلل) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), given a kasra because of the meeting of two sukūns; (الله) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (هادي) ism of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of lā; (الواو) a resumptive particle; (يذر) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is «he», i.e. Allah; (في طغيان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يعمهون, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يعمهون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يضلل الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا هادي له» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يذرهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعمهون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of (يذرهم) [Note: Or a second mafʿūl bihi if (نذرهم) is taken as one of the verbs of transformation, i.e. We make them wanderers blindly in their transgression.].

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (اللام): the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath. (جئنا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بكتاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جئناهم). (فصّلناه): like جئناهم. (على علم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ — i.e. "containing knowledge" — or of the fāʿil, i.e. "while We are knowing". (هدى): a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "possessing guidance", and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied on the alif. (الواو): conjunctive. (رحمة): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to هدى, accusative. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدى ورحمة), or to a naʿt (adjective) of them. (يؤمنون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جئناهم ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to an implied oath [Note: And the implied oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.].
The clause «فصّلناه ...»: in the position of genitive, naʿt of كتاب.
The clause «يؤمنون»: in the position of genitive, naʿt of قوم.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(هل): a particle of interrogation in the sense of negation. (ينظرون): like يؤمنون [Note: In the preceding āya (52).]. (إلّا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (تأويل): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقول). (يأتي): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ. (تأويل): fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (الهاء) is like the first. (يقول): like يأتي. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, fāʿil. (نسوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) is mafʿūl bihi. (من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (نسوه). (قد): a particle of verification (taḥqīq). (جاءت): a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (رسل): fāʿil, nominative. (ربّ): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of رسل, i.e. "supported by the truth". (الفاء): connecting (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied conditional. (هل): like the first, without negation. (اللام): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). (من): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (شفعاء): genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (الفاء): the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya). (يشفعوا): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (أن) after the fāʾ. (لنا): like the first, attached to (يشفعوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يشفعوا.) is conjoined to شفعاء, and the implied form is: "Are there for us intercessors, and so intercession for us?"
(أو): a conjunction. (نردّ): an imperfect verb, passive, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "naḥnu", and in the speech there is an implied interrogation, i.e. "Will we be returned?" (فنعمل): like فيشفعوا. (غير): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (كنّا): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (نعمل): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعمل ...) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech ... and the implied form is: "Is there a returning for us, and so another doing?" ...
(قد): a particle of verification. (خسروا): like نسوا. (أنفس): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunctive. (ضلّ): like جاء. (عن): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ضلّ) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "baʿuda" (to be far). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, fāʿil [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle ... and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of nominative, fāʿil.], and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted. (كانوا): a defective past verb and its noun. (يفترون): like ينظرون.
The clause «هل ينظرون ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يأتي تأويله»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يقول ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «نسوه»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «جاءت رسل ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هل لنا من شفعاء»: in the position of jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of an implied conditional, i.e. "If we have gone astray, then are there for us any ..."
The clause «يشفعوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «نردّ ...»: conjoined to the clause هل لنا من شفعاء.
The clause «نعمل ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «كنّا نعمل»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «نعمل ...»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of كنّا.
The clause «قد خسروا أنفسهم»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ضلّ عنهم ما ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause خسروا, which has no grammatical position. And the clause «كانوا....»: [Translator's note: the source reads «لها صلة», evidently with «لا محلّ» dropped, i.e. "has no grammatical position".] the ṣila of the relative (ما), whether nominal or particle.
The clause «يفترون»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:150-150.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (لمّا): like the previous one [Note: In the previous ayah (149).]. [Translator's note: The head (رجع) is missing in the source at this point; what follows refers to it.] A past verb. (موسى): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; it is prevented from nunation. (إلى قوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رجع), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (غضبان): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), prevented from nunation because of its being an adjective and the addition of alif and nūn. (أسفا): a second ḥāl, accusative. (قال): a past verb. (بئس): a past, inflexible (jāmid) verb for expressing blame, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya". (ما): an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of the fāʿil pronoun — i.e. the succession (al-khilāfa) — and the one specifically blamed (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "خلافتكم" (your succession). (خلفتم): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn ... and (تم) is a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), being the lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the vowel of the mīm, and (النون) is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلفتموني), and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). (عجلتم): like خلفتم. (أمر): mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: Or accusative by removal of the preposition, the original being: أعجلتم عن أمر ربّكم.]. (ربّ): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (ألقى): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (الألواح): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (أخذ): like رجع, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (برأس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذ) by its being made to imply the meaning of مسك (to hold). (أخي): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يجرّ): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: So in the source; this preceding phrase repeats the parsing of (أخي) under the head (يجرّ) and is evidently a printing duplication.] (يجرّ): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (إلى): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (يجرّ). (قال): like the first. (ابن أمّ): the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable on a ḍamma implied on its end, its appearance being prevented by the vowel of original indeclinability, which is the fatḥa of the two parts, because it is a compound resembling خمسة عشر; in the position of accusative. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (القوم): the noun of إنّ, accusative. (استضعفوا): like قالوا [Note: In the previous ayah (149).], and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunction. (كادوا): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator — and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of كاد. (يقتلون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn .. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the second (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (الفاء): conjunction, linking the effect to the cause. (لا): prohibitive, putting the verb in the jussive. (تشمت): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta". (الباء): a preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (تشمت). (الأعداء): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا تجعل): like لا تشمت, and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (مع): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تجعل). (القوم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الظالمين): a naʿt (adjective) of القوم, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «رجع موسى ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «بئسما ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «خلفتموني»: in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (ما), and the referential pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.
The clause «عجلتم ...»: has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «ألقى ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أخذ ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ألقى.
The clause «يجرّه ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of أخذ or of رأس.
The clause «قال (the second)»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ابن أمّ ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying [Note: Or parenthetical, and the object of the saying is the clause انّ القوم استضعفوني.].
The clause «انّ القوم ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «استضعفوني»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «كادوا ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause استضعفوني.
The clause «يقتلونني»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كادوا.
The clause «لا نشمت ...» [Translator's note: so in the source, for لا تشمت]: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «لا تجعلني ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تشمت.

* Morphology:
(غضبان): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb غضب يغضب, of the bāb faraḥa; its pattern is فعلان, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أسفا): an assimilated adjective from the verb أسف يأسف, of the bāb faraḥa; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then kasra.

* Benefits:
1- ابن أمّ: there are two views on the i'rab of these two words:
a- The preponderant view is that they are two nouns indeclinable on fatḥa, because they are compounded in the manner of the numbers, like: خمسة عشر and صباح مساء. On this view their vowel is a vowel of indeclinability.
b- The view of the Kufans is that ابن is in construct with أمّ, and أمّ is in construct with the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ was changed into an alif, then the alif was dropped and the fatḥa sufficed in its place. On this basis the vowel of ابن is a vowel of declension, and it is in construct with أمّ, and أمّ is in the position of genitive by the construct. On both views the vocative particle is omitted. Only the mother is mentioned because mentioning her is more moving to the heart; so reflect on the wisdom of Allah in His noble Book..!

safi-cedvel:151-151.t:
* I'rab:
(قال): a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa", i.e. Mūsā. (ربّ): the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on what precedes the yāʾ of the first person, which is omitted for lightness, and the omitted (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (اغفر): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is "anta". (اللام): a preposition, and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اغفر). (الواو): conjunction. (لأخ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اغفر), the sign of the genitive being an implied kasra on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (أدخل): like اغفر, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (في رحمة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أدخل), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (أنت): a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative. (أرحم): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (الراحمين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ربّ» of the vocative: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اغفر ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أدخلنا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أنت أرحم ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

safi-cedvel:152-152.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (اتّخذوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (العجل): first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the second object is omitted, its implied form being "إلها" (a god) [Note: If (اتّخذوا) is made to imply the meaning of عبدوا (they worshipped), then العجل is a mafʿūl bihi and nothing else.]. (السين): a particle of the future. (ينال): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (غضب): fāʿil, nominative. (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينال) [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of غضب.], and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (ذلّة): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to غضب, nominative. (في الحياة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (ذلّة) [Note: Or attached to each of غضب and ذلّة.]. (الدنيا): a naʿt of الحياة, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (الكاف): a preposition. (ذلك): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is نجزي ... and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (نجزي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu", for majesty. (المفترين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اتّخذوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «سينالهم غضب ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «نجزي ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause — or resumptive.

* Morphology:
(المفترين): plural of المفتري, an active participle of the five-letter verb افترى; in it the yāʾ, the lām of the word, is dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters.

safi-cedvel:153-153.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (الذين عملوا السيّئات): like الذين اتّخذوا العجل «1», and the sign of the accusative in the object is the kasra, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject). (ثم): a conjunction. (تابوا): like اتخذوا. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تابوا), and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (آمنوا): like اتّخذوا «2». (إنّ): like the previous one «3». (ربّ): the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من بعدها): like the first, attached to (غفور), which is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative (marfūʿ). (رحيم): a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «الذين عملوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ الذين اتّخذوا «4».
The clause «عملوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «تابوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «آمنوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تابوا.
The clause «إنّ ربك ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of الذين, and the linking element (rābiṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "غفور لهم رحيم بهم" (forgiving to them, merciful to them).
[Translator's note: The footnote markers «1»–«4» appear in the source without their footnote texts.]

safi-cedvel:154-154.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (لمّا سكت): like لمّا رجع [Note: In ayah (150) of this surah.]. (عن موسى): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سكت), the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, as it is a diptote. (الغضب): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (أخذ): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa". (الألواح): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (في نسخة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (هدى): a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif. (الواو): conjunction. (رحمة): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to هدى, nominative like it. (اللام): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to each of هدى and رحمة [Note: Or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة.]. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (اللام): redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening (li-l-taqwiya) [Note: Or it is original, coming for causation, and the object of يرهبون is omitted, its implied form being "يرهبون عقابه" (they fear His punishment), and the preposition with its noun is attached to (يرهبون); it may also be made to imply the meaning of يذعنون (they submit).]. (ربّ): genitive in form, accusative in position, a fronted mafʿūl bihi whose governor is يرهبون, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يرهبون): an imperfect verb, nominative .. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «سكت ... الغضب»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أخذ ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «في نسختها هدى»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «هم ... يرهبون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يرهبون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

* Morphology:
(نسخة): a primitive (jāmid) noun meaning the tablets, because they were copied from the Preserved Tablet as a second copy of it ... or it is a derived noun meaning the copied, i.e. what is written in them; so it is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn, in the sense of مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (istiʿāra): in the words of the Exalted «وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَنْ مُوسَى الْغَضَبُ». In the speech there is an implicit metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya), where anger is likened to a person who forbids and commands, and silence is ascribed to it by way of imaginative attribution (takhyīl). Al-Sakkākī said: in it there is a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya), where the subsiding of anger and the going of its sharpness is likened to the silence of the one who commands and forbids, and anger is its contextual indicator (qarīna). It is also said: anger is a metaphor by allusion (istiʿāra bi-l-kināya) for the speaking person, and the silence is an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya) for the calming of its agitation and boiling, so in the speech there is an implicit metaphor whose indicator is explicit, not imaginative. Whichever it is, in the speech there is hyperbole and eloquence whose lofty rank is not hidden.

safi-cedvel:187-187.t:
* I'rab:
(يسألون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عن الساعة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يسألونك; (أيّان) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (مرسى) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «you» (أنت); (إنما) a restraining [mā] and the restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (علم) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (ها) like the last; (عند) an adverb, accusative, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) a negative particle; (يجلّي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (لوقت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجلّيها), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (ثقلت) past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is «it» (هي); (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ثقلت), (الواو) conjunctive; (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, genitive; (لا تأتي) like لا يجلّي, and the fāʿil is «it» (هي), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إلّا) like the first; (بغتة) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of the ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because the meaning of تأتيكم is تبغتكم (it comes upon you suddenly).] (يسألونك) like the first; (كأنّ) a particle resembling the verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as ism of كأنّ; (حفيّ) khabar, nominative; (عن) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (حفيّ), since it is a derived word; (قل إنما علمها عند الله) like the first; (الواو) conjunctive; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk) – an abrogator –; (أكثر) ism of لكنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (لا) a negative particle; (يعلمون) imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يسألونك ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أيّان مرساها» is in the position of the genitive as badal (substitute) of الساعة [Note: Abū Ḥayyān said: «... and the badal is with the intention of repeating the governor ... And since the verb is suspended by the interrogative – and it is transitive with (عن) – the clause came to be in the position of the accusative by the dropping of the preposition, so it is a badal in the clause on the position of (عن الساعة), because the position of the genitive phrase is the accusative.» End quote.... Abū al-Baqāʾ makes it in the position of the genitive ... and this accords with grammatical craft, and on that basis it has been parsed above.].
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «علمها عند ربّي» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of saying).
The clause «لا يجلّيها.. إلّا هو» is in the position of the accusative as badal of the clause علمها عند ربّي.
The clause «ثقلت ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا تأتيكم إلّا بغتة» has no grammatical position: resumptive, affirming the content of what precedes it.
The clause «يسألونك ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كأنّك حفيّ عنها» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl of the object pronoun in (يسألونك).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption emphasising the preceding clause.
The clause «علمها عند الله» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «لكنّ أكثر ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause [Note: It may be resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of لكنّ.

* Morphology:
(مرساها): a mīmī maṣdar from the quadriliteral verb أرسى; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(وقتها): an adverb of time; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(حفيّ): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb حفي يحفي, of the pattern فرح; its pattern is فعيل, the extra yāʾ being assimilated into the final radical of the word. فعيل here has the meaning of فاعل, and it may have the meaning of مفعول, i.e. مخفيّ, on the pattern of مرميّ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Repetition (al-takrīr): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَسْئَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْها». In this kind of repetition there is a subtle point found only in the Mighty Book, which is too lofty to be shared. It is that what is customary in repetitions of this kind is that when speech is built on a purpose, and something incidental intervenes in its course, and it is then wished to return to complete the first purpose after it has become distant, the first purpose is refreshed by mentioning it, so that its end connects with its beginning. Examples of this have preceded in the Mighty Book, and more will come. This is one of them: for when He began the speech with His saying «يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْساها», then the mention of the answer contained in His saying «قُلْ إِنَّما عِلْمُها عِنْدَ رَبِّي» up to His saying «بَغْتَةً» intervened, it was wished to complete their question about it with a kind of reproach against them, which is what is contained in His saying «كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْها», and this is closely tied to the question. Since it had become distant, its mention was refreshed in a general way; and we never see it refreshed except with a kind of summary, like a reminder of the first, dispensing with its detail because of what preceded. Hence it was said (يسألونك) without mentioning what is asked about, namely the Hour, sufficing with what preceded. And when the question was repeated for this benefit, the answer was also repeated in summary, so He said: «قُلْ إِنَّما عِلْمُها عِنْدَ اللَّهِ». This is to be observed in the summing up of speech after its elaboration.
2- Simile (al-tashbīh): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَسْئَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْها», i.e. they ask you, likening your state in their eyes to the state of one who is حفي about it, i.e. thorough in knowledge of it.

* Benefits:
- أيّان: it may be an interrogative noun, and it may be a conditional noun. Whether it is this or that, the verifying scholars have differed about its origin. It was said that it is derived from «أي» on the pattern «فعلان»; others said its origin is a compound of «أي and آن», «أي» having the meaning of condition and «آن» having the meaning of «time» (الحين); after compounding it became a single noun bearing the meaning of condition and specific to future time. It is indeclinable on the fatḥa. Often the redundant «ما» is attached to it, giving it the sense of emphasis, as in the poet's saying:
إذا النعجة الأدماء باتت بقفرة ... فأيّان ما تعدل به الريح تنزل
(When the tawny wild cow spends the night in a wasteland ... then wherever the wind turns her, there she alights.)

safi-cedvel:188-188.t:
* I'rab:
(قل) like the previous; (لا) a negative particle; (أملك) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is «I» (أنا); (لنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb أملك – or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (نفعا) –, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (نفعا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (ضرّا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (نفعا), accusative; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of the accusative, the clause after it being its naʿt (adjective).] in the position of the accusative as excepted, in a connected or disconnected exception; (شاء) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (كنت) an incomplete past verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (التاء) a pronoun, ism of kāna; (أعلم) like أملك; (الغيب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لو; (استكثرت) past verb and its fāʿil; (من الخير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استكثرت), (الواو) conjunctive; (ما) a negative particle; (مسّني) past verb.. and (نون) of protection (al-wiqāya), and (ياء) of the speaker is mafʿūl bihi; (السوء) fāʿil, nominative; (إنّ) a negative particle [Translator's note: the source writes it with a shadda (إنّ); as a negative particle it is إن.]; (أنا) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (نذير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (بشير) maʿṭūf to نذير, nominative; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بشير; (يؤمنون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا أملك ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of saying).
The clause «شاء الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «كنت أعلم ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لا أملك.
The clause «أعلم ...» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كنت.
The clause «استكثرت ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ما مسّني السوء» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «إن أنا إلّا نذير» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of قوم.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (ربّ): the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (كم): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
