(الله): the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (الذي): a relative, in the position of nominative, naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. (خلق): a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "huwa". (السموات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (الواو): conjunctive. (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات, accusative like it. (في ستّة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلق). (أيّام): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (ثمّ): a conjunction. (استوى): like خلق, and the fatḥa is implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (على العرش): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استوى). (يغشي): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Allah. (الليل): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (النهار): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (يطلب): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. the night [Note: When each of the two nouns is fit to be fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi, the one that is the fāʿil in meaning must be placed before the one that is the mafʿūl in meaning, to avoid ambiguity.]. (حثيثا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), being its adjective, i.e. "a swift seeking" [Note: It is permissible that it be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يطلب, i.e. "urging", or of its object, i.e. "urged on".]. (الواو): conjunctive in the three places. (الشمس، القمر، النجوم): conjoined to السموات, accusative. (مسخّرات): a ḥāl of the three words, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (بأمر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مسخّرات, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ألا): a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and alerting (tanbīh). (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar. (الخلق): a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (الواو): conjunctive. (الأمر): conjoined to الخلق, nominative like it. (تبارك): like خلق [Note: Some make it a non-inflecting (jāmid) verb, so no imperfect or imperative comes from it.]. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (ربّ): naʿt of the Name of Majesty, nominative. (العالمين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ ربّكم الله»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «خلق....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «استوى ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يغشي....»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the fāʿil of خلق [Note: It is permissible that the clause be resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «يطلبه»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of الليل or of النهار.
The clause «له الخلق»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تبارك الله ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(استوى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution (qalb): the alif is changed from a yāʾ, because it — i.e. the yāʾ — came voweled after a fatḥa.
(العرش): a non-derived (jāmid) noun meaning, linguistically, the king's throne; and it has come in the exegesis that it is the luminous body raised above all bodies, encompassing them all.
(حثيثا): a derived adjective among the intensive forms (ṣiyagh al-mubālagha), from حثّ يحثّ, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; its wazn is فعيل.
(مسخّرات): plural of مسخّرة, the feminine of مسخّر ... (see āya 164 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(الخلق): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning people; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- ﴿يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهارَ﴾: the occurrence of the ghayn with the shīn as the first and second radicals (fāʾ and ʿayn) of a verb almost always conveys a similar or closely related meaning, whose gist is covering and concealing; and this belongs to the philology (fiqh al-lugha) of the language and its subtle secrets.

safi-cedvel:19-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (يا): a vocative particle. (آدم): the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (اسكن): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (أنت): a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun that is the fāʿil of اسكن. (الواو): a conjunction. (زوج): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the latent pronoun that is the fāʿil of اسكن, nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: See further explanation and commentary at āya (35) of Sūrat al-Baqara ...], and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الجنّة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): a conjunction. (كلا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الألف) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (من): a preposition. (حيث): a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلا); and there is an omission in the speech, i.e. «كلا منها- أي من ثمارها- حيث شئتما» ("eat of it — i.e. of its fruits — wherever you two wish"). (شئتما): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (التاء) is a pronoun, fāʿil, and (ما) is a supporting particle (ḥarf ʿimād) for the dual ... (الواو): a conjunction. (لا): prohibitive, causing the jussive. (تقربا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and (الألف) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه): a demonstrative noun, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (الشجرة): badal (substitute) from the demonstrative noun — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — accusative. (الفاء): the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya). (تكونا): a defective — abrogating (nāsikh) — imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ, and (الالف) is a pronoun in the position of nominative as the ism (subject) of تكون. (من الظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of تكون.
The clause «النداء وصلتها....» (the vocative and what follows it): has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اسكن ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «كلا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause that is the reply to the vocative.
The clause «شئتما....»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا تقربا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كلا.
The clause «تكونا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) أن.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكونا....) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: «لا يكن منكما قرب فحصول الظلم منكما» ("let there be no approach from you two, and so the occurrence of wrongdoing from you two") [Note: See āya (35) of Sūrat al-Baqara.].
(20) (الفاء): a conjunction. (وسوس): a past verb. (اللام): a preposition, and (هما) is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (وسوس). (الشيطان): fāʿil, nominative. (اللام): the lām of consequence (lām al-ʿāqiba) [Note: Or of cause and consequence.]. (يبدي): an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (لهما): like the first, attached to (يبدي). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (ووري): a past verb in the passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), and it is the referent (ʿāʾid). (عنهما): like لهما, attached to (ووري). (من سوءات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent pronoun, and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبدي ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (وسوس).
(الواو): a conjunction. (قال): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (ما): a negative particle. (نهى): a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كما) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (ربّ): fāʿil, nominative, and (كما) is muḍāf ilayhi. (عن): a preposition. (هذه الشجرة): like the first, in the position of genitive, attached to (نهى). (إلّا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (أن): a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (تكونا): like the first. (ملكين): the khabar of تكون, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ. (أو): a conjunction. (تكونا من الخالدين): like تكونا من الظالمين, and the verb is conjoined to the first.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكونا....) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. «خشية أن تكونا ...» ("for fear that you two become ...").
The clause «وسوس.... الشيطان»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the preceding resumptive clause.
The clause «يبدي ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-relative أن.
The clause «ووري....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «قال....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause وسوس.
The clause «ما نهاكما ربّكما»: in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). The clause «تكونا ملكين»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «تكونا من الخالدين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تكونا ملكين.
(21) (الواو): a conjunction. (قاسم): a past verb, and (هما) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he" (هو). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the ism of inna. (اللام): a preposition, and (كما) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to الناصحين. (اللام): it is the lām linking to the oath. (من الناصحين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of inna, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قاسمهما ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قال....
The clause «إنّي ... من الناصحين»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).
(22) (الفاء): a conjunction. (دلّاهما): like قاسمهما. (بغرور): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl from the object pronoun [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil, i.e. «دلّاهما مغرورا» ("he lowered them, being deluded") ... and the implied form from the object is: «دلّاهما مغرورين به» ("he lowered them, the two being deluded by it").]. (الفاء): resumptive. (لمّا): an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna), containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (بدت). (ذاقا): a past verb ... and (الألف) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (الشجرة): mafʿūl bihi with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. «ثمر الشجرة» ("the fruit of the tree"), accusative. (بدت): a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters (iltiqāʾ al-sākinayn). And (التاء) is for the feminine. (لهما): like the first, attached to (بدت). (سوءات): fāʿil, nominative, and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): a conjunction. (طفقا): a defective past verb of commencement (shurūʿ), and (الألف) is a pronoun, the ism of طفق. (يخصفان): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn. And (الألف) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (على): a preposition, and (هما) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يخصفان) by extension (tajāwuzan), through its being made to include (taḍmīn) the sense of «يردان» or «يهيلان» ("they pile/heap") the leaves of the Garden upon themselves. (من ورق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the implied mafʿūl bihi, i.e. «يخصفان عليهما شيئا حاصلا من ورق الجنّة» ("they patch upon themselves something made of the leaves of the Garden"). (الجنّة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): a conjunction. (ناداهما): like دلّاهما. (ربّ): fāʿil, nominative, and (هما) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الهمزة): for interrogation. (لم): a particle of negation, conversion (qalb) and the jussive. (أنه): an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and (كما) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عن): a preposition. (تلكما): a demonstrative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أنه); and (اللام) is for distance, and (كما) is the particle of address for the dual. (الشجرة): badal from the demonstrative noun — or ʿaṭf bayān — genitive. (الواو): a conjunction. (أقل): like أنه, and conjoined to it. (اللام): a preposition, and (كما) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أقل). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — abrogating. (الشيطان): the ism of inna, accusative. (لكما): like the previous one, attached to عدو ... (عدو): the khabar of inna, nominative. (مبين): naʿt of عدو, nominative.
The clause «دلّاهما....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the preceding resumptive clause.
The clause «ذاقا ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «بدت.... سواءتها»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «طفقا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause بدت ...
سوءاتهما.
The clause «يخصفان....»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of طفقا.
The clause «ناداهما ربهما»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause بدت ...
The clause «أنهكما....»: has no grammatical position, explicative (tafsīr) of the call [Note: Or in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl of an implied saying, i.e.: «ناداهما قائلا ألم أنهكما ...» ("He called them, saying: Did I not forbid you two ...").].
The clause «أقل»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنهكما.
The clause «إنّ الشيطان.»: in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.

* Morphology:
(ووري): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution (qalb) to suit the passive form; its origin is وارى. When its first letter took ḍamma, the alif after it was changed to wāw to suit the ḍamma, and when the letter before its last was given kasra, the second alif was changed to yāʾ to suit the kasra.
(الناصحين): plural of الناصح, an active participle from the triliteral نصح; its pattern is فاعل.
(دلّى): it contains iʿlāl by substitution; its origin is دلّي: the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif. Its pattern is فعّل.

* Rhetoric:
Āya «20» ..
- The secret of repeating letters within a single word:
Its definition: whenever letters are repeated within a single word, that signals a repetition of the action; and the transfer of a verb from one pattern to another was not resorted to by the coiner of the language originally except for this hidden secret. The word here is «وسوس», and it is a living embodiment and an eloquent depiction of Iblīs's persistence in leading astray, and his exerting himself to bring them to the point where their feet slip and they tumble into the slippery places of evil; so he whispers to them time after time.
Of the same kind is their saying خشن and اخشوشن: خشن does not convey what the word اخشوشن conveys, because of the repetition of letters in it.

* Benefits:
1- His saying «فوسوس» is one of the kinds of eloquence spread throughout the Arabic language, arising from "the repetition of letters in a single verb".
It is a living depiction of Iblīs's persistence in pursuing seduction; and similar to it is your saying «اخشوشن واعشوشب», for it is as though the Arabs, when they saw an abundance of grass, said اعشوشب; and thus the repetition of letters serves to strengthen the meaning and multiply the content of the word..
2- «طفق» is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), which operate like kāna and its sisters, with some detail.
The khabar of these verbs is "a clause", and its coming as a single word is anomalous (shādhdh), as in the saying of Taʾabbaṭa Sharran:
فأبت إلى فهم وما كنت آيبا ... وكم مثلها فارقت وهي تصغر
(So I returned to Fahm, and I was hardly about to return; how many a one like it have I left while it whistled [in vain].)
These verbs are divided into three groups: the first: those that indicate the nearness of the khabar's occurrence, and they are three: كاد، كرب and أوشك.
The second: those that indicate hope for the khabar, and they are three: عسى، جرى and اخلولق.
[Translator's note: «جرى» here is as printed; the verb of hope usually listed with عسى and اخلولق is «حرى».]
The third: those that indicate commencement in it, and their number is large — it may reach twenty or more — among them «أنشأ وطفق، وجعل، وعلق وهلهل وقام وابتدأ». Were it not for lengthiness, we would have pursued the discussion and the detail.

safi-cedvel:23-23.t:
* I'rab:
(قالا): like ذاقا [Translator's note: the source has a stray closing quotation mark here.], (ربّ): the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, from which the vocative particle has been omitted, accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ظلمنا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil (agent). (أنفس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative ... (نا): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): a conjunction. (إن): a jussive-governing conditional particle, and the lām that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam) has been omitted before it. (لم): a particle of negation only [Note: The clearer view is that the verb after it is made jussive by the conditional particle, not by it, despite its strength in governing the jussive, so that the verb remains purely for the future.]. (تغفر): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). (اللام): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تغفر). (الواو): a conjunction. (ترحم): like تغفر, and conjoined to it, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (اللام): the lām of the oath. (نكوننّ): a defective — abrogating (nāsikh) — imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative ... and (النون) is for emphasis, and its ism (subject) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن). (من الخاسرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of نكوننّ.
The clause «قالا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ربّنا...... وجوابها» (with its reply): in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying) [Note: The clause may be parenthetical, for seeking mercy, and the clause ظلمنا in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.].
The clause «ظلمنا..»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «تغفر لنا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the reply to the vocative [Note: It may be conjoined to the clause of maqūl al-qawl, in the position of accusative.].
The clause «ترحمنا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the reply to the vocative [Note: It may be conjoined to the clause تغفر لنا, taking its grammatical position in both cases.].
The clause «نكوننّ ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the implied oath..
The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the reply to the oath.

safi-cedvel:24-24.t:
* I'rab:
(قال): like the previous one [Note: In āya (20) of this sura.]. (اهبطوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (بعض): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (لبعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عدوّ ... which is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو): a conjunction — or resumptive. (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from مستقرّ — a naʿt (adjective) placed before what it qualifies. (مستقر): a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو): a conjunction. (متاع): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مستقرّ, nominative. (إلى حين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of متاع.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «اهبطوا ...»: in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «بعضكم لبعض عدوّ»: in the position of accusative as ḥāl.
The clause «لكم.. مستقرّ»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.. or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(قال): like the previous one. (في): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تحيون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الواو): a conjunction in both places. (فيها تموتون): like فيها تحيون. (منها): like فيها, attached to (تخرجون), which is an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تحيون»: in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying).
The clause «تموتون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تحيون.
The clause «تخرجون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تحيون.

* Morphology:
(تحيون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is تحياون. Two quiescent letters met, the alif and the wāw of the plural; the alif was deleted and the letter before the wāw was given fatḥa — or remained with fatḥa — as an indication of it. Its pattern is تفعون.

safi-cedvel:101-103.t:
* I'rab:
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) indicates distance and (الكاف) is for address. (القرى) a badal (substitute) for تلك, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) [Note: It may be the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; this is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān in al-Nahr al-Mādd min al-Baḥr. He said: «And القرى is the khabar, and نقصّ is a ḥāl clause, like His saying, Exalted is He, فتلك بيوتهم خاوية بما ظلموا» — and in making القرى the predicate there is a sense of magnifying them and those who destroyed them, as has been said about His saying ذلك الكتاب, and about his saying (peace be upon him) أولئك الملأ من قريش; and since the predicate is restricted by the ḥāl, the restriction gave the meaning of the adjective» — end of quote.]. (نقصّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is نحن, used for majesty. (على) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نقصّ). (من أنباء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نقصّ); and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath. (جاءت) a past verb.. and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (رسل) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (بالبيّنات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاءتهم). (الفاء) a conjunction. (ما) a particle of negation. (كانوا) a defective past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd). (يؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يؤمنوا); the returning pronoun is omitted [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle which, together with what follows, is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive, and the bāʾ is causal, i.e. they were not going to believe because of their having denied before.]. (كذّبوا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (من) a preposition. (قبل) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (كذّبوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يؤمنوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of كانوا, i.e.: they were not qualified, or prepared, for belief.
(الكاف) a preposition [Note: Or a noun meaning «like» (مثل), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description.], (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is يطبع; (واللام) for distance and (كاف) for address. (يطبع) an imperfect verb, nominative. (الله) the Word of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (على قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يطبع). (الكافرين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause: تلك القرى نقصّ.. is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: نقصّ ... is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ تلك [Note: Or a second khabar, with القرى being the first khabar; or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with القرى being the khabar.].
And the clause: جاءتهم رسلهم ... has no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath..
And the implied oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: ما كانوا ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer-of-the-oath clause.
And the clause: يؤمنوا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: كذّبوا ... has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما), whether nominal or particle.
And the clause: يطبع الله ... has no grammatical position, resumptive or parenthetical.
(الواو) a conjunction. (ما) a particle of negation. (وجدنا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (لأكثر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from عهد [Note: This is if the verb (وجد) is transitive to one object.. and it is the second object if it is transitive to two.], and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (عهد) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi, its governor being وجد. (للواو) a conjunction [Translator's note: the source writes «للواو» here, evidently for «الواو».]. (إن) lightened from the heavy (inna), inoperative [Note: إن lightened (from inna), when it is directly followed by a verb, must be made inoperative; but al-ʿUkbarī and al-Zamakhsharī made it operative: its noun, according to al-ʿUkbarī, is the first-person pronoun, and according to al-Zamakhsharī, the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).]. (وجدنا) like the first one. (أكثر) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) like the last one. (اللام) it is the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa). (فاسقين) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
And the clause: وجدنا لأكثرهم ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يطبع..
or to the clause ما كانوا ليؤمنوا.
And the clause: إن وجدنا ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما وجدنا.
(ثمّ) a conjunction. (بعثنا) like وجدنا. (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بعثنا) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl from (موسى), i.e. as a messenger after them.], and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (موسى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif. (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بعثنا), and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى فرعون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بعثنا); the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa because it is a diptote, for being a proper name and foreign. (الواو) a conjunction. (ملأ) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to فرعون, genitive, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) a conjunction. (ظلموا) like كذّبوا. (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ظلموا), by its being made to carry the meaning of كفروا [Note: The bāʾ is causal and the object is omitted, i.e. they wronged themselves, or the people, that is, by turning away from belief because of these signs.]. (الفاء) resumptive. (انظر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar of kāna. (عاقبة) the noun of kāna, nominative. (المفسدين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
And the clause: بعثنا ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause وجدنا.
And the clause: ظلموا ... has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause بعثنا.
And the clause: انظر.. has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: كان عاقبة ... is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative كيف.

* Rhetoric:
Putting the overt noun in place of the pronoun: in His saying, Exalted is He, «كَذلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلى قُلُوبِ الْكافِرِينَ» «i.e. their hearts) — the overt noun was put in place of the pronoun to indicate that the sealing is because of disbelief; and the Majestic Name is made overt by way of iltifāt (shift of person) to instil awe and inspire dread.

* Benefits:
- The differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa) is the lām with fatḥa that comes at the beginning of the khabar of «إن» lightened from the heavy (inna); its purpose is to distinguish between the lightened «إن» and the negating إن.
And this «إن», when followed by a (verb), must be made inoperative; and if followed by a «noun», it is mostly inoperative and less often operative, as in إن خالدا لمجتهد..!

safi-cedvel:104-104.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قال) a past verb. (موسى) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif. (يا) a vocative particle. (فرعون) the one addressed (munādā), singular «على» [Translator's note: the source reads «مفرد على», evidently a slip for «مفرد علم», a singular proper name.], indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of inna. (رسول) khabar (predicate), nominative. (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رسول). (العالمين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause: قال موسى ... is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: يا فرعون is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: إنّي رسول ... has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.

* Benefits:
فرعون: a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); what prevents it is two causes, namely: being a proper name and being foreign. Every noun that is a diptote must contain two causes that prevent it from full declension, except for the two patterns of the ultimate plural (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ) «مفاعل ومفاعيل» and the extended feminine alif.
The discussion has a continuation which we will resume in another place.

safi-cedvel:105-105.t:
* I'rab:
(حقيق) a second khabar (predicate) of the particle resembling the verb, إنّ [Note: in the previous ayah; or it is a naʿt (adjective) of رسول in the previous ayah.. or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being أنا, and the clause is resumptive.], (على) a preposition. (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (لا) a negating particle. (أقول) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنا. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقول), by its being made to carry the meaning of «claim» (ادّعي). (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (الحق) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لا أقول..) is in the position of genitive by (على), attached to (حقيق) in the sense of «eager» (حريص) [Note: Some grammarians make the preposition (على) mean the bāʾ — and so came the reading of Ubayy — and on this view حقيق is made to carry the meaning of «worthy» (جدير).].
(قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (جئت) a past verb with its fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (ببيّنة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جئتكم). (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of بيّنة [Note: Or attached to (جئتكم), and (من) is for the beginning of the extent.], and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition. (أرسل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is أنت. (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (أرسل), and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بني) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, for it is treated like the sound masculine plural. (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is prevented from nunation for being a proper name and foreign.
The clause: أقول ... is a clause with no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: قد جئتكم is in the position of nominative as a third khabar of the particle resembling the verb, انّ [Note: Or a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ أنا.].
And the clause: أرسل.. is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a condition, i.e. an implied one, i.e. «if you are a believer in what I say, then send».

* Morphology:
(حقيق): a derived adjective on the pattern فعيل, in the sense of an active participle (fāʿil) or a passive participle (mafʿūl); predominantly it is in the sense of the active participle, because it comes meaning «obligated», «eager» and «worthy».

safi-cedvel:106-106.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is هو. (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle. (كنت) a defective past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء) the noun of kāna. (جئت) a past verb with its fāʿil. (بآية) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جئت). (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (ائت) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ائت). (إن كنت) like the first. (من الصادقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause: «قال ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: (كنت جئت) is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «جئت بآية» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنت.
And the clause: «ائت بها» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition.
And the clause: «كنت من الصادقين» has no grammatical position, a resumption to emphasise what preceded..
And the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: فأت بها.

safi-cedvel:107-108.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction. (ألقى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (عصا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa on the alif, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الفاء) a conjunction linking the effect to the cause [Note: This fāʾ is a necessary redundant (zāʾida) one according to al-Fārisī, al-Māzinī and a group.. and some make it purely causal without conjunction.], (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya) [Note: According to the well-known view it is a particle that comes merely for linking.. according to some it is an adverb of place, and according to others an adverb of time.], (هي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ثعبان) khabar (predicate), nominative. (مبين) naʿt (adjective) of ثعبان, nominative.
And the clause: «ألقى ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قال [Note: in the previous ayah (106).].
And the clause: «هي ثعبان» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ألقى.
(الواو) a conjunction. (نزع) a past verb, and the fāʿil is هو. (يد) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (فاذا هي بيضاء) like فإذا هي ثعبان. (للناظرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بيضاء), in the sense of «wondrous».
And the clause: «نزع يده» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ألقى عصاه.
And the clause: «هي بيضاء» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نزع ...

* Morphology:
(ثعبان): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the male of snakes, or the huge, massive one; its pattern is فعلان with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(بيضاء): the feminine of أبيض, an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha); its pattern is فعلاء, pluralised on فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, i.e. بيض.

safi-cedvel:109-110.t:
* I'rab:
(قال الملأ) a past verb and its nominative fāʿil (agent). (من قوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الملأ. (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for being a proper name and foreign. (إن) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. (اللام) conveys emphasis. (ساحر) khabar (predicate), nominative. (عليم) naʿt (adjective) of ساحر, nominative.
The clause: «قال الملأ ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّ هذا لساحر» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
(يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو. (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (يخرج) an imperfect verb, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is هو. (من أرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخرج), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) resumptive — or a conjunction — [Note: If the speech that follows it is the speech of the chiefs, it is for conjunction; and if it is the speech of Pharaoh — which is the apparent meaning — it is for resumption, i.e. so he said: ماذا تأمرون; and what indicates that is their saying after that: قالوا أرجه ...], (ما) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative. (ذا) a relative noun in the position of nominative, khabar. (تأمرون) — with fatḥa on the nūn — an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرجكم) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
And the clause: «يريد ... » is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of «إنّ» [Note: Or it is a ḥāl from ساحر, because it is a description.. or it is a second naʿt of ساحر.. or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).].
And the clause: «ماذا ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb of saying..
And the implied clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position [Note: It is permissible for the clause ماذا ... to be conjoined to the clause يريد أن يخرجكم. Moreover, it is permissible for (ماذا) to be a single word, an interrogative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi of the imperative verb, the first object being the implied first-person pronoun.].
And the clause: «تأمرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e. ماذا تأمروننيه [Note: If the word (ماذا) is parsed without splitting, then the clause تأمرون is conjoined to the clause يريد, or it is the maqūl al-qawl of the omitted verb of saying.].

safi-cedvel:111-112.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (أرجه) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn appearing on the hamza that was dropped for lightening; its origin is أرجئ [Note: Or indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, if the verb is weak (muʿtall), as the lexicons indicate.].. and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (الواو) a conjunction. (أخا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the attached third-person pronoun, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the alif, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) a conjunction. (أرسل) like أرجئ. (في المدائن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسل), by its being made to carry the meaning of «spread out» (انشر). (حاشرين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative — and it is the naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. رجالا حاشرين —.
The clause: «قالوا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «أرجه ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «أرسل ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أرجه.
(يأتوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأتوك). (ساحر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (عليم) naʿt of ساحر, genitive like it.
And the clause: «يأتوك ... » has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, not joined with the fāʾ, i.e.: إن ترسل.. يأتوك.

* Morphology:
(المدائن): plural of المدينة, a noun on the pattern فعيلة in which the yāʾ is extra in the singular; therefore it was changed into a hamza in the plural. It is from مدن يمدن بالمكان, «to reside in a place», of the نصر class; and the pattern of المدائن is فعائل.
(حاشرين): plural of حاشر, an active participle from the triliteral حشر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:55-56.t:
* I'rab:
(ادعوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (ربّ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (تضرّعا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil pronoun [Note: It is permissible that it be a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar because it expresses its kind, i.e. "the supplication of humility and secrecy".]. (الواو): conjunctive. (خفية): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (تضرّعا), accusative. (إنه): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun. (لا): a particle of negation. (يحبّ): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "huwa". (المعتدين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «ادعوا....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنه لا يحبّ ...»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya) and resumptive.
The clause «لا يحبّ ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of inna.
(56) (الواو): conjunctive. (لا): the lā of prohibition, making jussive (jāzima). (تفسدوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تفسدوا). (بعد): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تفسدوا). (إصلاح): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunctive. (ادعوه خوفا وطمعا): like ادعوا ربّكم تضرّعا وخفية. (إنّ): like the first. (رحمة): the noun of inna, accusative. (الله): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (قريب): the khabar of inna, nominative. (من المحسنين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قريب.
The clause «لا تفسدوا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ادعوا.
The clause «ادعوه....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تفسدوا.
The clause «إنّ رحمة الله قريب»: has no grammatical position, causal and resumptive.

* Morphology:
(طمعا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb طمع يطمع, of the pattern (bāb) فرح; its wazn is فعل, with two fatḥas. There are other maṣdars, namely طماع with fatḥa on the ṭāʾ, and طماعية with fatḥa and an unstressed (non-doubled) yāʾ.
(قريب): see āya (186) of Sūrat al-Baqara ... The word has come masculine because "mercy" means "reward", so the adjective refers back to the meaning.

* Benefits:
1- The linguists and grammarians differed greatly about the masculine form of the word «قريب» although it is an adjective of الرحمة, which is feminine. Perhaps the view of al-Farrāʾ is closest to the truth, for he said: If قريب means distance, it is treated as masculine and feminine; and if it means kinship, it is feminine without any disagreement among them. So one says: «دارك منا قريب» or «قريبة» (your house is near us), and «فلانة منا قريبة» (so-and-so [fem.] is our relative). Allah the Exalted said:
﴿لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيباً﴾ ....!

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunctive — or resumptive. (هو): a detached pronoun, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (الذي): a relative noun, in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate). (يرسل): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" — i.e. Allah. (الرياح): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (بشرا): a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الرياح, accusative. (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بشرا). (يدي): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ. (رحمة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (حتى): a particle of inception (ibtidāʾ). (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the meaning of the conditional, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) سقناه. (أقلت): a past verb.... and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "hiya", i.e. the winds. (سحابا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ثقالا): naʿt (adjective) of (سحابا), accusative [Note: (ثقالا) came plural in consideration of the meaning of سحاب, which is a generic collective noun (ism jamʿ jinsī).]. (سقنا): a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi [Note: The pronoun came singular masculine in consideration of the wording of سحاب.]. (لبلد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (سقناه). (ميت): naʿt of بلد, genitive. (الفاء): conjunctive. (أنزلنا): like سقنا. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنزلنا). (الماء): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء): conjunctive. (أخرجنا به): like أنزلنا به, and the bāʾ is causal (li-l-sababiyya) in each of them. (من كل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخرجنا). (الثمرات): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الكاف): a preposition of comparison. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose operator is نخرج, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (نخرج): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", for majesty. (الموتى): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (لعل): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of laʿalla. (تذكرون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «هو الذي....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ ربكم [Note: In āya (54) of this sura, and what lies between them is a kind of parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ) ... It is permissible that the clause be resumptive.] ....
The clause «يرسل....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «أقلّت ...»: in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «سقناه....»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive conditional.
The clause «أنزلنا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «أخرجنا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «نخرج الموتى»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لعلكم تذكرون»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya) or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تذكرون»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(بشرا): plural of بشور, a derived adjective, an intensive form of the active participle; its wazn is فعول with fatḥa on the fāʾ — or plural of بشير. And بشر, with ḍamma on the bāʾ and sukūn on the shīn, is lightened from بشر with two ḍammas.
(ثقالا): plural of ثقيل, and ثقال [is read] with fatḥa or ḍamma on the thāʾ, from ثقل يثقل, of the pattern (bāb) نصر, and it is an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) [Translator's note: the source attaches "it is a ṣifa mushabbaha" here, apparently referring to ثقيل.]; the wazn of ثقال is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn ... There is another plural of ثقيل, namely ثقلاء with ḍamma on the thāʾ, and ثقل with two ḍammas.

* Rhetoric:
1- The representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the saying of the Exalted ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّياحَ بُشْراً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ حَتَّى إِذا أَقَلَّتْ سَحاباً ثِقالًا سُقْناهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَنْزَلْنا بِهِ الْماءَ فَأَخْرَجْنا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَراتِ كَذلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتى لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾.
That is: just as We revived the earth after its death by sending down water upon it and bringing forth plants and fruits from it, We shall bring forth the dead from the earth and resurrect them alive on the Last Day.
The point of similarity between bringing out the dead and bringing out plants is that the standing of the two is the same, and whoever is able to do one of them is able to do the other, as reason requires.
2- The non-metaphoric trope (al-majāz al-mursal): in the saying of the Exalted ﴿بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ﴾, i.e. in front of His mercy; this is figurative, and what is meant by mercy is rain. It was called mercy because of the benefits that, in the ordinary course of things, result from it. The relation is causality, because the hand is the cause of bestowing favour, and bestowing favour is mercy.
3- The explicit simile (al-tashbīh al-mursal): in the saying of the Exalted ﴿كَذلِكَ نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتى﴾, i.e. like that bringing forth — which is the bringing forth of fruits — ﴿نُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتى لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾. It is called mursal because the particle of comparison is mentioned.

safi-cedvel:58-58.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (البلد): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (الطيّب): naʿt (adjective) of البلد, nominative like it. (يخرج): an imperfect verb, nominative. (نبات): fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (بإذن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of نبات [Note: Or attached to (يخرج), if the bāʾ is causal.]. (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (الهاء) is like the first. (الواو): conjunctive. (الذي): a relative, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (خبث): a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa" — and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid). (لا): a negating particle. (يخرج): like the first, and the fāʿil pronoun refers back to the plants. (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (نكدا): a ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb) [Note: Or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar — being its adjective — i.e. "a meagre coming forth".]. (كذلك نصرف الآيات): like كذلك نخرج الموتى [Note: In the preceding āya (57).]. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نصرّف). (يشكرون): like تذكرون [Note: In the preceding āya (57).].
The clause «البلد ... يخرج»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يخرج نباته ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «الذي خبث....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «خبث....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «لا يخرج....»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذي).
The clause «نصرّف ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يشكرون»: in the position of genitive, naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(نكدا): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb نكد ينكد, of the pattern (bāb) فرح; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:189-190.t:
* I'rab:
(هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); (خلق) past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is «he», a latent (mustatir) pronoun; (من نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خلقكم), (واحدة) naʿt (adjective) of نفس, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunctive; (جعل) like خلق; (من) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (جعل), by its being made to include the meaning of خلق; (زوج) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl); (يسكن) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the fāʿil is «he»; (إليها) like منها, attached to (يسكن), by its being made to include the meaning of يأوي (to take refuge).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يسكن) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (جعل).
(الفاء) conjunctive; (لمّا) an adverb meaning «when» (حين), containing the meaning of condition, in the position of the accusative, attached to the apodosis حملت; (تغشّى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is «he», and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (حملت) past verb.. and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «she» (هي); (حملا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative [Note: Or a mafʿūl bihi in the sense of the carried foetus.], (خفيفا) naʿt, accusative; (الفاء) conjunctive; (مرّت) like حملت; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (مرّت), (الفاء) conjunctive; (لمّا) like the first; (أثقلت) like حملت; (دعوا) past verb ... and (الألف) a pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ربّ) badal (substitute) of the Name of Majesty or its naʿt, accusative, and (هما) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) paving the way for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (آتيت) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ...
and (التاء) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (نا) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (صالحا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: It is an adjective standing for an omitted qualified noun, i.e. «a righteous child» or «a well-formed human».], (اللام) the lām of the oath; (نكوننّ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative ... and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis, and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «we» (نحن); (من الشاكرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of نكوننّ.
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلقكم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يسكن ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «تغشّاها ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «حملت ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «مرّت به» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «أثقلت ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «دعوا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of the (second) condition.
The clause «إن آتيتنا ...» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or an explanation of the supplication..
The omitted oath clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of دعوا, i.e. they called upon Allah swearing: لئن.
The clause «نكوننّ من الشاكرين» has no grammatical position: the answer of the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer of the oath.
(الفاء) conjunctive; (لمّا آتاهما) like لمّا تغشّاها; (صالحا) like the first; (جعلا) past verb.. and (الألف) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted second object of the verb جعلا ...; (شركاء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, denied nunation because it is attached to the feminine ending in the extended alif of the feminine, on the pattern فعلاء; (في) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to شركاء; (آتاهما) like the first. (الفاء) resumptive; (تعالى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (عن) a preposition; (ما) like the first, and the preposition phrase is attached to (تعالى), (يشركون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «آتاهما ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «جعلا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «آتاهما (the second)» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «تعالى الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, a supplication.
The clause «يشركون» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).

* Morphology:
(حملا): a maṣdar (verbal noun) of يحمل, of the pattern ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. The verb has another maṣdar, حملان with ḍamma on the ḥāʾ; and (حملا) may be a noun for what the female carries in her womb.
(خفيفا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb خفّ يخفّ, of the pattern ضرب; its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
Metonymy (al-kināya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاها», the speech is a metonymy for intercourse, i.e. when he had lain with her. The covering (التغشي) is attributed to the male, and in it there is an allusion that the multiplication of the species is the cause of companionship, just as solitude is the cause of loneliness.

* Benefits:
- لمّا: a conditional particle set up to indicate the existence of something because of the existence of something else. Its discussion has passed with us in detail, so refer to it in its places.

safi-cedvel:191-193.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation (istifhām tawbīkhī); (يشركون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, the clause after it being its naʿt (adjective).], indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لا) negative; (يخلق) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «it» (هو), and it is the resumptive pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يخلقون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «يشركون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يخلق ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هم يخلقون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of يخلق [Note: It refers to (ما), which denotes the idols, and they were expressed with the pronoun used for rational beings because of the rationality that, by their claim that they are gods, would necessarily belong to them; and likewise the matter in the following verse.].
The clause «يخلقون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(الواو) conjunctive; (لا) negative; (يستطيعون) like يشركون; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of (نصرا), which is mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ولا) like the first; (أنفس) a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ينصرون) like يشركون.
The clause «لا يستطيعون ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يخلقون.
The clause «ينصرون» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يخلقون or the clause لا يستطيعون.
(الواو) conjunctive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تدعوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إلى الهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تدعوهم), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (لا) negative; (يتّبعوا) imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (سواء) a fronted khabar, nominative; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to سواء; (الهمزة) a maṣdar-forming particle of equivalence (taswiya); (دعوتم) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الواو) is an extra letter (zāʾid), lengthening the vowel of the mīm before it, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أدعوتموهم) is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
(أم) a conjunction counterbalancing the hamza; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ; (صامتون) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «تدعوهم ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يخلقون.
The clause «لا يتّبعوكم» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سواء عليكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, affirming the content of what precedes it.
The clause «دعوتموهم» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).
The clause «أنتم صامتون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle-relative [Note: This nominal clause has the force of a verbal clause, with the implied form أم صمتّم; and the implied form of the conjunction is:
سواء عليكم دعاؤكم أم صمتكم (your calling and your silence are the same to you).].

* Morphology:
(صامتون): plural of صامت, the active participle of the triliteral صمت; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
1- The saying of Allah the Exalted: أَيُشْرِكُونَ ما لا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئاً وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ؟ The hamza is for disapproval. This meaning was the course of debate between the atheist philosophers and the theologians. The latter argued for the existence of Allah the Exalted by saying: science and scientists have not been able, up to today, to know the reality of a fly, let alone to create one..!

safi-cedvel:194-194.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) –; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as ism of inna; (تدعون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) – and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted resumptive pronoun, i.e. you call upon them as distinct from Allah; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (عباد) khabar of inna, nominative; (أمثال) naʿt (adjective) of عباد, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause [Note: Or it connects the apodosis of a condition implied from the content of the coming condition, i.e. if you are truthful in what you claim ... then call upon them], (ادعوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء) conjunctive; (اللام) the lām of command; (يستجيبوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يستجيبوا), (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun, ism of kāna; (صادقين) khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الذين تدعون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تدعون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ادعوهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause, to link the effect with the cause.
The clause «يستجيبوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ادعوهم.
The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position: resumptive ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: if you are truthful about their divinity, then call upon them.

safi-cedvel:155-157.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (اختار): a past verb. (موسى): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif. (قوم): accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. من قوم (from the people), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (سبعين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ [Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī permitted parsing it as a badal (substitute) of قوم, weakly, with قوم being the first object; as for the second object, it is implied, and in implying it there is strain, just as there is strain in supplying the linking pronoun for the badal.]. (رجلا): tamyīz (specification), accusative. (لميقات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اختار), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): conjunction. (لمّا): an adverb meaning حين (when), containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis قال. (أخذت): a past verb .. and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الرجفة): fāʿil, nominative. (قال): like اختار. (ربّ): the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied fatḥa on the yāʾ that is omitted for lightness, and the omitted (الباء) is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently (الياء) is meant, and the implied fatḥa is on what precedes the yāʾ.]. (لو): a particle of impossibility for impossibility (imtināʿ li-mtināʿ), a non-jussive conditional particle. (شئت): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn .. and (الياء) is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently (التاء) is meant.]. (أهلكت): like شئت, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (أهلكتهم). (الواو): conjunction. (إيّاي): a detached pronoun in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the attached third-person pronoun. (الهمزة): for interrogation, carrying a sense of pleading (istiʿṭāf). (تهلك): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta", and (نا) is mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: It may be a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the referential pronoun omitted and the clause after it its ṣila (relative clause), i.e. بالذي فعله السفهاء (for what the foolish did).]. (فعل): like اختار. (السفهاء): fāʿil, nominative. (من): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of السفهاء. The interpreted maṣdar (ما فعل السفهاء) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تهلكنا). (إن): a particle of negation [Translator's note: the source has «نقي», a misprint for «نفي» (negation).]. (هي): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (فتنة): khabar (predicate), nominative, and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (تضلّ): like تلك [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently «like تهلك» is meant.]. (الباء): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (تضلّ). (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (تشاء): like تهلك. (الواو): conjunction. (تهدي من تشاء): like تضلّ من تشاء. (أنت): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (وليّ): khabar, nominative, (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition. (اغفر): an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is "anta". (لنا): like منّا, attached to (أغفر). (الواو): conjunction. (أرحم): like أغفر, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunction. (أنت خير): like أنت وليّ. (الغافرين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «أخذتهم الرجفة»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the non-jussive condition (لمّا).
The vocative clause with its answer: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لو شئت ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أهلكتهم ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the non-jussive condition (لو).
The clause «تهلكنا ...»: has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «فعل السفهاء»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «هي ... فتنتك»: has no grammatical position, resumptive, to confirm the meaning of destruction.
The clause «تضلّ ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the second-person pronoun.
The clause «تضلّ ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative (من). [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently the clause «تشاء» (the first) is meant.]
The clause «تهدي ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تضلّ.
The clause «تشاء (the second)»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «أنت وليّنا»: has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «اغفر ...»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. إن أذنبنا فاغفر لنا (if we have sinned, then forgive us).
The clause «ارحمنا»: conjoined to the clause اغفر لنا.
The clause «أنت خير ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنت وليّنا.
(الواو): conjunction. (اكتب): like اغفر. (لنا): like منّا, attached to (اكتب). (في): a preposition. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (اكتب) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the genitive pronoun in لنا, or a ḥāl of حسنة — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies.]. (الدنيا): a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied kasra on the alif. (حسنة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. في (الآخرة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb explained by the mentioned one, اكتب. (حسنة): mafʿūl bihi whose governor is the omitted verb, accusative. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (هدنا): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (إلى): a preposition, and (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (هدنا). (قال): like the first. (عذاب): mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on what precedes the yāʾ, and (الياء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أصيب): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anā". (به): like بها, attached to (أصيب). (من): like the first. (أشاء): like أصيب, and the object of أشاء is omitted, its implied form being "إصابته" (striking him). (الواو): conjunction. (رحمتي): like عذابي. (وسعت): a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "hiya". (كلّ): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الفاء): conjunction, linking the effect to the cause. (السين): a particle of the future. (أكتب): like أصيب, and (ها) is mafʿūl bihi. (اللام): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أكتبها). (يتّقون): an imperfect verb, nominative .. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction. (يؤتون): like يتّقون. (الزكاة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (الذين): like the first and conjoined to it. (هم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمنون), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يؤمنون): like يتّقون.
The clause «اكتب لنا ...»: conjoined to the clause اغفر لنا.
The clause «إنّا هدنا ...»: has no grammatical position, giving the cause (taʿlīl) of the preceding supplication.
The clause «هدنا ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «عذابي أصيب ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «أصيب ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذابي).
The clause «أشاء»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «رحمتي وسعت ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of the saying.
The clause «وسعت كلّ..»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (رحمتي).
The clause «سأكتبها ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause وسعت.
The clause «يتقون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يؤتون ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هم ... يؤمنون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «يؤمنون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
(الذين): a badal of الذين يتقون, in the position of genitive [Note: Or in the position of nominative as the khabar of a necessarily omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هم, it having been cut off from the naʿt (adjective) for praise; or in the position of accusative by an omitted verb, for praise.
(2, 3) Or attached to (مكتوبا).]. (يتّبعون): like يتّقون. (الرسول): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (النبيّ): a badal of الرسول — or a naʿt of it — accusative. (الأميّ): a naʿt of النبيّ, accusative. (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a second naʿt of النبيّ. (يجدون): like يتّقون, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (مكتوبا): a ḥāl, accusative, of the third-person pronoun in (يجدونه). (عند): an adverb, accusative, attached to (يجدون) «2», and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (في التوراة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجدون) «3». (الواو): conjunction. (الإنجيل): maʿṭūf to التوراة, genitive. (يأمر): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "huwa", and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بالمعروف): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأمر). (الواو): conjunction. (ينهاهم): like يأمرهم. (عن المنكر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينهاهم). (الواو): conjunction. (يحلّ): like يأمر. (لهم): like لنا, attached to (يحلّ). (الطيّبات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو): a conjunction. (يحرّم عليهم الخبائث): like يحلّ لهم الطيّبات. (الواو): conjunction. (يضع عنهم إصرهم): like يحلّ لهم الطّيبات. (الواو): conjunction. (الأغلال): maʿṭūf to إصر, accusative. (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of الأغلال. (كانت): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator — and (التاء) is for the feminine, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "hiya". (على): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to the omitted khabar of كانت.
(الفاء): resumptive. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, mubtadaʾ. (آمنوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma .. and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (به): like the first, attached to (آمنوا). (الواو): conjunction in the three places. (عزّروا، نصروا، اتّبعوا): like آمنوا, and (الهاء) in the two verbs is the object in each. (النور): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الذي): like التي. (أنزل): a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (معه): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (أنزل), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (أولئك): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) is a particle of address. (هم): a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun, a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (المفلحون), and the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).]. (المفلحون): the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «يتّبعون ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يجدونه ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يأمرهم ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of الرسول.
The clause «ينهاهم ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يأمرهم.
The clause «يحلّ ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يأمرهم.
The clause «يحرّم ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يأمرهم.
The clause «يضع ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يأمرهم.
The clause «كانت عليهم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (التي).
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «عزّروه»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «نصروه»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «اتّبعوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أنزل معه»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third relative (الذي).
The clause «أولئك هم المفلحون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين آمنوا).

* Morphology:
