and (التاء) the fāʿil, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is «you»; (إنّما) a restraining [mā] and the restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (اتّبع) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «I» (أنا); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يوحى) imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is «it» (هو), and it is the resumptive pronoun; (إلى) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يوحى), (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (بصائر) khabar, nominative; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (بصائر), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive in both places; (هدى، رحمة) two words conjoined to بصائر, both nominative, the sign of the nominative in هدى being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رحمة; (يؤمنون) like يمدّون.
The clause «لم تأتهم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «اجتبيتها» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of saying).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أتّبع ...» is in the position of the accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يوحى إليّ ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هذا بصائر ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of the genitive as naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(طائف): the active participle of the triliteral طاف; its pattern is فاعل. The weak letter – the wāw, the ʿayn of the word – was changed into a hamza because it came after the quiescent alif of فاعل.
(مبصرون): plural of مبصر, the active participle of the quadriliteral أبصر; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- لولا is a particle of non-existence due to existence (imtināʿ li-l-wujūd). Its matter was treated earlier, so go back and review it, for in repetition there is benefit.

safi-cedvel:125-126.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun. (إلى رب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (منقلبون), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (منقلبون) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause: «قالوا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّا ... منقلبون» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
(الواو) a conjunction. (ما) a particle of negation. (تنقم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (من) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تنقم), by its being made to carry the meaning of «disapprove» (تنكر). (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (آمنّا) like آمنتم [Note: in ayah (123) of this surah.], (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنّا). (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن آمنّا) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
(لمّا) an adverb meaning «when» (حين), containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the omitted apodosis. (جاءت) a past verb, and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هي. (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), with the vocative particle omitted from it.. and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أفرغ) an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is أنت. (على) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أفرغ), by its being made to carry the meaning of «send down» (أنزل). (صبرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) a conjunction. (توفّ) an imperative verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (مسلمين) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the object of توفّنا, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «تنقم ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
And the clause: «آمنا ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «جاءتنا» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi ... and the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its implied form being آمنّا, is explained by what is mentioned before it.
And the vocative clause and its answer have no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the sorcerers' speech.
And the clause: «أفرغ ... » has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
And the clause: «توفّنا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause answering the vocative.

* Morphology:
(منقلبون): plural of منقلب, an active participle from the five-letter verb انقلب; its pattern is منفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Confirming praise with what resembles blame (taʾkīd al-madḥ bi-mā yushbih al-dhamm): in His saying, Exalted is He, «وَما تَنْقِمُ مِنَّا إِلَّا أَنْ آمَنَّا بِآياتِ رَبِّنا», i.e. you find no fault in us except belief in the signs of Allah. They meant: you find no fault in us except what is the root of all virtues and glories, namely belief. Of this kind is the poet's saying:
ولا عيب فيهم غير أن سيوفهم ... بهنّ فلول من قراع الكتائب
(There is no fault in them, except that their swords are notched from striking the battalions.)
2- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, Exalted is He, «رَبَّنا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنا صَبْراً», i.e. pour upon us patience that overwhelms us, as water is poured out; or pour upon us what purifies us of sins, namely patience in the face of Pharaoh's threat. (فأفرغ) on the first view is a derivative explicit metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya taṣrīḥiyya), and (صبرا) is its contextual indicator (qarīna); the meaning intended is: grant us complete, abundant patience. On the second view, (صبرا) is a root implicit metaphor (istiʿāra aṣliyya makniyya), and (أفرغ) is the imaginative attribute (takhyīliyya).

* Benefits:
- لمّا is a conditional particle, and it is called «the particle of existence for existence». Among the scholars are those who make it an adverb of time meaning «when» (حين), and it is called «the temporal لمّا» (lammā al-ḥīniyya), and it is annexed to the conditional clause. This is the well-known view. The verifying scholars claim that it is a particle for linking.
In truth, this discussion contains details worthy of verification, were it not that length is undesirable in this concise work.

safi-cedvel:127-127.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قال الملأ من قوم فرعون) its i'rab has already passed [Note: in ayah (109) of this surah.], (الهمزة) for interrogation. (تذر) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is أنت. (موسى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and it is prevented from nunation. (الواو) a conjunction. (قوم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to موسى, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (اللام) the lām of consequence. (يفسدوا) like تخرجوا [Note: in ayah (123) of this surah.], (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفسدوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفسدوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (تذر).
(الواو) a conjunction [Note: Or the wāw of accompaniment (wāw al-maʿiyya), with the verb after it accusative by an obligatorily implied أن after the wāw of accompaniment.
And the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, i.e.: أو ذرّ — that is, leaving — لموسى منك ووذر للالهة ولك منه.], (يذر) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يفسدوا), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is هو. (الواو) a conjunction. (آلهة) maʿṭūf to the attached second-person pronoun in (يذرك), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is هو. (السين) a particle of the future. (نقتّل) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being نحن, used for majesty. (أبناءهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.. and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (نستحيي) an imperfect verb, nominative. (نساءهم) like أبناءهم. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (إنا) like the previous one [Note: in ayah (125) of this surah.], (فوق) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (قاهرون), (وهم) muḍāf ilayhi. (قاهرون) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause: «قال الملأ ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «تذر ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «يفسدوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «يذرك ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يفسدوا.
And the clause: «قال» ... has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause: «سنقتّل ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «نستحيي ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
And the clause: «إنّا فوقهم قاهرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of نقتّل and نستحيي [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption, and then it has no grammatical position.].

* Morphology:
(قاهرون): plural of قاهر, an active participle from the triliteral قهر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:128-128.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb. (موسى) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and it is prevented from nunation. (لقوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (استعينوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (استعينوا). (الواو) a conjunction. (اصبروا) like استعينوا. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (الأرض) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb). (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. (يورث) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, i.e. Allah. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يشاء) like يورث. (من عباد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted returning pronoun, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (العاقبة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (للمتّقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause: «قال موسى ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «استعينوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «اصبروا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
And the clause: «إنّ الأرض لله» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya), or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause: «يورثها ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from the Word of Majesty [Note: It may be cut off as a resumption, and then it has no grammatical position; it may also be a second khabar in the position of nominative.].
And the clause: «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
And the clause: «العاقبة للمتّقين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ الأرض لله.

safi-cedvel:129-129.t:
* I'rab:
«قالوا» a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (أوذينا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوذينا). (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (تأتي) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأتينا) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(الواو) a conjunction. (من بعد) like من قبل. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (جئتنا) a past verb ... and (التاء) is the fāʿil ... and (نا) is mafʿūl bihi. (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is هو. (عسى) a defective, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb. (ربّ) the noun of ʿasā, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أن يهلك) like أن تأتي. (عدوّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (يستخلف) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يهلك), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يستخلفكم).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يهلك..) is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ʿasā.
(الفاء) a conjunction. (ينظر) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يستخلف), and the fāʿil is هو, i.e. Allah. (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of تعملون. (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause: «قالوا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «أوذينا ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «تأتينا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «جئتنا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
And the clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause: «عسى ربّكم ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
And the clause: «يهلك ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
And the clause: «يستخلفكم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يهلك.
And the clause: «ينظر ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يستخلفكم.
And the clause: «تعملون» is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative كيف.

* Benefits:
- كيف: a vague, non-fully-declinable (ghayr mutamakkin) noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, with which one asks about the state of a thing.
Questioning with it may be genuine, or it may be non-genuine, as in «كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ».
It is parsed as a fronted khabar, as in «كيف أنت»; or as the khabar of kāna, as in «كيف كنت»?; or as the second object of ẓanna and its sisters. The bāʾ, of the prepositions, may enter its khabar, in which case the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition and كيف is in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar.
It may be in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), as in:
«كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحابِ الْفِيلِ». And it may occur as a ḥāl before that by which the speech is completed.
As for «the conditional كيف», it requires two verbs agreeing in wording and meaning, not jussive, as in «كيف تصنع أصنع». The discussion of «كيف» is subtle, so reflect.

safi-cedvel:204-204.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذا) like the previous [Note: In verses (201 and 203) of this sūra.], attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (قرئ) past verb, passive; (القرآن) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition; (استمعوا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunctive; (أنصتوا) like استمعوا; (لعلّ) a particle of hope (tarajjī) and of the accusative – an abrogator (nāsikh) – and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as ism of laʿalla; (ترحمون) imperfect verb, passive, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «قرئ القرآن» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the condition, its verb and its apodosis are a resumption.
The clause «استمعوا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أنصتوا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «لعلّكم ترحمون» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «ترحمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

safi-cedvel:205-205.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (اذكر) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «you» (أنت); (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the second-person pronoun in ربّك, and (الكاف) like the first; (تضرّعا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative [Note: Or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of the ḥāl, interpreted as a derived word, i.e. متضرّعا (humbly).], (الواو) conjunctive; (خيفة) conjoined to (تضرّعا), accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (دون) an adverb, accusative, attached to a ḥāl conjoined to the first ḥāl – في نفسك [Note: al-ʿUkbarī allowed conjoining it to (تضرّعا), making it include the meaning of مقتصدين (moderate).. In any case, the adverb carries the meaning of the ḥāl.] – (الجهر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (من القول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of الجهر – i.e. below the loud voice, being of speech – (بالغدوّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اذكر), (الواو) conjunctive; (الآصال) conjoined by the wāw to الغدوّ, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-making; (تكن) an incomplete imperfect verb – an abrogator (nāsikh) – jussive (majzūm), its ism being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «you» (أنت); (من الغافلين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of تكن, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «اذكر ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the preceding resumption.
The clause «لا تكن ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اذكر.

* Morphology:
(خيفة): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb خاف يخاف; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn. It contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by change: its origin is خوفة – with kasra on the khāʾ and sukūn on the wāw – because the alif's origin is a wāw, which appears in the maṣdar (الخوف); when the letter before it took a kasra, it was changed into a yāʾ.
(الغدوّ): plural of غدوة – with ḍamma on the ghayn and sukūn on the dāl – (from the break of dawn to sunrise); its pattern is فعلة, and the pattern of الغدوّ is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ, in which the extra wāw is assimilated into the final radical of the word.
(الآصال): plural of أصيل, which is from the afternoon to sunset; its pattern is فعيل, and the pattern of آصال is أفعال. The madda in آصال is originally two hamzas, the first vowelled with fatḥa and the second quiescent: أأصال.

safi-cedvel:206-206.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ الذين) its i'rab has passed [Note: In verse (201) of this sūra.], (عند) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of the genitive; (لا) a negative particle; (يستكبرون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (عن عبادة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يستكبرون), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (يسبّحون) like يستكبرون, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunctive; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يسجدون), which is like يستكبرون.
The clause «إنّ الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يستكبرون ...» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «يسبّحونه» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause لا يستكبرون.
The clause «يسجدون» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause لا يستكبرون.

safi-cedvel:65-72.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إلى عاد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "arsalnā" (We sent). (أخا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the alif, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (هودا): a badal (substitute) of (أخاهم) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), accusative. (قال يا قوم ... إله غيره): its i'rab has passed [Note: In āya (59) of this sura.]. (الهمزة): for interrogation. (الفاء): conjunctive. (لا): negating. (تتقون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
The clause «أرسلنا إلى عاد ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قال....»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial), with qad implied [Note: Or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.].
The clause «the vocative and its reply»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اعبدوا....»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «ما لكم من إله....»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تتقون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumed clause, i.e. "Are you heedless, and so do not fear [Him]?"
(66) (قال الملأ): its i'rab has passed «1». (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, naʿt (adjective) of الملأ. (كفروا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (من قوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of كفروا, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إنا لنراك في سفاهة): like إنا لنراك في ضلال «2». (الواو): conjunctive. (إنا لنظنّك من الكاذبين): like إنا لنراك في ضلال «3» ... and the preposition and its genitive noun are the second object of (نظنك).
[Translator's note: the markers «1», «2», «3» stand in the source without accompanying footnote text.]
The clause «قال الملأ ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «إنا لنراك....»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «نراك....»: in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of inna.
The clause «إنا لنظنك....»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the speech reported.
The clause «نظنك»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the second inna.
(67) (قال يا قوم ... رب العالمين): the i'rab of its counterpart, word by word and clause by clause, has passed [Note: In āya (61) of this sura.].
(68) (أبلغكم رسالات ربي): its i'rab has passed [Note: In āya (62) of this sura.]. (الواو): circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (أنا): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to ناصح ... which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative. (أمين): a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «أبلغكم ...»: in the position of nominative, a second naʿt of رسول in the preceding āya [Note: Or it is a ḥāl, or resumptive.].
The clause «أنا لكم ناصح ...»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl [Note: Or conjoined to the clause (لكني رسول من ربّ العالمين) ... see āya (61) of this sura.].
(69) (أو عجبتم أن جاءكم.... لينذركم): its i'rab has passed [Note: In āya (63) of this sura.]. (الواو): conjunctive. (اذكروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إذ): a noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi, its operator being اذكروا [Note: إذ may be purely adverbial, and then it is attached to an omitted word, its implied form being "niʿma" (favour), i.e. "Remember the favour of your Lord when He made you ..."]. (جعل): a past verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring back to ربكم. (خلفاء): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and it is prevented from nunation because it is attached (mulḥaq) to the extended (mamdūd) [nouns] on the wazn فعلاء. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of خلفاء. (قوم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (نوح): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): conjunctive. (زادكم): like جعلكم. (في الخلق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (زادكم) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of (بسطة) — an adjective placed before the qualified noun.]. (بسطة): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء): connecting (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied conditional. (اذكروا): like the first. (آلاء): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الله): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (لعل): a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of laʿalla. (تفلحون): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «عجبتم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to a resumed clause [Note: I.e.: "You denied and wondered that there came to you ...", and the resumed clause falls within the scope of the speech «لمسبوق» from Hūd, peace be upon him. [Translator's note: «لمسبوق» is evidently a misprint for «المسوق», "conveyed", as in the parallel note on āya 63.]].
The clause «جاءكم ذكر....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ينذركم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «اذكروا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumed [clause], i.e. "Do not wonder", or "Consider your affair, and remember ..."
The clause «جعلكم ...»: in the position of genitive by the annexation of إذ to it.
The clause «زادكم ...»: in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause جعلكم.
The clause «اذكروا.... (the second)»: in the position of jussive (majzūm), the apodosis of an implied conditional, i.e.:
"If you recognise Allah's bounty upon you, then remember the favours of Allah."
The clause «لعلكم تفلحون»: has no grammatical position, causal.
The clause «تفلحون»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of laʿalla.
(70) (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الهمزة): for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī). (جئت): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (اللام): for causation (taʿlīl). (نعبد): an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", and it is accusative by a concealed (أن) after the lām. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (وحد): a ḥāl of the Name of Majesty, accusative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعبد) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (جئتنا).
(الواو): conjunctive. (نذر): an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (نعبد), and the fāʿil is "naḥnu". (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (كان): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring back to آباء [Note: The two verbs (كان، يعبد) contend (tanāzuʿ) over the word الآباء, and it is permissible that the noun of kāna be the word آباؤنا.]. (يعبد): an imperfect verb, nominative, and its object is omitted, i.e. يعبده. (آباء): the fāʿil of يعبد, nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء): connecting for the apodosis of an implied conditional. (ائت): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta", and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (ائت). (تعد): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta", and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إن): a conditional particle making jussive. (كنت): a defective past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء) is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (من الصادقين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كنت.
The clause «قالوا....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «جئتنا....»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «نعبد....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «نذر....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle relative.
The clause «كان ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يعبد آباؤنا»: in the position of accusative, the khabar of kāna.
The clause «ائتنا ...»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied conditional, i.e. "If you are truthful in what you say, then bring us (فأتنا)."
The clause «تعدنا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «كنت من الصادقين»: has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or it is an explication of the implied conditional clause that preceded.], and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "If you are among the truthful, then bring us what you promise us."
(71) (قال): like the first. (قد): a particle of verification (taḥqīq). (وقع): like قال. (على): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (وقع). (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (وقع) by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "wajaba" (to be due) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of رجس — an adjective placed before the qualified noun.], and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (رجس): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunctive. (غضب): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to رجس, nominative. (الهمزة): for disapproving interrogation. (تجادلون): like تتّقون, and (النون) is for protection (al-wiqāya), and (الياء) is mafʿūl bihi. (في أسماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجادلون) [Note: On the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "about possessors of names that you have named".]. (سمّيتم): like عجبتم, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), a vowel-lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the mīm. (ها): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (أنتم): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, tawkīd (emphasis) of the attached pronoun, the fāʿil of سمّيتم. (الواو): conjunctive. (آباء): conjoined to the attached pronoun, the fāʿil of سمّيتم, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ما): negating. (نزّل): a past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الباء): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نزّل), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "for worshipping them". (من): a redundant preposition. (سلطان): genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. (الفاء): connecting for the apodosis of an implied conditional. (انتظروا): like اعبدوا. (إنّي): like إنّا. (مع): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to المنتظرين, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من المنتظرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of inna.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قد وقع ... رجس»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «تجادلونني....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive within the scope of the saying.
The clause «سمّيتموها»: in the position of genitive, a second naʿt of أسماء.
The clause «ما نزّل الله.....»: in the position of genitive, a second naʿt of أسماء [Note: Or in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of أسماء because it is qualified.]. [Translator's note: the source calls both clauses the "second naʿt"; presumably سمّيتموها is the first.]
The clause «انتظروا....»: the apodosis of an implied conditional, in the position of jussive, i.e. "If you do not believe, then wait.."
The clause «إنّي معكم ...»: has no grammatical position, causal, or in its status (ḥukm).
(72) (الفاء): conjunctive. (أنجينا): a past verb and its fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunctive. (الذين معه): its i'rab has passed [Note: In the preceding āya (64).]. (برحمة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنجيناه), and the bāʾ is causal. (من): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt of رحمة. (الواو): conjunctive. (قطعنا): like أنجينا. (دابر): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (كذّبوا): like كفروا. (بآيات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunctive. (ما): negating. (كانوا): a defective past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of kāna. (مؤمنين): the khabar of kāna, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «أنجيناه ...»: conjoined to an implied resumed clause, i.e.:
"The wind was sent upon them ... and so We saved him."
The clause «قطعنا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنجيناه.
The clause «كذّبوا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ما كانوا مؤمنين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(سفاهة): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb سفه يسفه, of the pattern (bāb) كرم, meaning "to be ignorant"; its wazn is فعالة with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and the occurrence of this wazn for the maṣdar of a verb with ḍamma on the ʿayn is predominant. There is another maṣdar of this verb, namely سفاه, without the tāʾ marbūṭa and also with fatḥa on the sīn.
(أمين): a derived adjective whose verb is أمن يأمن, of the pattern فرح; the wazn is فعيل in the sense of مفعول, i.e. trusted with the message.
(آلاء): plural of إلي, with kasra on the hamza and sukūn on the lām, like حمل and أحمال; or ألي, with ḍamma on the hamza and sukūn on the lām, like قفل and أقفال; or إلى, with kasra on the hamza and fatḥa on the lām, like عنب and أعناب; or ألى, with fatḥa on the hamza and the lām, like قفا and أقفاء ... It is a noun meaning "favour", and in it the yāʾ is changed into a hamza because it came final after a quiescent alif; its original form is آلاي.
(وحده): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the verb وحد يحد, of the pattern ضرب; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. There are other maṣdars of the verb, namely (وحدة) with fatḥa on the wāw, (وحدة) with kasra on the ḥāʾ, and (وحود) with ḍamma on the wāw ... then (وحادة) with fatḥa on the wāw, and (وحودة) with ḍamma on the wāw, two maṣdars of the verb وحد يحد with ḍamma on the ḥāʾ in the past and kasra in the imperfect — irregularly.
(تعدنا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by omission, because it is the imperfect of a mithāl verb (first radical wāw) with kasra on the ʿayn, whose fāʾ is always dropped; its wazn is تعلنا.

* Rhetoric:
1- Allusion (al-kināya): this is in the saying of the Exalted ﴿قالَ: يا قَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفاهَةٌ وَلكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ﴾: their denial was alluded to by their saying to Hūd, peace be upon him: "We surely see you in foolishness."
2- Shifting to the nominal: in the story of Hūd He brought the nominal clause, saying ﴿وَأَنَا لَكُمْ ناصِحٌ أَمِينٌ﴾, while in the story of Nūḥ He brought the verbal clause, saying ﴿وَأَنْصَحُ لَكُمْ﴾; and in this shift from the verbal to the nominal there is what is not hidden. Perhaps expressing it with the nominal here and with the verbal earlier is because of the renewal of the counsel on the part of Nūḥ rather than Hūd, peace be upon them both.
3- Allusion (al-kināya): in the saying of the Exalted ﴿قَطَعْنا دابِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾: the speech is an allusion to extirpation. الدابر is the last one, i.e. We destroyed them entirely and annihilated them to the last of them.

* Benefits:
1- إنّ with kasra occurs after a saying (qawl) that does not contain the meaning of supposing (ẓann), and this is one of twelve places in which the kasra of the hamza of «إنّ» is obligatory; we shall have a detailed discussion of them, Allah willing.
2- From the stories of the Qur'an:
We do not wish to go into these āyas and the splendid dialogue they contain, their concision and brevity, their artistic depiction and living movement; rather, this is a summary of the story of ʿĀd. History claims that ʿĀd spread out in the lands between ʿUmān and Ḥaḍramawt, and they had idols which they worshipped besides Allah, namely Ṣadāʾ, Ṣumūd and al-Habāʾ. So Allah sent to them Hūd as a prophet, from the most central of them in rank and lineage. They denied him and increased in insolence and tyranny, so Allah withheld rain from them for three years until they were exhausted. When affliction befell people, they would ask Allah for relief and flee to His Sacred House; so ʿĀd sent to Mecca seventy men from among their most eminent, and they entered Mecca. Qayl ibn ʿAntar, one of the leaders of the delegation, said: "O Allah, give ʿĀd to drink as You used to give them to drink." So Allah produced three clouds — white, red and black — then called him from the sky: "O Qayl, choose for yourself and for your people." He said: "I choose the black, for it has the most water of them." It came out upon ʿĀd from a valley of theirs called al-Mughīth, and they rejoiced at it and said: "This is a cloud bringing us rain." But from it there came to them a barren wind that destroyed them, and Hūd and the believers with him were saved; they came to Mecca and worshipped Allah there until they died.
Surely in that is a lesson for whoever has a heart....!

safi-cedvel:161-163.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إذ): an adverbial noun of past time, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). (قيل): a passive past verb. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قيل). (اسكنوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (القرية): a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو): conjunction. (كلوا): like اسكنوا. (من): a preposition, and (ها) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (كلوا). (حيث): an adverb indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative, attached to (كلوا). (شئتم): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ..
and (تم) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (الواو): conjunction. (قولوا): and like اسكنوا. (حطّة): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "مسألتنا" (our request) or "أمرنا" (our matter). (الواو): conjunction. (ادخلوا): like اسكنوا. (الباب): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (سجّدا): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the fāʿil of ادخلوا. (نغفر): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu", for majesty. (لكم): like لهم, attached to (نغفر). (خطيئات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (السين): a particle of the future. (نزيد): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) .. and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", for majesty. (المحسنين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «(اذكر)», the implied one ...: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قيل ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اسكنوا ...»: in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Note: Because it is the clause that is the object of the saying for the verb in the active voice .. and the parsers make the nāʾib fāʿil implied, i.e. قيل القول (the saying was said), and the clause is explicative or an explanatory resumption, and consequently so are the clauses conjoined to it.].
The clause «كلوا»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اسكنوا.
The clause «شئتم»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قولوا ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اسكنوا.
The clause «(أمرنا) حطّ» [Translator's note: so in the source, truncated; «(أمرنا) حطّة» is meant]: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ادخلوا ...»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause اسكنوا.
The clause «نغفر ...»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied condition not joined with the fāʾ, i.e.: إن تدخلوا نغفر ... (if you enter, We will forgive ...).
The clause «سنزيد ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive — or parenthetical — [Note: See the two ayahs (57, 58) of Sūrat al-Baqara for i'rab and morphology.].
(الفاء): conjunction. (بدّل): a past verb. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (ظلموا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (منهم): like منها, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of ظلموا. (قولا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: And the second object of the verb بدّل is omitted, the implied form being: فبدّل الذين ظلموا منهم بالذي قيل لهم قولا غير ... (so those of them who did wrong substituted, for what was said to them, a saying other ...).]. (غير): a naʿt (adjective) of (قولا), accusative. (الذي): a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (قيل لهم): like the first, and the nāʾib fāʿil is the referential pronoun (ʿāʾid). (الفاء): conjunction. (أرسلنا): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (على): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (أرسلنا). (رجزا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (رجزا). (الباء): a causal preposition. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (كانوا): an incomplete past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — indeclinable on ḍamma .. and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of كان. (يظلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative .. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أرسلنا).
The clause «بدّل الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e. أمروا فبدّلوا (they were commanded, but they substituted).
The clause «ظلموا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «قيل ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause بدّل الذين ... [Translator's note: So in the source; by the author's own parsing above, «قيل لهم» is the ṣila of the relative (الذي); the clause conjoined to بدّل is evidently «أرسلنا ...», which is not listed.]
The clause «كانوا يظلمون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما) [Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a relative noun, with the referential pronoun omitted .. and the clause is the ṣila of ما.].
The clause «يظلمون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا [Note: See ayah (59) of al-Baqara.].
(الواو): conjunction. (اسأل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "anta", and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عن القرية): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اسأل). (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as a naʿt of القرية. (كانت): an incomplete past verb, an abrogator .. and (التاء) is for the feminine, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "hiya", and it is the referential pronoun. (حاضرة): the khabar of كانت, accusative. (البحر): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إذ): an adverb of past time, in the position of accusative, attached to حاضرة, the derived noun. (يعدون): like يظلمون. (في السبت): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يعدون). (إذ): like the first, attached to (يعدون). (تأتي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (حيتان): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تأتيهم). (سبت): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) is like the last. (شرّعا): a ḥāl, accusative, of حيتان. (الواو): conjunction. (يوم): like the first, attached to (لا تأتيهم). (لا): a particle of negation. (يسبتون): like يظلمون. (لا): like the first. (تأتيهم): like the first, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "hiya". (الكاف): a preposition, and (ذلك) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (نبلوهم) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl .. i.e. لا تأتيهم شرّعا كذلك (they do not come to them visibly, likewise).], and it is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the wāw .. and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "naḥnu", for majesty. [Translator's note: The source does not give the head (نبلو) separately; «and it is an imperfect verb» refers to نبلوهم.] (بما كانوا يفسقون): like بما كانوا يظلمون [Note: In the previous ayah (162).].
The clause «اسألهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied clause «اذكر».
The clause «كانت حاضرة ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (التي).
The clause «يعدون ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تأتيهم حيتانهم»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا يسبتون ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا تأتيهم»: in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause تأتيهم.
The clause «نبلوهم»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كانوا يفسقون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يفسقون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(يعدون): the imperfect of عدا يعدو, meaning to transgress and do wrong. In it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is يعدوون with ḍamma on the first wāw, then it was made vowelless because of the heaviness of the ḍamma — iʿlāl by making vowelless — then it was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. Its pattern is يفعون.
(حيتان): plural of الحوت, a primitive (jāmid) noun for a concrete thing; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma then sukūn. In (حيتان) there is iʿlāl: the wāw was changed into a yāʾ because it is vowelless and what precedes it has kasra; its origin is حوتان, with kasra then sukūn. Its pattern is فعلان, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(شرّعا): plural of شارع, from شرع عليه when it came near and appeared; an active participle on the pattern فاعل. The pattern of شرّع is فعّل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and a doubled ʿayn with fatḥa, on the measure of شرّد.

* Rhetoric:
[Translator's note: So headed in the source; the material below is grammatical.]
1- حيث is for place as «حين» is for time.
Most often «حيث» comes in the position of accusative as an adverb of place.
It may come in the position of genitive by the construct, as in «لدى حيث القت إلخ» (at where she cast ... etc.).
And in the position of genitive by «من», as in «مِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ».
It may occur as a mafʿūl bihi, as in «اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسالَتَهُ».
Its being put in construct with a single word is rare, as in «حيث ليّ العمائم» (where the turbans are wound). Remark: when حيث is joined to the restraining «ما» (mā al-kāffa), it comes to imply the meaning of condition and puts the two verbs of the condition in the jussive «its apodosis and its consequence», and it remains in the position of accusative as an adverb of place.
2- إذ: it comes as an adverb, as a particle of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and as causal (taʿlīliyya).
a- The adverbial: it is an adverb of past time, a mafʿūl bihi, a badal of the mafʿūl bihi, and in the position of genitive by a noun of time being put in construct with it, such as «يومئذ وحينئذ» and بعد إذ هديتنا.
b- The one of surprise is the one that comes after «بينا» or «بينما», as in:
استقدر الله خيرا وارضينّ به ... فبينما العسر إذ دارت مياسير
(Ask Allah to decree good and be content with it ... for while there is hardship, suddenly ease comes round.)
c- The causal: it has the meaning of «لأنّ» (because), as in the words of the Exalted: «قَدْ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ إِذْ لَمْ أَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ شَهِيداً». The majority do not affirm the causal one and hold only that it is adverbial.
So choose for yourself and verify.

safi-cedvel:164-166.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): an adverb conjoined to إذ يعدون ... [Note: In the previous ayah (163).],
(قال): a past verb, (والتاء) is for the feminine. (أمّة): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (من): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of أمّة. (اللام): a preposition. (ما): an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (تعظون), which is an imperfect verb, nominative ..
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (قوما): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (مهلك): khabar (predicate), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (أو): a conjunction. (معذّبهم): like مهلكهم, and it is conjoined to it. (عذابا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, whose governor is معذّب. (شديدا): a naʿt of (عذابا), accusative like it. (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma .. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (معذرة): mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, accusative [Note: Or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. وعظناهم للمعذرة (we admonished them for the sake of excuse); and it is said that it is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e.:
قالوا نطلب معذرة (they said: we seek an excuse).]. (إلى ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (معذرة), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (لعلّ): a particle resembling the verb, for hope — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of لعلّ. (يتّقون): like تعظون.
The clause «قالت أمّة ...»: in the position of genitive by (إذ) being put in construct with it.
The clause «تعظون»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «الله مهلكهم»: in the position of accusative as a naʿt of «قوما».
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «(نعتذر) معذرة»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «لعلّهم يتّقون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause that is the object of the saying.
The clause «يتقون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.
(الفاء): conjunction. (لمّا): an adverb meaning حين (when), containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis أنجينا. (نسوا): a past verb like قالوا. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (ذكّروا): a passive past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (ذكّروا). (أنجينا): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn .. and (نا) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (ينهون): an imperfect verb, nominative .. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (عن السوء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينهون). (الواو): conjunction. (أخذنا): like أنجينا. (الذين): like the first. (ظلموا): like قالوا. (بعذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذنا), and the bāʾ is for making transitive (taʿdiya). (بئيس): a naʿt of عذاب, genitive (majrūr). (بما كانوا يفسقون): its i'rab has passed [Note: In the previous ayah (163) of this surah.].
The clause «نسوا ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ذكّروا به»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «أنجينا»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ينهون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أخذنا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ظلموا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «كانوا يفسقون ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يفسقون»: in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أخذنا) [Note: Or to (بئيس), the assimilated adjective, i.e. severe because of their transgression.].
(الفاء): conjunction. (لمّا عتوا): like لمّا نسوا ... and the indeclinability on ḍamma is implied on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (عن): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (عتوا) by its being made to imply the meaning of تكبّروا (they were arrogant). (نهوا): like ذكّروا. (عنه): a preposition and a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نهوا). (قلنا): like أنجينا. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم) is in the position of genitive; attached to (قلنا). (كونوا): an incomplete imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of كن. (قردة): the khabar of كونوا, accusative. (خاسئين): a second khabar, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ [Note: It may be a naʿt of قردة .. or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the noun of كان ... and see ayah (65) of Sūrat al-Baqara.].
The clause «عتوا ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نهوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «قلنا»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كونوا ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.

* Morphology:
(مهلك): an active participle of the quadriliteral أهلك; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(معذّب): an active participle of the quadriliteral عذّب; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(معذرة): a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb اعتذر; its pattern is مفعلة, with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn. Or it is a mīmī maṣdar of the verb عذر that came irregularly, because the regular form has fatḥa on the rāʾ, and the tāʾ marbūṭa is for intensity, as in محبّة and مودّة.
(بئيس): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from بؤس يبؤس, of the bāb karuma; its pattern is فعيل. Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī said: it may properly be a maṣdar like النذير, and its implied form in the ayah is:
بعذاب ذي بأس, i.e. of severity.
(نهوا): in it there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is نهيوا with ḍamma on the yāʾ together with the nūn. The vowel on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made vowelless and its vowel was transferred to the hāʾ .. then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, vowelless, with the wāw of the plural, so it became نهوا. Its pattern is فعوا, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the ʿayn.
(قردة): plural of قرد, a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known animal; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn, and the pattern of قردة is فعلة, with kasra on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Majāz (figurative usage): in the words of the Exalted «فَلَمَّا نَسُوا ما ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ», i.e. they abandoned what their righteous ones reminded them of; so forgetting is a majāz for abandoning. It is held to be apparent that it is a metaphor (istiʿāra), where abandoning is likened to forgetting by the common factor of lack of concern; and it is allowed to be a non-metaphorical majāz (majāz mursal) by the relation of causation.

safi-cedvel:130-131.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (أخذنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent), used for majesty. (آل) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (بالسنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخذنا), by its being made to carry the meaning of «we punished» — or «we tried» — the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, for it is treated like the sound masculine plural. (الواو) a conjunction. (نقص) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السنين, genitive. (من الثمرات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نقص), for it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) or a noun of the maṣdar. (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of laʿalla. (يذّكّرون) like تعملون in the preceding ayah (129).
And the clause: «أخذنا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, being the answer to an implied oath.
And the clause: «لعلّهم يذّكّرون» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
And the clause: «يذّكّرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.
(الفاء) a conjunction. (إذا) an adverb for the future containing the sense of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (قالوا). (جاء) a past verb, (التاء) for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الحسنة) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (قالوا) like the preceding one [Note: in ayah (129) of this surah.], (اللام) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (الواو) a conjunction. (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle. (تصب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (سيّئة) fāʿil, nominative. (يطّيّروا) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بموسى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يطّيّروا); the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa implied on the alif, for it is a diptote. (الواو) a conjunction. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, conjoined to موسى. (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلا) [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is ألا.] a particle of alerting and opening. (إنّما) the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (طائر) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. (الله) the Word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) a conjunction. (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk) — an abrogator. (أكثر) the noun of lākinna, accusative, and (هم) like the last one. (لا) a negating particle. (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
And the clause: «جاءتهم الحسنة ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «لنا هذه» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «تصبهم سيّئة..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, which is conjoined by the fāʾ to the implied resumptive oath clause.
And the clause: «يطّيّروا..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
And the clause: «طائرهم عند الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «أكثرهم لا يعلمون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause طائرهم عند الله.
And the clause: «لا يعلمون ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of lākinna.

* Morphology:
(السنين): plural of سنة. It has two usages; the better known of them is treating it like the sound masculine plural, so it is nominative with the wāw and accusative and genitive with the yāʾ, and its nūn is dropped in annexation. The second usage is to put the case-inflection on the nūn, but with the yāʾ specifically; this is the view of al-Farrāʾ. See ayah (155) of Surat al-Baqara.
(يطّيّروا): in it the tāʾ of the تفعّل form is replaced by ṭāʾ because of the closeness of their points of articulation; its origin is يتطيّروا. The first ṭāʾ had fatḥa, as the tāʾ had, then it was made quiescent so that assimilation of the two ṭāʾs would be valid; its pattern is يتفعّلوا.
(طائرهم): an active participle from the triliteral طار; its pattern is فاعل, with the weak letter in it changed into a hamza. It has been used in the sense of «their destiny» or «their lot». In al-Miṣbāḥ:
A person's ṭāʾir is his deed which is hung upon him.. and the noun is الطيرة on the measure of عنبة, and it is pessimism (taking evil omens).

* Rhetoric:
- In making الحسنة definite and السيئة indefinite there is a wondrous device of the devices of the science of meanings (ʿilm al-maʿānī). In making الحسنة definite, and mentioning it with the particle of certainty, there is an indication of the frequency of its occurrence and that the divine will is attached to it essentially; just as making السيئة indefinite, and bringing it with the particle of doubt, is to signal the rarity of its occurrence, and that the will is not attached to it except accidentally.

* Benefits:
- Taking evil omens (al-taṭayyur): taking evil omens has no basis in reality; it is only a delusion and a psychological illness, which contemporary psychologists have taken up, considering its source to be weakness of the nerves and scattered thoughts. Islam forbade taking evil omens and considered it contrary to the principles of faith.
Ibn al-Rūmī was famous for taking evil omens; he used to feel fright, and would take precautions as far as precaution allowed. About it he says:
فآمن ما يكون المرء يوما ... إذا لبس الحذار من الخطوب
(The safest a man ever is, on any day, is when he puts on caution against misfortunes.)

safi-cedvel:132-132.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قالوا) its i'rab has passed. (مهما) a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by the overt verb, its implied form being (تعطنا); this implied verb comes after the conditional noun because the latter has the right to the front position [Note: That is because the overt verb is transitive to the second object by means of the bāʾ in His saying (تأتنا به).], (تأت) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), for explanation; the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تأتنا). (من آية) a preposition and its genitive noun, a tamyīz (specification) of the pronoun in به [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in به.], (اللام) for causation. (تسحر) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is أنت. (بها) like به, attached to the verb (تسحر). And the interpreted maṣdar (أن تسحرنا) is in the position of genitive, attached to (تأتي).
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (ما) a negating particle operating like laysa. (نحن) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the noun of mā. (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (مؤمنين). (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (مؤمنين) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the implied clause: (تعطنا) is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «تأتنا» has no grammatical position, explicative.
And the clause: «ما نحن ... » is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(مهما): there are three views about it ... The first is that it is composed of (مه), meaning «stop», and (ما), a conditional noun, as in His saying: ما يفتح الله للناس من رحمة.
The second is that the origin of (مه) is the conditional ما, to which ما was added, as it was added in His saying:
إمّا يأتينّكم.. Then the first alif was replaced with a hāʾ so that two words of the same form would not follow one another. The third is that it is entirely a single, non-compound word [Note: al-ʿUkbarī in (Imlāʾ mā manna bihi al-Raḥmān min wujūh al-iʿrāb..)].

* Benefits:
And he said about Ibn Ṭālib the scribe:
ويدعى أبوه طالبا وكفاكم ... به طيرة ان المنية طالب
(His father is called Ṭālib («seeker»), and that suffices you as an evil omen, for death is a seeker.)
And the Messenger of Allah (Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) used to dislike taking evil omens and would say: «If you take an evil omen, go ahead, and put your trust in Allah.»
- مهما: some grammarians have taken as evidence that it is a particle the saying of Zuhayr ibn Abī Sulmā:
ومهما تكن عند امرئ من خليقة ... وإن خالها تخفى على الناس تعلم
(Whatever trait a man has, even if he thinks it hidden from people, it becomes known.)
So in this verse «مهما» would have no grammatical position. Some verifying scholars held that مهما in this verse is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and this is the more preponderant view.
As for Ibn Mālik, he mentioned that ما and مهما occur as adverbs of time, saying:
وقد أتت مهما وما ظرفين في ... شواهد من يعتضد بها كفى
(مهما and ما have come as adverbs of time in pieces of evidence; whoever relies on them has enough.)
The scholars have rebuttals of him, at their head al-Zamakhsharī; we do not see fit to go into them, lest we depart from the course of the book.

safi-cedvel:133-133.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction. (أرسلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent). (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أرسلنا). (الطوفان) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الجراد.. الدم) words conjoined by conjunctions to الطوفان, accusative like it. (آيات) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the five words, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (مفصّلات) naʿt (adjective) of آيات, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الفاء) a conjunction. (استكبروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الواو) a conjunction. (كانوا) defective, parsed like استكبروا.. and the wāw is the noun of kāna. (قوما) the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, accusative. (مجرمين) naʿt of (قوما), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «أرسلنا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا ... [Note: in the previous ayah (132).].
And the clause: «استكبروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أرسلنا.
And the clause: «كانوا قوما ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استكبروا.

* Morphology:
(الطوفان): there are two views about it. One is that it is the plural of طوفانة, i.e. it is a generic noun (ism jins), like قمح and قمحة. The second is that it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), like النقصان; its pattern is فعلان with ḍamma then sukūn.
(الجراد): a generic noun whose single unit is جرادة, for male and female; some said it is derived from الجرد. Its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(القمّل): a generic noun whose single unit is قملة, for male and female; its pattern is فعّل with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn. There is another usage in its wording, namely القمل with fatḥa on the qāf and sukūn on the mīm.
(الضفادع): plural of ضفدع on the measure of درهم; kasra on the dāl is also permissible. ضفدع is feminine, and its male and female are distinguished by description, so one says ضفدع ذكر and ضفدع أنثى.
In al-Qāmūs: الضفدع like زبرج with kasra on the dāl, and like جعفر and جندب with ḍamma on the ḍād and the dāl, and like درهم — and this is less common or rejected — the single one with hāʾ (tāʾ marbūṭa), and the plural is ضفادع and ضفادي.
(مفصّلات): plural of مفصّلة, the feminine of مفصّل.. a passive participle of the quadriliteral (فصّل); its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn. See ayah (144) of Surat al-Anʿām.

* Rhetoric:
The secret of using القمّل: the word «القمّل» occurs in the ayah as fine and agreeable, because it came embedded within well-proportioned speech, and the speech did not stop at it. The ayah contains five words, namely الطوفان, الجراد, القمل, الضفادع and الدم; and the finest of these five words are الطوفان, الجراد and الدم. So when these five words came all together, الطوفان and الجراد were placed first, the word الدم was put last, and the words القمل and الضفادع were placed in the middle, so that the hearing would be struck first by the fine words among the five and would end with them last. Observing such secrets and subtleties in the use of words is not within human power.

safi-cedvel:73-79.t:
* I'rab:
(وإلى ثمود ... إله غيره): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed in āya (65) of this sura. (قد): a particle of verification (taḥqīq). (جاءت): a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بيّنة): fāʿil (agent), and nominative (marfūʿ). (من رب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاءتكم) [Note: Or attached to a naʿt (adjective) of بيّنة.], and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذه): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (ناقة): khabar (predicate), nominative [Note: It is permissible that it be a badal (substitute) of ذه or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), and (لكم) is the khabar of the demonstrative.]. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of آية [Note: It is permissible that it be attached to an omitted second khabar of the demonstrative.] — an adjective placed before the qualified noun. (آية): a ḥāl of ناقة, accusative (manṣūb), and its operator is the meaning of pointing. (الفاء): for linking the effect to the cause [Note: Or connecting (rābiṭa) for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied conditional.]. (ذروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (تأكل): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the reply to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya". (في أرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأكل). (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunctive. (لا): the lā of prohibition, making jussive. (تمسوا): an imperfect verb, jussive, and the sign of the jussive is the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بسوء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تمسوها). (الفاء): the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya). (يأخذ): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (أن) after the fāʾ, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عذاب): fāʿil, nominative. (أليم): naʿt of عذاب, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأخذكم ...) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "Let there be no touching with harm from you, and so a seizing of you with punishment."
The clause «(أرسلنا) إلى ثمود....»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يا قوم ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اعبدوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «قد جاءتكم بينة....»: has no grammatical position, a resumption in the course of Ṣāliḥ's saying.
The clause «هذه ناقة الله....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «ذروها....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هذه ناقة الله [Note: Or it is the apodosis of the implied conditional, in the position of jussive, i.e. "If you are worthy of faith, then leave her ..."].
The clause «تأكل....»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied conditional, not joined with the fāʾ [Note: I.e. "If you leave her, she will eat."].
The clause «لا تمسوها بسوء»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ذروها.
The clause «يأخذكم»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the concealed particle relative (أن).
(74) (الواو): conjunctive. (اذكروا إذ ... بعد عاد): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In āya (69) of this sura.]. (الواو): conjunctive. (بوأكم): a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Allah. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بوّأكم). (تتخذون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من سهول): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of (قصورا), if the verb is transitive to one object.. It is also permissible to attach it to the verb.], (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قصورا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunctive. (تنحتون): like تتخذون. (الجبال): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (بيوتا): an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara) [Note: Because the houses did not exist at the time of the carving.. It is permissible that it be a second object, by making تنحتون include the meaning of تتّخذون.. Or it is the mafʿūl bihi and (الجبال) is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from the mountains".], accusative, by interpretation as a derived word, i.e. "inhabited". (فاذكروا آلاء الله): its i'rab has passed [Note: In āya (69) of this sura.]. (الواو): conjunctive. (لا تعثوا): like لا تمسوا. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تعثوا). (مفسدين): an emphasising ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida) of the fāʿil pronoun, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «اذكروا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumed [clause], i.e. "Consider ..."
The clause «جعلكم ...»: in the position of genitive by the annexation of إذ to it.
The clause «بوّأكم....»: in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause جعلكم.
The clause «تتخذون»: in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the object pronoun in (بوّأكم).
The clause «تنحتون....»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تتخذون.
The clause «اذكروا آلاء....»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied conditional, i.e. "If you recognise Allah's bounty upon you, then remember the favours of Allah."
The clause «لا تعثوا في الأرض»: conjoined to the clause اذكروا آلاء الله.
(75) (قال الملأ ... من قومه): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In āya (66) of this sura.]. (اللام): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (قال). (استضعفوا): a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun in the position of nominative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (لمن): like للذين, and it is a badal of the first with repetition of the preposition, in the position of genitive. (آمن): a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid). (من): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil pronoun in (آمن). (الهمزة): for interrogation. (تعلمون): like تتخذون. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis. (صالحا): the noun of anna, accusative. (مرسل): the khabar of anna, nominative. (من رب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مرسل), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن صالحا مرسل ...) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of تعلمون.
(قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of inna. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (مؤمنون). (أرسل): a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Ṣāliḥ. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أرسل). (مؤمنون): the khabar of inna, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «قال الملأ ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «استكبروا....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «استضعفوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «آمن ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «تعلمون....»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «قالوا....»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنا ... مؤمنون»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «أرسل....»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
(76) (قال الذين استكبروا): like قال الملأ الذين استكبروا [Note: In āya (66) of this sura.]. (إنّا): like the preceding. (بالذي): like للذين, attached to (كافرون). (آمنتم): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (تم) is a pronoun, fāʿil. (به): like the preceding, attached to (آمنتم). (كافرون): the khabar of inna, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «قال الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «استكبروا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «إنا ... كافرون»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported.
The clause «آمنتم به»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
(77) (الفاء): resumptive. (عقروا): like قالوا. (الناقة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunctive.
