(عتوا): like قالوا, and the indeclinability is on the ḍamma implied on the alif omitted because of the meeting of two quiescents. (عن أمر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عتوا). (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunctive. (قالوا): like the first. (يا): a vocative particle. (صالح): the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (ائتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من المرسلين): the i'rab of its counterpart has passed [Note: In āya (70) of this sura.].
The clause «عقروا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «عتوا....»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
The vocative clause «يا صالح»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported [Note: It is permissible that the clause be parenthetical, and the clause ائتنا ... the speech reported.].
The clause «ائتنا ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to the vocative.
The clause «تعدنا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «كنت من المرسلين»: has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "If you are among the messengers, then bring us (فأتنا) what you promise us."
(78) (الفاء): conjunctive. (أخذت): like جاءت, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الرجفة): fāʿil, nominative. (الفاء): conjunctive. (أصبحوا): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of aṣbaḥa [Note: It is permissible that the verb be complete (tāmm), the wāw a fāʿil and (جاثمين) a ḥāl.]. (في دار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاثمين, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (جاثمين): the khabar of aṣbaḥa, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «أخذتهم الرجفة»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عقروا الناقة.
The clause «أصبحوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أخذتهم الرجفة.
(79) (الفاء): conjunctive. (تولى): a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Ṣāliḥ. (عن): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تولى). (الواو): conjunctive. (قال): like the first. (يا قوم): like the first one [Note: In āya (73) of this sura.]. (اللام): the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد): a particle of verification. (أبلغت): like آمنتم, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (رسالة): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ربي): like ربهم [Note: In āya 77 of this sura.]. (الواو): conjunctive. (نصحت): like آمنتم. (اللام): a preposition, and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نصحت). (الواو): conjunctive. (لكن): a particle of rectification (istidrāk), having no governing effect. (لا): negating. (تحبون): like تتخذون. (الناصحين): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «تولى عنهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أصبحوا.
The clause «قال ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (تولى) [Note: It is permissible that the clause be circumstantial, with (قد) implied.].
The clause «يا قوم ...»: in the position of accusative, the speech reported [Note: It is permissible that the clause be parenthetical, and the clause أبلغتكم the speech reported.].
The clause «أبلغتكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the reply to an implied oath, and the implied oath clause is the reply to the vocative.
The clause «نصحت لكم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the reply to the oath.
The clause «لا تحبون ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نصحت.

* Morphology:
(ناقة): a well-known non-derived (jāmid) noun, and the alif is changed from a wāw. Its plurals are ناق، نوق، أنوق، أنؤق، أونق، أينق، نياق، ناقات and أنواق, and the plural of the plural is أيانق and نياقات.
(سهول): plural of سهل, a non-derived noun for level ground; it was originally a derived adjective that was made the name of a concrete thing; its wazn is فعل, and the wazn of سهول is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(قصورا): plural of قصر, a non-derived noun for a lofty dwelling; it was originally a maṣdar (verbal noun) that was made the name of a concrete thing; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and the wazn of قصور is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(عتوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by omission: its original form is عتاوا; two quiescents met — the alif and the wāw — so the alif was dropped, and what precedes the wāw remained with fatḥa as an indication of it; its wazn is فعوا.
(الرجفة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from رجف يرجف, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; its wazn is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(جاثمين): plural of جاثم, an active participle of the triliteral جثم; its wazn is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The non-metaphoric trope (al-majāz al-mursal): in the saying of the Exalted ﴿فَعَقَرُوا النَّاقَةَ﴾.
The hamstringing is attributed to all of them, while the one who hamstrung her was one person, called Qudār. So the relation of this majāz is generality (al-ʿumūm).

* Benefits:
2- ﴿وَلكِنْ لا تُحِبُّونَ النَّاصِحِينَ﴾.
The meaning of «لكن» is rectification (istidrāk) and emphasis.
When «لكنّ» is lightened (takhfīf), it becomes inoperative (muhmal) and its governing effect is cancelled according to the majority, though Yūnus and al-Akhfash disagreed with them and permitted it to operate. And when an adverb, or a preposition and its genitive noun, comes after inna or one of its sisters, its noun is postponed; so let this be heeded, for fear of falling into error.
[Translator's note: the source numbers this single benefit "2".]

safi-cedvel:134-136.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (لمّا) an adverb meaning «when» (حين), containing the sense of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis قالوا. (وقع) a past verb. (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (وقع). (الرجز) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (يا) a vocative particle. (موسى) the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, in the position of accusative. (ادع) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت. (اللام) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ادع). (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, i.e.: by His covenant with you.], indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (ادع) [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in (ادع), i.e. call on Him, seeking a means through that which He covenanted with you.], (عهد) like وقع, and the fāʿil is هو. (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (عهد), and (الكاف) like the preceding one. (اللام) preparing for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam). (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle. (كشف) a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء) a pronoun, fāʿil. (عنا) like لنا, attached to (كشفت). (الرجز) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (اللام) the lām of the oath. (نؤمننّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative.. and (النون) is the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن. (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نؤمننّ). (الواو) a conjunction. (لنرسلنّ) like لنؤمننّ. (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (نرسلنّ) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl from بني إسرائيل.], and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بني) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ. (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa.
The clause: «وقع ... الرجز» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «قالوا» is a clause with no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «يا موسى ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
And the clause: «ادع لنا ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
And the clause: «عهد ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما), whether nominal or particle.
And the clause: «كشفت ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), or an explanation of the subject of the supplication and its purpose.
And the clause «نؤمننّ ... » has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath.. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath [Note: Abū Ḥayyān: (The oath clause is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of قالوا, i.e. they said ادع لنا ... while swearing).].
And the clause: «نرسلنّ..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the answer-of-the-oath clause.
(الفاء) a conjunction. (لمّا) like the first. (كشفنا عنهم الرجز) like كشفت عنّا الرجز. (إلى أجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كشفنا). (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (بالغو) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, and the nūn was dropped for annexation, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إذا) a particle of surprise. (هم) like the first. (ينكثون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
And the clause: «كشفنا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «هم بالغوه» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of أجل.
And the clause: «هم ينكثون» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «ينكثون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (هم).
(الفاء) a conjunction in both places [Note: The fāʾ may be redundant (zāʾida) in (أغرقناهم), and the clause in that case is a badal (substitute) for (انتقمنا).], (انتقمنا) like كشفت. (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (انتقمنا). (أغرقنا) like كشفت, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في اليمّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أغرقناهم). (الباء) a preposition. (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative, the noun of anna. (كذّبوا) like قالوا. (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (كذّبوا), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم كذّبوا) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أغرقناهم), and the bāʾ is causal.
(الواو) a conjunction. (كانوا) a defective past verb — an abrogator — indeclinable on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the noun of kāna. (عنها) like عنّا, attached to (غافلين). (غافلين) the khabar of كانوا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
And the clause: «انتقمنا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumption represented by the opening of the preceding ayahs: فلمّا وقع.. فلمّا كشفنا ...
And the clause: «أغرقناهم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause انتقمنا.
And the clause: «كذّبوا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.
And the clause: «كانوا ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كذّبوا.

* Morphology:
(اليمّ): a primitive (jāmid) concrete noun meaning «the sea»; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (istiʿāra): in His saying, Exalted is He, «إِذا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ», i.e. they break the covenant. The origin of النكث is undoing the strands of spun wool in order to spin it a second time; so it was borrowed for breaking a covenant after it has been concluded.

safi-cedvel:137-137.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (أورثنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). (القوم) first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of القوم. (كانوا) like the preceding one [Note: in the previous ayah (136).], (يستضعفون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (مشارق) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الواو) a conjunction. (مغارب) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مشارق, accusative, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (التي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of مشارق الأرض ومغاربها. (باركنا) like أورثنا. (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (باركنا). (الواو) a conjunction. (تمّت) a past verb ... and (التاء) for the feminine. (كلمة) fāʿil, nominative. (ربّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الحسنى) naʿt of كلمة, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (على بني) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تمّت). (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (صبروا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما صبروا) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تمّت).
(الواو) a conjunction. (دمّرنا) like أورثنا. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (كان) a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring back to ما [Note: i.e. we destroyed that which was made by Pharaoh.. The grammarians have allowed other ways of parsing this ayah, among them: a- that the noun of kāna is an obligatorily latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring back to Pharaoh, with the overt فرعون being the fāʿil of يصنع and the returning pronoun of the relative omitted, i.e. دمّرنا ما كان يصنعه فرعون.. And it is permissible for the overt فرعون to be the noun of kāna, with the fāʿil of يصنع being a latent pronoun referring back to Pharaoh, i.e. ما كان فرعون يصنعه.
b- that (كان) is redundant (zāʾida) and (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle, i.e. we destroyed Pharaoh's making.. al-ʿUkbarī mentioned it. And it is also valid for ما to be a relative. c- (كان) is a defective verb whose noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the clause يصنع is the khabar (predicate) of kāna.], (يصنع) an imperfect verb, nominative. (فرعون) the fāʿil of يصنع, nominative. (الواو) a conjunction. (قوم) maʿṭūf to فرعون, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (ما كانوا يعرشون) like ما كان يصنع ...
and conjoined to it.
The clause: «أورثنا ... » is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «كانوا يستضعفون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «يستضعفون ... » is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
And the clause: «باركنا ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (التي).
And the clause: «تمّت كلمة ربّك» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أورثنا.
And the clause: «صبروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
And the clause: «دمّرنا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أورثنا.
And the clause: «كان يصنع» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما), whether nominal or particle.
And the clause: «يصنع فرعون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kāna.
And the clause: «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
And the clause: «يعرشون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

* Benefits:
- The «tāʾ» in this ayah is written open (mabsūṭa) [Translator's note: i.e. in كلمت.], and this is one of the places in which the script of the words of the Quran differs from the rules of writing and spelling that we follow. It is good to point out that this kind of script is not to be taken as a basis for analogy, nor is it to be relied upon in our teaching of the principles of writing, because it is restricted to the Noble Quran, to the exclusion of other books.

safi-cedvel:167-169.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). (تأذّن): a past verb. (ربّ): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (اللام): the lām of oath [Note: Because the verb (تأذّن) is treated like an oath.]. (يبعثنّ): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative .. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (على): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبعثنّ). (إلى يوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبعثنّ) [Note: It may be attached to (تأذّن).]. (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (من): a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective ... and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as its naʿt (adjective).], indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يسوم): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" — and it is the referential pronoun (ʿāʾid) — and (هم) is a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi. (سوء): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إن): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh). (ربّ): the noun of إنّ, accusative, and (الكاف) is like the last. (اللام): it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis. (سريع): the khabar (predicate) of إن, nominative. (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): conjunction. (إنّ): like the first, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (لغفور): «قبل» لسريع [Translator's note: so in the source; «قبل» (before) is evidently a misprint for «مثل» (like): i.e. like لسريع.]. (رحيم): a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «تأذّن ربك ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يبعثّن ...»: has no grammatical position, the answer to an oath ... and the oath clause with its answer stands in place of the object of تأذّن [Note: Because the verb (تأذّن) means أعلم (to announce), from الأذان, which is announcing; so it meets the verbs of the heart in meaning.].
The clause «يسومهم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «إنّ ربّك لسريع ...»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya) or in its ruling.
The clause «إنّه لغفور»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ ربّك لسريع.
(الواو): conjunction. (قطّعنا): a past verb, indeclinable on «الكون» [Translator's note: so in the source; a misprint for «السكون» (sukūn).] .. and (نا) is the fāʿil, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قطّعنا). (أمما): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the object pronoun in (قطّعناهم) [Note: If (قطّعنا) is made to imply the meaning of صيّرنا (We made into), then (أمما) is its second object. [Translator's note: the source has «إ أضمّن», evidently for «إذا ضمّن».]]. (من): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. (الصالحون): a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (الواو): conjunction. (منهم): like the first. (دون): an adverb, accusative, a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, which is the delayed mubtadaʾ, i.e. ومنهم ناس أو قوم دون ذلك (and among them are people, or a folk, below that) [Note: Al-Zamakhsharī said: «Its meaning is: and among them are people who fall short of righteousness; and similar to it is «ما منّا إلّا له مقام معلوم», meaning: there is none of us but has a known station — that is, in the omission of the qualified noun and the setting up of the adjective in its place ...» end of quote.]. (ذلك): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) is for address. (الواو): conjunction. (بلونا): like قطّعنا, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بالحسنات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (بلونا). (الواو): conjunction. (السيّئات): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الحسنات, genitive. (لعلّهم يرجعون): like لعلّهم يتّقون [Note: In ayah (164) of this surah.].
The clause «قطّعناهم ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption in the course of the story of the Children of Israel.
The clause «منهم الصالحون»: in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (أمما).
The clause «منهم دون ذلك»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause منهم الصالحون.
The clause «بلوناهم»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قطّعناهم.
The clause «لعلّهم يرجعون»: has no grammatical position, causal.
The clause «يرجعون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.
(الفاء): conjunction. (خلف): a past verb. (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلف), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (خلف): fāʿil, nominative. (ورثوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (الكتاب): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (يأخذون): an imperfect verb, nominative ..
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (عرض): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الأدنى): a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif. (الواو): conjunction [Note: Or of the ḥāl, and the clause after it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.]. (يقولون): like يأخذون. (السين): a particle of the future. (يغفر): a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted, understood from the context of the speech, the implied form being ما فعلناه (what we did). (اللام): a preposition, and (نا) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (يغفر). (الواو): conjunction. (إن): a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. (يأت): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عرض): fāʿil, nominative. (مثل): a naʿt of عرض, nominative, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (يأخذوا): an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الهمزة): for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī). (لم): a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive. (يؤخذ): a passive imperfect verb, jussive. (عليهم): like the first, attached to (يؤخذ). (ميثاق): nāʾib fāʿil, nominative. (الكتاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle putting the verb in the accusative. (لا): a particle of negation. (يقولوا): an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقولوا). (إلّا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (الحقّ): mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألا يقولوا) is in the position of nominative as a badal of ميثاق, or ʿaṭf bayān [Note: And it may be genitive by the lām of causation — on the view of al-Zamakhsharī — who said: «Its meaning is: so that they would not say about Allah except the truth ...»; and he explained the covenant of the Book by saying: in the Torah, whoever commits a grave sin is not forgiven except by repentance. Further, it is permissible for (أن) to be an explicative particle explaining the covenant of the Book, because it has the meaning of saying, and (لا) a particle of prohibition, and the verb jussive by the particle of prohibition .. and the clause has no grammatical position, explicative; for that reason (أن لا) was written separately in the muṣḥaf. And it is permissible for (الحقّ) to be accusative as a maṣdar, i.e. القول الحقّ (the true saying).].
(الواو): conjunction. (درسوا): like ورثوا. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (في): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to the omitted ṣila of ما. (الواو): resumptive. (الدار): mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الآخرة): a naʿt of الدار, nominative like it. (خير): khabar, nominative. (اللام): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (خير). (يتّقون): like يأخذون. (الهمزة): for interrogation. (الفاء): conjunction, linking the effect to the cause. (لا): negating. (تعقلون): like يأخذون.
The clause «خلف ... خلف»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قطّعناهم.
The clause «ورثوا ...»: in the position of nominative as a naʿt of خلف.
The clause «يأخذون ...»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of ورثوا [Note: Or it has no grammatical position, cut off as a resumption.].
The clause «يقولون ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يأخذون.
The clause «سيغفر لنا»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يأتهم عرض ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Al-Zamakhsharī makes the wāw before the clause one of the ḥāl, and the clause is confined to being a ḥāl.].
The clause «يأخذوه»: has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لم يؤخذ ... ميثاق»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يقولوا ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative.
The clause «درسوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يؤخذ [Note: Al-ʿUkbarī made this clause conjoined to the clause ورثوا, and the clause يؤخذ parenthetical.], i.e.: was not the covenant taken from them in the Book, and they studied what came in it — so why did they lie about Allah? The clause «الدار الآخرة خير»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يتّقون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «تعقلون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
أغفلتم فلا تعقلون (have you been heedless, so that you do not understand?).

* Morphology:
(خلف): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning generation after generation; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. It is mostly used for evil when the lām comes with sukūn, and for good when the lām comes with fatḥa.

* Benefits:
1- «دون» is the opposite of «فوق» (above), and it is an adverb of place, accusative. One says «هذا دونك» (this is below you) in belittling and in approximating. So from one aspect it is an adverb and is put in the accusative, and from another aspect it is a noun, so a preposition enters upon it. «دون» may mean in front of, behind and above, so it is one of the words with opposite meanings (aḍdād). Of the meaning "behind" is their saying «أمير على مادون الفرات» (a governor over what is beyond the Euphrates), i.e. behind it. It may mean «غير» (other than), as in the words of the Exalted: «إِلهَيْنِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ», i.e. other than Allah, and His words «وَيَغْفِرُ ما دُونَ ذلِكَ».
The kāf of address may be attached to it, so it becomes a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr), as in دونك الكتاب, i.e. take it; its fāʿil is "anta", the kāf is for address, and الكتاب is mafʿūl bihi. The discussion has a continuation when we deal with the verbal nouns (asmāʾ al-afʿāl).

safi-cedvel:170-170.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (الذين): a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يمسّكون): like يأخذون «1». (بالكتاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يمسّكون). (الواو): conjunction. (أقاموا): like ورثوا «2». (الصلاة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (إنا): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and its noun. (لا): negating. (نضيع): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "naḥnu", for majesty. (أجر): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (المصلحين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «الذين يمسّكون ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يمسّكون ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أقاموا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «إنّا لا نضيع ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين); the overt noun has been put in the place of the pronoun, i.e. in place of (لا نضيع أجرهم) .. so the linking is completed by the word المصلحين.
The clause «لا نضيع ...»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
[Translator's note: The markers «1» and «2» refer to the previous entry (ayah 169), where يأخذون and ورثوا are parsed; their footnote texts are not given in the source.]

safi-cedvel:171-171.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). (نتقنا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn ... and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent), for majesty. (الجبل): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (فوق): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتقنا) by its being made to imply the meaning of رفعنا (We raised), and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (كأنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for likening — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of كأنّ. (ظلّة): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (الواو): conjunction — or of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (ظنّوا): like ورثوا [Note: In ayah (169) of this surah.]. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, the noun of أنّ. (واقع): khabar, nominative. (الباء): a preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to (واقع).
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه واقع بهم) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of ظنّ.
(خذوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn .. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (آتينا): like نتقنا, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بقوّة): a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the second-person pronoun, i.e. مجدّين or مجتهدين (earnest, striving). (الواو): conjunction. (اذكروا): like خذوا. (ما): like the first. (في): a preposition, and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive; attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (لعلّ): for hope, a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) is a pronoun, the noun of لعلّ. (تتّقون): an imperfect verb, nominative .. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «نتقنا ...»: in the position of genitive by (إذ) being put in construct with it.
The clause «كأنّه ظلّة»: in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of الجبل.
The clause «ظنّوا ...»: in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause نتقنا [Note: The clause may be a ḥāl of الجبل with (قد) implied. It may also be resumptive with no grammatical position.].
The clause «خذوا»: in the position of accusative as the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. وقلنا خذوا (and We said: take), and the clause of saying is conjoined to the clause نتقنا.
The clause «آتيناكم ...»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «اذكروا»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوا.
The clause «لعلّكم تتّقون»: has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تتّقون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(ظلّة): a primitive (jāmid) noun for a concrete thing; its pattern is فعله [Translator's note: so in the source, for فعلة], with ḍamma then sukūn. The plural is ظلل and ظلال, and it is anything that shades you.
(واقع): an active participle of the triliteral وقع; its pattern is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- The loose simile (tashbīh mursal): in the words of the Exalted «وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ», i.e. a cloud or a canopy. It was explained thus, even though it is anything that rises above and shades, because of the particle of likening. The benefit of this simile here is bringing what custom has not experienced out to what custom has experienced.
2- Kināya (metonymy): in the words of the Exalted «خُذُوا ما آتَيْناكُمْ بِقُوَّةٍ وَاذْكُرُوا ما فِيهِ», i.e. act upon it and do not leave it as something forgotten; it is a kināya for that, or a majāz (figurative usage).

safi-cedvel:172-172.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ أخذ ربّك): like إذ تأذّن ربّك [Note: In ayah (167) of this surah.]. (من بني): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخذ), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (آدم): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (من ظهور): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذ), because it is a badal (substitute) of the first genitive noun with repetition of the preposition, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (ذرّيّة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) is like the last. (الواو): conjunction. (أشهد): a past verb, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". (على أنفس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أشهد), and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (الهمزة): for interrogation. (لست): a past, inflexible (jāmid), incomplete verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (التاء) is a pronoun, the noun of ليس. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (ربّ): genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of ليس, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil. (بلى): a particle for affirming the negated. (شهدنا): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (نا) is the fāʿil. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle putting the verb in the accusative. (وتقولوا): an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تقولوا). (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (إنّا): a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator — and (نا) is a pronoun, the noun of إنّ, in the position of accusative. (كنّا): an incomplete past verb and its noun. (عن): a preposition. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (غافلين), which is the khabar of كنّا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقولوا) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. خشية أن تقولوا (for fear that you would say).
The clause «أخذ ربك ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أشهدهم»: in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause أخذ ربّك ...
The clause «ألست بربّكم»: in the position of accusative as the object of an implied saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e.: قال: ألست بربّكم (He said: am I not your Lord?) [Note: It may be resumptive with no grammatical position, on taking أشهدهم to mean سألهم (He asked them).].
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «بلى (أنت ربّنا)», the implied one ..: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «شهدنا ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive ... either within the scope of the preceding saying, i.e. the saying of the offspring, or it goes back to the saying of the angels.
The clause «تقولوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «إنّا كنّا ...»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «كنّا ... غافلين»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّا.

safi-cedvel:173-173.t:
* I'rab:
(أو): a conjunction. (تقولوا): like the previous one «1», so it is conjoined to it. (إنما): a restraining (kāffa) particle and the restrained (makfūfa) particle. (أشرك): a past verb. (آباء): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أشرك). (الواو): conjunction. (كنّا): like the previous one «2». (ذريّة): khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb). (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of ذرّيّة, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الهمزة): for interrogation. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis of an implied condition, and it is delayed from a fronted position [Translator's note: i.e. its proper place is before the interrogative hamza, but it is written after it]. (تهلك): an imperfect verb, nominative, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "anta". (الباء): a preposition, causal. (ما): a maṣdar-forming particle. (فعل المبطلون): a past verb and its fāʿil, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «تقولوا ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تقولوا «3».
The clause «أشرك آباؤنا»: in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنّا ذرّيّة ...»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أشرك آباؤنا.
The clause «تهلكنا ...»: the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. فإن أخطأنا من بعدهم فهل تهلكنا ... (so if we erred after them, would You destroy us ...); and the condition clause with its apodosis is conjoined to the clause that is the object of the saying.
The clause «فعل المبطلون»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما فعل المبطلون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تهلكنا).
[Translator's note: The markers «1»–«3» appear in the source without their footnote texts; they evidently refer to ayah (172).]

* Morphology:
(المبطلون): plural of المبطل, an active participle of the quadriliteral أبطل; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:174-174.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (الكاف): a preposition [Note: Or a noun meaning مثل (like), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, as it is its adjective, i.e. تفصيلا مثل ذلك (a detailing like that).]. (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is نفصّل [Note: I.e. نفصّل الآيات تفصيلا كذلك التفصيل السابق (We detail the signs with a detailing like the previous detailing).]. (نفصّل): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu", for majesty. (الآيات): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الواو): conjunction. (لعلّهم يرجعون): like لعلّكم تتّقون [Note: In ayah (171) of this surah.].
The clause «نفصّل ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لعلّهم يرجعون»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumptive, causal clause, i.e. لعلّهم يتدبّروها ولعلّهم يرجعون (so that they may reflect on them, and so that they may return).
The clause «يرجعون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.
